/// Localised certificate kind (never the raw enum such as `SICK_LEAVE`).
fn certificate_kind_label(de: bool, kind: &str) -> String {
    let (d, e) = match kind {
        "SICK_LEAVE" => ("Arbeitsunfähigkeitsbescheinigung", "Sick-leave certificate"),
        "SPORTS_EXEMPTION" => ("Sportbefreiung", "Sports exemption"),
        "SCHOOL_EXEMPTION" => ("Schulbefreiung", "School exemption"),
        "TREATMENT_CONFIRMATION" => ("Behandlungsbestätigung", "Treatment confirmation"),
        _ => ("Bescheinigung", "Certificate"),
    };
    if de { d.into() } else { e.into() }
}

/// Turns off chart sections the caller's role is not allowed to see.
fn gate_chart_sections(
    sec: &mut ChartExportSections,
    role: Role,
    overrides: &[crate::domain::rbac::PermissionOverride],
) {
    let medical = rbac::effective_allowed("patient.read_medical", role, overrides);
    let finance = rbac::effective_allowed("finance.read", role, overrides);
    let documents = rbac::effective_allowed("patient.read_documents", role, overrides);
    let audit_ok = rbac::effective_allowed("audit.read", role, overrides);
    if !medical {
        sec.dental_findings = false;
        sec.anamnesis = false;
        sec.examinations = false;
        sec.treatments = false;
        sec.prescriptions = false;
        sec.certificate = false;
    }
    if !finance {
        sec.payments = false;
    }
    if !documents {
        sec.attachments = false;
    }
    if !audit_ok {
        sec.audit = false;
    }
}

fn fmt_treatment_status(de: bool, raw: &str) -> String {
    match raw.trim().to_uppercase().as_str() {
        "COMPLETED" => l(de, "Completed"),
        "PLANNED" => l(de, "Planned"),
        "ABGEBROCHEN" => l(de, "Discontinued"),
        "CANCELLED" => l(de, "Cancelled"),
        other if other.is_empty() || other == "-" => "-".into(),
        other => truncate_cell(other, 12),
    }
}

async fn practice_kv_pairs_from_app_kv(pool: &SqlitePool, de: bool) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
    let Ok(Some(raw)) = app_kv_repo::get(pool, "invoice.practice.v1").await else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let Ok(j) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&raw) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let get = |k: &str| {
        j.get(k)
            .and_then(|version| version.as_str())
            .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
            .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
    };
    let mut kv = Vec::new();
    if let Some(version) = get("name") {
        kv.push((l(de, "Practice"), version));
    }
    if let Some(version) = get("clinician_name") {
        kv.push((l(de, "Clinician"), version));
    }
    if let Some(version) = get("bsnr") {
        kv.push(("BSNR".into(), version));
    }
    if let Some(version) = get("zanr") {
        kv.push(("ZANR".into(), version));
    }
    if let Some(version) = get("emergency_phone").or_else(|| get("notfall_phone")) {
        kv.push((l(de, "Emergency"), version));
    }
    kv
}

async fn chart_header_from_app_kv(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    created_by: &str,
    document_id: &str,
    locale: &str,
) -> Option<ChartHeaderContext> {
    let Ok(Some(raw)) = app_kv_repo::get(pool, "invoice.practice.v1").await else {
        return None;
    };
    let Ok(j) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&raw) else {
        return None;
    };
    let get = |k: &str| {
        j.get(k)
            .and_then(|version| version.as_str())
            .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
            .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
    };
    let name = get("name")?;
    let mut practice_lines = vec![name];
    if let Some(addr) = get("addr") {
        for ln in addr.lines() {
            let t = ln.trim();
            if !t.is_empty() {
                practice_lines.push(t.to_string());
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(t) = get("phone") {
        practice_lines.push(format!("Tel. {t}"));
    }
    if let Some(t) = get("fax") {
        practice_lines.push(format!("Fax {t}"));
    }
    if let Some(e) = get("email") {
        practice_lines.push(e);
    }
    if let Some(w) = get("web") {
        practice_lines.push(
            w.trim_start_matches("https://")
                .trim_start_matches("http://")
                .to_string(),
        );
    }
    if let Some(b) = get("bsnr") {
        practice_lines.push(format!("BSNR {b}"));
    }
    if let Some(z) = get("zanr") {
        practice_lines.push(format!("ZANR {z}"));
    }
    Some(ChartHeaderContext {
        practice_lines,
        clinician_name: get("clinician_name"),
        professional_title: get("professional_title"),
        bsnr: get("bsnr"),
        zanr: get("zanr"),
        created_by: Some(created_by.to_string()),
        document_id: Some(document_id.to_string()),
        logo: app_kv_repo::get(pool, "practice.logo.v1")
            .await
            .ok()
            .flatten()
            .and_then(|raw| crate::infrastructure::pdf::PdfLogo::from_kv_json(&raw)),
        locale: locale.into(),
        rtl: locale == "ar",
        watermark: None,
        footer_lines: PracticeProfile::load(pool)
            .await
            .map(|p| p.footer_lines(locale))
            .unwrap_or_default(),
    })
}

#[derive(Debug, serde::Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ChartExportSections {
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub patient: bool,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub chart_core: bool,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub dental_findings: bool,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub anamnesis: bool,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub examinations: bool,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub treatments: bool,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub prescriptions: bool,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub certificate: bool,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub payments: bool,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub attachments: bool,
    /// Audit-Log-Auszug für diesen Patients (`entity_id`); nur mit `audit.read`.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub audit: bool,
}

impl Default for ChartExportSections {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            patient: true,
            chart_core: true,
            dental_findings: true,
            anamnesis: true,
            examinations: true,
            treatments: true,
            prescriptions: true,
            certificate: true,
            payments: true,
            attachments: true,
            audit: false,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ExportChartPdfArgs {
    /// Akzeptiert `patientId` (Tauri/JS) und Legacy `patient_id`.
    #[serde(alias = "patient_id")]
    pub patient_id: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub sections: ChartExportSections,
    /// Watermarked preview: no number, no registry entry, no export audit.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub preview: bool,
}

/// FA-DOK-08: Discharge leaflet / aftercare as PDF (compact summary).
#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ExportDischargeLeafletPdfArgs {
    #[serde(alias = "patient_id")]
    pub patient_id: String,
    /// Additional notes / aftercare.
    #[serde(default, alias = "additionalNotes")]
    pub additional_notes: Option<String>,
    /// Referral / onward care.
    #[serde(default, alias = "referralNotes")]
    pub referral_notes: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub preview: bool,
}

/// FA-AKTE-04: patient chart extract as PDF (selectable sections).
/// `preview = true` → watermarked, unnumbered, not registered.
pub async fn export_chart_pdf(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    session: &Session,
    args: ExportChartPdfArgs,
) -> Result<IssuedPdf, AppError> {
    use base64::Engine;
    let preview = args.preview;

    let role = Role::parse(&session.role).ok_or(AppError::Unauthorized)?;
    let ov = &session.permission_overrides;
    let patient_id = args.patient_id.clone();
    let mut sec = args.sections;
    gate_chart_sections(&mut sec, role, ov);
    let sections_json = serde_json::to_value(&sec).unwrap_or_default();
    let medical = rbac::effective_allowed("patient.read_medical", role, ov);

    let patient = patient_repo::find_by_id(pool, &patient_id)
        .await?
        .ok_or(AppError::NotFound("Patient".into()))?;
    let chart = chart_repo::find_chart_by_patient(pool, &patient_id)
        .await?
        .ok_or(AppError::NotFound("PatientChart".into()))?;

    let mut chart_display = chart.clone();
    if !medical {
        chart_display.diagnosis = None;
        chart_display.findings = None;
    }

    let locale = document_locale(pool).await;
    let de = locale == "de";
    // Local time: the document is read by people in the practice's time zone.
    let generated = chrono::Local::now().format("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M").to_string();
    let mut blocks: Vec<ChartPdfBlock> = Vec::new();

    let practice_kv = practice_kv_pairs_from_app_kv(pool, de).await;
    if !practice_kv.is_empty() {
        blocks.insert(
            0,
            ChartPdfBlock {
                title: l(de, "Practice"),
                body_lines: vec![],
                kv_pairs: practice_kv,
                table: None,
            },
        );
    }

    if sec.patient {
        let mut kv = vec![
            ("Name".into(), patient.name.clone()),
            (l(de, "Date of birth"), patient.date_of_birth.to_string()),
            (l(de, "Sex"), patient.sex.clone()),
            (
                l(de, "Insurance number"),
                patient.insurance_number.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
            ),
            (l(de, "Patient status"), patient.status.clone()),
        ];
        if let Some(t) = &patient.phone {
            kv.push((l(de, "Phone"), t.clone()));
        }
        if let Some(e) = &patient.email {
            kv.push((l(de, "Email"), e.clone()));
        }
        if let Some(a) = &patient.address {
            kv.push((l(de, "Address"), a.clone()));
        }
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
            title: l(de, "Master data"),
            body_lines: vec![],
            kv_pairs: kv,
            table: None,
        });
    }

    if sec.chart_core {
        let mut kv = vec![
            (l(de, "Chart ID"), chart_display.id.clone()),
            (l(de, "Chart status"), chart_display.status.clone()),
        ];
        if medical {
            kv.push((
                l(de, "Diagnosis"),
                chart_display
                    .diagnosis
                    .as_deref()
                    .map(crate::infrastructure::clinical_text_format::plain_text_for_pdf)
                    .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| l(de, "(none recorded)")),
            ));
            kv.push((
                l(de, "Findings"),
                chart_display
                    .findings
                    .as_deref()
                    .map(crate::infrastructure::clinical_text_format::plain_text_for_pdf)
                    .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| l(de, "(none recorded)")),
            ));
        } else {
            kv.push((
                l(de, "Note"),
                l(de, "Diagnosis/findings not included for this role."),
            ));
        }
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
            title: l(de, "Patient chart (core)"),
            body_lines: vec![],
            kv_pairs: kv,
            table: None,
        });
    }

    if sec.dental_findings && medical {
        let rows_db = chart_repo::find_dental_findings(pool, &chart.id).await?;
        let tbl = if rows_db.is_empty() {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Tooth"),
                    l(de, "Finding"),
                    l(de, "Diagnosis"),
                    l(de, "Notes"),
                ],
                rows: vec![],
                ..Default::default()
            }
        } else {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Tooth"),
                    l(de, "Finding"),
                    l(de, "Diagnosis"),
                    l(de, "Notes"),
                ],
                rows: rows_db
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|z| {
                        vec![
                            z.tooth_number.to_string(),
                            z.finding.clone(),
                            z.diagnosis.as_deref().unwrap_or("-").to_string(),
                            z.notes.as_deref().unwrap_or("-").to_string(),
                        ]
                    })
                    .collect(),
                ..Default::default()
            }
        };
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
            title: l(de, "DentalFindings"),
            body_lines: vec![],
            kv_pairs: vec![],
            table: Some(tbl),
        });
    }

    if sec.anamnesis && medical {
        if let Some(am) = chart_repo::find_anamnesis_form(pool, &patient_id).await? {
            let signed = match (de, am.signed) {
                (true, true) => "Unterschrieben: ja",
                (true, false) => "Unterschrieben: nein",
                (false, true) => "Signed: yes",
                (false, false) => "Signed: no",
            };
            let mut lines =
                crate::infrastructure::clinical_text_format::format_anamnesis_answers(&am.answers);
            lines.insert(0, signed.to_string());
            blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
                title: l(de, "Anamnesis / questionnaire"),
                body_lines: lines,
                kv_pairs: vec![],
                table: None,
            });
        } else {
            blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(
                l(de, "Anamnesis / questionnaire"),
                vec![l(de, "(no anamnesis form recorded)")],
            ));
        }
    }

    if sec.examinations && medical {
        let rows_db = chart_repo::list_examinations(pool, &chart.id).await?;
        let tbl = if rows_db.is_empty() {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Date"),
                    "Nr.".into(),
                    l(de, "Examination findings (full)"),
                ],
                rows: vec![],
                column_weights: Some(vec![2, 1, 12]),
            }
        } else {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Date"),
                    "Nr.".into(),
                    l(de, "Examination findings (full)"),
                ],
                rows: rows_db
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|u| {
                        let finding =
                            crate::infrastructure::clinical_text_format::format_examination_for_chart_table(
                                u.chief_complaint.as_deref(),
                                u.results.as_deref(),
                                u.diagnosis.as_deref(),
                            );
                        vec![
                            u.created_at.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
                            u.examination_number.as_deref().unwrap_or("-").to_string(),
                            finding,
                        ]
                    })
                    .collect(),
                column_weights: Some(vec![2, 1, 12]),
            }
        };
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
            title: l(de, "Examinations"),
            body_lines: vec![],
            kv_pairs: vec![],
            table: Some(tbl),
        });
    }

    if sec.treatments && medical {
        let rows_db = chart_repo::list_treatments(pool, &chart.id).await?;
        let tbl = if rows_db.is_empty() {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Date"),
                    l(de, "ServiceItem"),
                    l(de, "Cat."),
                    l(de, "Sess."),
                    "B-Nr.".into(),
                    "Status".into(),
                    "EUR".into(),
                    l(de, "Notes"),
                ],
                rows: vec![],
                column_weights: Some(vec![2, 4, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1, 3]),
            }
        } else {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Date"),
                    l(de, "ServiceItem"),
                    l(de, "Cat."),
                    l(de, "Sess."),
                    "B-Nr.".into(),
                    "Status".into(),
                    "EUR".into(),
                    l(de, "Notes"),
                ],
                rows: rows_db
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|b| {
                        let d = b.treatment_date.as_deref().unwrap_or("");
                        let date_part = if d.is_empty() {
                            b.created_at.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string()
                        } else {
                            d.to_string()
                        };
                        let title = b
                            .service_name
                            .as_deref()
                            .or(b.description.as_deref())
                            .unwrap_or(b.kind.as_str())
                            .to_string();
                        let cost = b
                            .total_cost
                            .map(|k| format!("{:.2}", k))
                            .unwrap_or_else(|| "-".into());
                        vec![
                            date_part,
                            title,
                            b.category.as_deref().unwrap_or("-").to_string(),
                            b.session_number
                                .map(|s| s.to_string())
                                .unwrap_or_else(|| "-".into()),
                            b.treatment_number.as_deref().unwrap_or("-").to_string(),
                            fmt_treatment_status(de, b.treatment_status.as_deref().unwrap_or("-")),
                            cost,
                            b.notes.as_deref().unwrap_or("-").to_string(),
                        ]
                    })
                    .collect(),
                column_weights: Some(vec![2, 4, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1, 3]),
            }
        };
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
            title: l(de, "Treatments"),
            body_lines: vec![],
            kv_pairs: vec![],
            table: Some(tbl),
        });
    }

    if sec.prescriptions && medical {
        let rows_db = prescription_repo::find_for_patient(pool, &patient_id).await?;
        let tbl = if rows_db.is_empty() {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Issued"),
                    l(de, "Medication"),
                    l(de, "Dosage"),
                    l(de, "Duration"),
                    "Status".into(),
                    l(de, "Active ingredient"),
                ],
                rows: vec![],
                ..Default::default()
            }
        } else {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Issued"),
                    l(de, "Medication"),
                    l(de, "Dosage"),
                    l(de, "Duration"),
                    "Status".into(),
                    l(de, "Active ingredient"),
                ],
                rows: rows_db
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|r| {
                        vec![
                            r.issued_at.to_string(),
                            r.medication.clone(),
                            r.dosage.clone(),
                            r.duration.clone(),
                            r.status.clone(),
                            r.active_ingredient.as_deref().unwrap_or("-").to_string(),
                        ]
                    })
                    .collect(),
                ..Default::default()
            }
        };
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
            title: l(de, "Prescriptions"),
            body_lines: vec![],
            kv_pairs: vec![],
            table: Some(tbl),
        });
    }

    if sec.certificate && medical {
        let rows_db = certificate_repo::find_for_patient(pool, &patient_id).await?;
        if rows_db.is_empty() {
            blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(
                l(de, "Certificates"),
                vec![l(de, "(no certificates)")],
            ));
        } else {
            let certificate_rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = rows_db
                .iter()
                .map(|a| {
                    vec![
                        certificate_kind_label(de, &a.kind),
                        a.valid_from.to_string(),
                        a.valid_until.to_string(),
                        a.issued_at.to_string(),
                    ]
                })
                .collect();
            blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
                title: l(de, "Certificates (overview)"),
                body_lines: vec![],
                kv_pairs: vec![],
                table: Some(ChartPdfTable {
                    headers: vec![
                        l(de, "Type"),
                        l(de, "Valid from"),
                        l(de, "Valid until"),
                        l(de, "Issued"),
                    ],
                    rows: certificate_rows,
                    ..Default::default()
                }),
            });
            for a in rows_db {
                let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
                if a.body_text.trim().is_empty() {
                    lines.push(l(de, "(no free text)"));
                } else {
                    for ln in a.body_text.lines() {
                        lines.push(if ln.is_empty() {
                            " ".into()
                        } else {
                            ln.to_string()
                        });
                    }
                }
                blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(
                    certificate_kind_label(de, &a.kind),
                    lines,
                ));
            }
        }
    }

    if sec.payments {
        let rows_db = payment_repo::find_by_patient_id(pool, &patient_id).await?;
        let tbl = if rows_db.is_empty() {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Time"),
                    "EUR".into(),
                    l(de, "Kind"),
                    "Status".into(),
                    l(de, "Beschreibung"),
                ],
                rows: vec![],
                ..Default::default()
            }
        } else {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Time"),
                    "EUR".into(),
                    l(de, "Kind"),
                    "Status".into(),
                    l(de, "Beschreibung"),
                ],
                rows: rows_db
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|z| {
                        vec![
                            z.created_at.format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M").to_string(),
                            format!("{:.2}", z.amount),
                            z.payment_method.to_string(),
                            z.status.to_string(),
                            z.description.as_deref().unwrap_or("-").to_string(),
                        ]
                    })
                    .collect(),
                ..Default::default()
            }
        };
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
            title: l(de, "Payments / Buchungen"),
            body_lines: vec![],
            kv_pairs: vec![],
            table: Some(tbl),
        });
    }

    if sec.attachments {
        let rows_db = chart_attachment_repo::list_for_chart(pool, &chart.id).await?;
        let tbl = if rows_db.is_empty() {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Dateiname"),
                    l(de, "MIME"),
                    l(de, "Date"),
                    "Bytes".into(),
                ],
                rows: vec![],
                ..Default::default()
            }
        } else {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Dateiname"),
                    l(de, "MIME"),
                    l(de, "Date"),
                    "Bytes".into(),
                ],
                rows: rows_db
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|r| {
                        vec![
                            r.display_name.clone(),
                            r.mime_type.clone(),
                            r.created_at.to_string(),
                            r.size_bytes.to_string(),
                        ]
                    })
                    .collect(),
                ..Default::default()
            }
        };
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
            title: l(de, "Chart attachments (metadata)"),
            body_lines: vec![],
            kv_pairs: vec![],
            table: Some(tbl),
        });
    }

    if sec.audit {
        let rows_db = audit_repo::find_for_patient_entity(pool, &patient_id, 500).await?;
        let tbl = if rows_db.is_empty() {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Time"),
                    l(de, "Aktion"),
                    l(de, "Entity"),
                    "ID".into(),
                    "Details".into(),
                ],
                rows: vec![],
                ..Default::default()
            }
        } else {
            ChartPdfTable {
                headers: vec![
                    l(de, "Time"),
                    l(de, "Aktion"),
                    l(de, "Entity"),
                    "ID".into(),
                    "Details".into(),
                ],
                rows: rows_db
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|r| {
                        vec![
                            r.created_at.format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M").to_string(),
                            r.action.clone(),
                            r.entity.clone(),
                            r.entity_id.as_deref().unwrap_or("-").to_string(),
                            r.details.as_deref().unwrap_or("-").to_string(),
                        ]
                    })
                    .collect(),
                ..Default::default()
            }
        };
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
            title: l(de, "Audit extract"),
            body_lines: vec![],
            kv_pairs: vec![],
            table: Some(tbl),
        });
    }

    let created_by = format!("{} ({})", session.name, session.role);
    let title = if de { "Patientenakte – Auszug" } else { "Patient chart – extract" };
    let pdf_title = format!("{title} {}", patient.name);
    let header_base = chart_header_from_app_kv(pool, &created_by, "", locale).await;
    let render = |number: &str, watermark: Option<String>| -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
        let mut blocks = blocks.clone();
        let mut header = header_base.clone();
        if let Some(h) = header.as_mut() {
            h.document_id = Some(number.to_string());
            h.watermark = watermark;
        }
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(
            l(de, "Notes"),
            vec![
                format!("{}: {created_by}", if de { "Erstellt von" } else { "Created by" }),
                format!("{}: {number}", if de { "Dokument-Nr." } else { "Document no." }),
                l(de, "This document contains confidential patient data (§ 630f BGB)."),
                l(de, "Disclosure only with the patient's explicit consent."),
            ],
        ));
        render_chart_blocks(title, &generated, &pdf_title, &blocks, header.as_ref())
    };

    if preview {
        let bytes = render(WATERMARK_PREVIEW, Some(WATERMARK_PREVIEW.into()))?;
        return Ok(IssuedPdf {
            document_id: None,
            document_number: None,
            sha256: crate::infrastructure::database::issued_document_repo::sha256_hex(&bytes),
            pdf_base64: base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&bytes),
            reprint: false,
        });
    }
    let payload = serde_json::json!({ "sections": sections_json, "generatedAt": generated });
    register_rendered(pool, session, DocKind::ChartExtract, &patient_id, payload, |number| {
        render(number, None)
    })
    .await
}

/// FA-DOK-08: Discharge leaflet / aftercare as PDF.
pub async fn export_discharge_leaflet_pdf(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    session: &Session,
    args: ExportDischargeLeafletPdfArgs,
) -> Result<IssuedPdf, AppError> {
    use base64::Engine;
    let preview = args.preview;

    let patient_id = args.patient_id.clone();
    let patient = patient_repo::find_by_id(pool, &patient_id)
        .await?
        .ok_or(AppError::NotFound("Patient".into()))?;
    let chart = chart_repo::find_chart_by_patient(pool, &patient_id)
        .await?
        .ok_or(AppError::NotFound("PatientChart".into()))?;

    let locale = document_locale(pool).await;
    let de = locale == "de";
    // Local time: the document is read by people in the practice's time zone.
    let generated = chrono::Local::now().format("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M").to_string();
    let mut blocks: Vec<ChartPdfBlock> = Vec::new();

    let practice_kv = practice_kv_pairs_from_app_kv(pool, de).await;
    if !practice_kv.is_empty() {
        blocks.insert(
            0,
            ChartPdfBlock {
                title: l(de, "Practice"),
                body_lines: vec![],
                kv_pairs: practice_kv,
                table: None,
            },
        );
    }

    let mut master_kv = vec![
        ("Name".into(), patient.name.clone()),
        (l(de, "Date of birth"), patient.date_of_birth.to_string()),
    ];
    if let Some(t) = &patient.phone {
        master_kv.push((l(de, "Phone"), t.clone()));
    }
    if let Some(e) = &patient.email {
        master_kv.push((l(de, "Email"), e.clone()));
    }
    blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
        title: l(de, "Patient — master data"),
        body_lines: vec![],
        kv_pairs: master_kv,
        table: None,
    });

    let mut bh_list = chart_repo::list_treatments(pool, &chart.id).await?;
    bh_list.sort_by(|a, b| {
        let da = a.treatment_date.as_deref().unwrap_or("0000-01-01");
        let db = b.treatment_date.as_deref().unwrap_or("0000-01-01");
        db.cmp(da).then_with(|| b.created_at.cmp(&a.created_at))
    });
    let latest_bh = bh_list.into_iter().next();

    if let Some(b) = latest_bh {
        let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        lines.push(format!(
            "{}: {}",
            l(de, "Date"),
            b.treatment_date
                .clone()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| l(de, "(no date)"))
        ));
        lines.push(format!("{}: {}", l(de, "Kind"), b.kind));
        if let Some(k) = &b.category {
            if !k.trim().is_empty() {
                lines.push(format!("{}: {}", if de { "Kategorie" } else { "Category" }, k));
            }
        }
        if let Some(desc) = &b.description {
            if !desc.trim().is_empty() {
                lines.push(l(de, "Description:"));
                for ln in desc.lines() {
                    lines.push(if ln.is_empty() {
                        " ".into()
                    } else {
                        ln.to_string()
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(n) = &b.notes {
            if !n.trim().is_empty() {
                lines.push(l(de, "Notes:"));
                for ln in n.lines() {
                    lines.push(if ln.is_empty() {
                        " ".into()
                    } else {
                        ln.to_string()
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(l(de, "Last documented treatment"), lines));
    } else {
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(
            l(de, "Last documented treatment"),
            vec![l(de, "(no treatment entries)")],
        ));
    }

    let prescriptions = prescription_repo::find_for_patient(pool, &patient_id).await?;
    let rz_take: Vec<_> = prescriptions.into_iter().take(12).collect();
    if rz_take.is_empty() {
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(
            l(de, "Medication (prescriptions)"),
            vec![l(de, "(no prescriptions recorded)")],
        ));
    } else {
        let tbl = ChartPdfTable {
            headers: vec![
                l(de, "Issued"),
                l(de, "Medication"),
                l(de, "Dosage"),
                l(de, "Duration"),
                l(de, "Notes"),
            ],
            rows: rz_take
                .iter()
                .map(|r| {
                    vec![
                        r.issued_at.to_string(),
                        r.medication.clone(),
                        r.dosage.clone(),
                        r.duration.clone(),
                        r.instructions.as_deref().unwrap_or("-").to_string(),
                    ]
                })
                .collect(),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock {
            title: l(de, "Medication (prescriptions, extract)"),
            body_lines: vec![],
            kv_pairs: vec![],
            table: Some(tbl),
        });
    }

    match appointment_repo::find_next_for_patient(pool, &patient_id).await? {
        Some(t) => {
            blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(
                l(de, "Next appointment"),
                vec![
                    format!("{}: {} {}", l(de, "Date"), t.date, t.time),
                    format!("{}: {}", l(de, "Kind"), t.kind),
                    format!("Status: {}", t.status),
                    t.notes
                        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
                        .map(|s| format!("{} {}", l(de, "Notes:"), s))
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| l(de, "(no appointment notes)")),
                ],
            ));
        }
        None => {
            blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(
                l(de, "Next appointment"),
                vec![l(de, "(no upcoming appointment booked)")],
            ));
        }
    }

    if let Some(txt) = args
        .referral_notes
        .as_ref()
        .map(|s| s.trim())
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
    {
        let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        for ln in txt.lines() {
            lines.push(if ln.is_empty() {
                " ".into()
            } else {
                ln.to_string()
            });
        }
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(l(de, "Referral / onward care"), lines));
    }

    if let Some(txt) = args
        .additional_notes
        .as_ref()
        .map(|s| s.trim())
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
    {
        let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        for ln in txt.lines() {
            lines.push(if ln.is_empty() {
                " ".into()
            } else {
                ln.to_string()
            });
        }
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(l(de, "Additional notes / aftercare"), lines));
    }

    if let Ok(Some(raw)) = app_kv_repo::get(pool, "invoice.practice.v1").await {
        if let Ok(j) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&raw) {
            let bh = j
                .get("clinician_name")
                .and_then(|version| version.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("")
                .trim();
            let professional_title = j
                .get("professional_title")
                .and_then(|version| version.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("")
                .trim();
            if !bh.is_empty() {
                let mut sig = vec![
                    String::new(),
                    "____________________________".into(),
                    bh.to_string(),
                ];
                if !professional_title.is_empty() {
                    sig.push(professional_title.to_string());
                }
                let zanr = j
                    .get("zanr")
                    .and_then(|version| version.as_str())
                    .unwrap_or("")
                    .trim();
                let bsnr = j
                    .get("bsnr")
                    .and_then(|version| version.as_str())
                    .unwrap_or("")
                    .trim();
                if !zanr.is_empty() || !bsnr.is_empty() {
                    sig.push(format!("ZANR: {zanr} · BSNR: {bsnr}"));
                }
                sig.push(stamp_label(if de { "de" } else { "en" }).into());
                blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(
                    if de { "Behandler/in / Unterschrift" } else { "Clinician / signature" },
                    sig,
                ));
            }
        }
    }

    let created_by = format!("{} ({})", session.name, session.role);
    let title = if de { "Nachsorge-Merkblatt" } else { "Discharge leaflet / aftercare" };
    let pdf_title = format!("{title} – {}", patient.name);
    let header_base = chart_header_from_app_kv(pool, &created_by, "", locale).await;
    let render = |number: &str, watermark: Option<String>| -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
        let mut blocks = blocks.clone();
        let mut header = header_base.clone();
        if let Some(h) = header.as_mut() {
            h.document_id = Some(number.to_string());
            h.watermark = watermark;
        }
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::body(
            l(de, "Note"),
            vec![
                format!("{}: {created_by}", if de { "Erstellt von" } else { "Created by" }),
                format!("{}: {number}", if de { "Dokument-Nr." } else { "Document no." }),
                l(de, "This leaflet summarises data from the practice software and does not replace medical advice."),
                l(de, "Please bring this sheet to follow-up appointments if it was given to you."),
            ],
        ));
        render_chart_blocks(title, &generated, &pdf_title, &blocks, header.as_ref())
    };

    if preview {
        let bytes = render(WATERMARK_PREVIEW, Some(WATERMARK_PREVIEW.into()))?;
        return Ok(IssuedPdf {
            document_id: None,
            document_number: None,
            sha256: crate::infrastructure::database::issued_document_repo::sha256_hex(&bytes),
            pdf_base64: base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&bytes),
            reprint: false,
        });
    }
    let payload = serde_json::json!({
        "generatedAt": generated,
        "additionalNotes": args.additional_notes,
        "referralNotes": args.referral_notes,
    });
    register_rendered(pool, session, DocKind::DischargeLeaflet, &patient_id, payload, |number| {
        render(number, None)
    })
    .await
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod export_chart_pdf_args_tests {
    use super::{ExportChartPdfArgs, ExportDischargeLeafletPdfArgs};

    #[test]
    fn deserializes_patient_id_camel_case() {
        let j = serde_json::json!({ "patientId": "p1" });
        let a: ExportChartPdfArgs = serde_json::from_value(j).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(a.patient_id, "p1");
        assert!(a.sections.patient);
    }

    #[test]
    fn deserializes_patient_id_snake_case() {
        let j = serde_json::json!({ "patient_id": "p2" });
        let a: ExportChartPdfArgs = serde_json::from_value(j).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(a.patient_id, "p2");
    }

    #[test]
    fn deserializes_sections_partial() {
        let j = serde_json::json!({
            "patientId": "p3",
            "sections": { "patient": true, "payments": false }
        });
        let a: ExportChartPdfArgs = serde_json::from_value(j).unwrap();
        assert!(a.sections.patient);
        assert!(!a.sections.payments);
        assert!(a.sections.chart_core);
    }

    #[test]
    fn discharge_args_deserializes_camel_case() {
        let j = serde_json::json!({
            "patientId": "p1",
            "additionalNotes": "Aftercare",
            "referralNotes": "CAD"
        });
        let a: ExportDischargeLeafletPdfArgs = serde_json::from_value(j).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(a.patient_id, "p1");
        assert_eq!(a.additional_notes.as_deref(), Some("Aftercare"));
        assert_eq!(a.referral_notes.as_deref(), Some("CAD"));
    }
}

//! Reception need-to-know redaction for treatment/examination lists (GAP-01 mitigation).

use crate::application::rbac::Role;
use crate::domain::entities::treatment::{Examination, Treatment};

pub fn redact_treatment_for_reception(mut b: Treatment) -> Treatment {
    b.description = None;
    b.teeth = None;
    b.material = None;
    b.notes = None;
    b
}

pub fn redact_examination_for_reception(mut u: Examination) -> Examination {
    u.chief_complaint = None;
    u.results = None;
    u.diagnosis = None;
    u
}

pub fn apply_reception_redact_treatments(role: &str, rows: Vec<Treatment>) -> Vec<Treatment> {
    match Role::parse(role) {
        Some(Role::Reception) => rows
            .into_iter()
            .map(redact_treatment_for_reception)
            .collect(),
        _ => rows,
    }
}

pub fn apply_reception_redact_examinations(role: &str, rows: Vec<Examination>) -> Vec<Examination> {
    match Role::parse(role) {
        Some(Role::Reception) => rows
            .into_iter()
            .map(redact_examination_for_reception)
            .collect(),
        _ => rows,
    }
}

//! Application orchestration for device sessions (list, investigate, revoke).
use crate::domain::entities::AuditLog;
use crate::domain::services::device_session_peer;
use crate::error::AppError;
use crate::infrastructure::database::repos::admin::audit as audit_repo;
use crate::infrastructure::database::repos::admin::device_session::{
    self, DeviceSessionAuditEntry, DeviceSessionInvestigation, DeviceSessionRow,
};
use sqlx::SqlitePool;

const INVESTIGATION_LOGIN_LIMIT: i64 = 12;

pub struct OpenDeviceSession {
    pub id: String,
    pub reused: bool,
}

/// Reuse an active session from the same IP (reconnect). Otherwise create a new row.
pub async fn open_or_reuse(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    user_id: &str,
    device_label: &str,
    user_agent: Option<&str>,
    peer_ip: &str,
) -> Result<OpenDeviceSession, AppError> {
    let peer = device_session_peer::normalize_peer_ip(peer_ip);
    if let Some(existing) = device_session::find_active_by_peer(pool, user_id, &peer).await? {
        device_session::touch_reconnect(
            pool,
            &existing,
            device_label,
            user_agent,
            Some(peer.as_str()),
        )
        .await?;
        let _ = device_session::end_other_same_peer(pool, user_id, &existing, &peer).await?;
        return Ok(OpenDeviceSession {
            id: existing,
            reused: true,
        });
    }
    let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
    device_session::insert(
        pool,
        &id,
        user_id,
        device_label,
        user_agent,
        Some(peer.as_str()),
    )
    .await?;
    Ok(OpenDeviceSession { id, reused: false })
}

pub async fn list_enriched_for_user(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    user_id: &str,
    current_id: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<Vec<DeviceSessionRow>, AppError> {
    device_session::list_active_for_user(pool, user_id, current_id).await
}

pub async fn investigate_session(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    user_id: &str,
    session_id: &str,
    current_id: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<DeviceSessionInvestigation, AppError> {
    let session = device_session::find_active_for_user_by_id(pool, user_id, session_id, current_id)
        .await?
        .ok_or_else(|| AppError::NotFound("error.entity.device_session".into()))?;

    let all = device_session::list_active_for_user(pool, user_id, current_id).await?;
    let label = session.device_label.trim();
    let same_device_label_count = if label.is_empty() {
        0
    } else {
        all.iter()
            .filter(|s| s.device_label.trim() == label)
            .count()
    };

    let audits = audit_repo::find_recent_for_user_actions(
        pool,
        user_id,
        &[
            "LOGIN",
            "LOGOUT",
            "DEVICE_SESSION_RECONNECT",
            "DEVICE_SESSION_NEW",
            "DEVICE_SESSION_REVOKE",
            "DEVICE_SESSION_INVESTIGATE",
            "DEVICE_SESSION_TRUST",
            "DEVICE_SESSION_UNTRUST",
        ],
        INVESTIGATION_LOGIN_LIMIT,
    )
    .await?;

    Ok(DeviceSessionInvestigation {
        active_session_count: all.len(),
        same_device_label_count,
        recent_logins: map_audit_entries(&audits),
        session,
    })
}

pub async fn revoke_session(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    user_id: &str,
    session_id: &str,
    current_id: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let session = device_session::find_active_for_user_by_id(pool, user_id, session_id, current_id)
        .await?
        .ok_or_else(|| AppError::NotFound("error.entity.device_session".into()))?;

    if session.is_current {
        return Err(AppError::validation_code(
            "error.device_session.cannot_revoke_current",
        ));
    }

    device_session::end(pool, session_id).await?;

    audit_repo::create(
        pool,
        user_id,
        "DEVICE_SESSION_REVOKE",
        "DeviceSession",
        Some(session_id),
        Some(&format!(
            "label={}; suspected={}",
            session.device_label, session.is_suspected
        )),
    )
    .await?;

    Ok(())
}

pub async fn set_session_trusted(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    user_id: &str,
    session_id: &str,
    current_id: Option<&str>,
    trusted: bool,
) -> Result<DeviceSessionRow, AppError> {
    let existing =
        device_session::find_active_for_user_by_id(pool, user_id, session_id, current_id)
            .await?
            .ok_or_else(|| AppError::NotFound("error.entity.device_session".into()))?;

    if existing.is_current {
        return Err(AppError::validation_code(
            "error.device_session.current_already_trusted",
        ));
    }

    let updated = device_session::set_trusted(pool, user_id, session_id, trusted).await?;
    if !updated {
        return Err(AppError::NotFound("error.entity.device_session".into()));
    }

    audit_repo::create(
        pool,
        user_id,
        if trusted {
            "DEVICE_SESSION_TRUST"
        } else {
            "DEVICE_SESSION_UNTRUST"
        },
        "DeviceSession",
        Some(session_id),
        Some(&format!("label={}", existing.device_label)),
    )
    .await?;

    device_session::find_active_for_user_by_id(pool, user_id, session_id, current_id)
        .await?
        .ok_or_else(|| AppError::NotFound("error.entity.device_session".into()))
}

fn map_audit_entries(rows: &[AuditLog]) -> Vec<DeviceSessionAuditEntry> {
    rows.iter()
        .map(|r| DeviceSessionAuditEntry {
            id: r.id.clone(),
            action: r.action.clone(),
            created_at: r.created_at.format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").to_string(),
            details: r.details.clone(),
        })
        .collect()
}

FILE: crates/shared/medoc-core/src/application/documents/cash_book.rs

//! Cash book and day close (Kassenbuch / Tagesabschluss).
//!
//! All figures are computed here from the cash journal (`payment_receipt`)
//! and the cash movements; the client only supplies what a person counted.
//!
//! Rules (GoBD Rz. 111 ff., AEAO zu § 146 AO):
//! * cash is recorded daily; a closing covers every journal line not yet
//!   closed up to its date (late entries roll into the next closing),
//! * Soll-Bestand = Anfangsbestand + Bareinnahmen ± Einlagen/Entnahmen,
//!   Anfangsbestand = counted cash of the previous closing,
//! * a counted amount is mandatory; a difference needs a written reason,
//! * a closing is final. Mistakes are fixed by a correction protocol that
//!   references the original; nothing is edited or deleted,
//! * each closing issues a numbered Kassenbericht (TB-YYYY-nnnnnn).

use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use base64::{engine::general_purpose::STANDARD, Engine as _};
use chrono::{Local, NaiveDate};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sqlx::{SqliteConnection, SqlitePool};

use super::finance_schema;
use super::issue::{
    after_insert, now_iso, require_permission, year_now, DocKind, IssuedPdf, WATERMARK_COPY,
};
