// GDPR (DSGVO) compliance helpers (NFA-EU-01).
//
// - export_patient: collects **all data** linked to a patient (full rows, not
//   ids), the access log and issued documents, as one JSON document
//   (Art. 15 — right of access, Art. 20 — data portability).
// - erase_patient: refuses while statutory retention applies (§ 630f BGB:
//   10 years after treatment; § 147 AO: 10 years for invoices/payments —
//   Art. 17 Abs. 3 lit. b DSGVO). After that it pseudonymises the patient
//   and deletes related medical records, backups and log references.

use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::{json, Map, Value};
use sqlx::sqlite::SqliteRow;
use sqlx::{Column, Row, SqlitePool, TypeInfo, ValueRef};
use std::path::Path;

use crate::error::AppError;
use crate::infrastructure::database::patient_repo;
use crate::infrastructure::database::{db_key, sqlcipher};
use crate::infrastructure::{backup, logging::sanitizer};
use crate::log_system;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ErasureReport {
    pub patient_id: String,
    pub anonymised_at: String,
    pub deleted_records: u64,
    pub backups_redacted: u32,
    pub log_files_redacted: u32,
}

/// Tuple representing the patient row queried for the DSGVO export.
type PatientRow = (
    String,
    String,
    String,
    String,
    String,
    Option<String>,
    Option<String>,
    Option<String>,
    String,
);

/// Collect every row that references the patient and return a single JSON
/// document. Returns an `Err` with `NotFound` if the patient does not exist.
pub async fn export_patient(pool: &SqlitePool, patient_id: &str) -> Result<Value, AppError> {
    let patient: Option<PatientRow> = sqlx::query_as(
        "SELECT id, name, date_of_birth, sex, insurance_number,
                    phone, email, address, status
             FROM patient WHERE id = ?1",
    )
    .bind(patient_id)
    .fetch_optional(pool)
    .await?;
    let p = patient.ok_or(AppError::NotFound("Patient".into()))?;

    let related = collect_related(pool, patient_id).await?;
    let access_log = crate::infrastructure::database::audit_repo::find_for_patient_entity(
        pool, patient_id, 100_000,
    )
    .await?;
    let issued_documents =
        crate::infrastructure::database::issued_document_repo::list_for_patient(pool, patient_id)
            .await
            .unwrap_or_default();

    log_system!(info, event = "DSGVO_EXPORT", patient_id = %patient_id);

    Ok(json!({
        "exported_at": chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
        "schema_version": 3,
        "legal_basis": "Art. 15 und Art. 20 DSGVO",
        "access_log": access_log,
        "issued_documents": issued_documents,
        "patient": {
            "id": p.0, "name": p.1, "date_of_birth": p.2, "sex": p.3,
            "insurance_number": p.4, "phone": p.5, "email": p.6,
            "address": p.7, "status": p.8,
        },
        "related": related,
    }))
}

/// Pseudonymise + erase a patient's medical data while keeping an anonymised
/// stub row so foreign-key audit trails remain valid.
pub async fn erase_patient(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    patient_id: &str,
    app_data_dir: &Path,
) -> Result<ErasureReport, AppError> {
    if let Some(until) = retention_until(pool, patient_id).await? {
        return Err(AppError::validation_code_params(
            "error.gdpr.retention_active",
            &[("until", until)],
        ));
    }
    let (deleted, chart_ids) = erase_patient_records(pool, patient_id).await?;

    for (aid,) in chart_ids {
        crate::infrastructure::database::chart_attachment_repo::remove_storage_dir_best_effort(
            app_data_dir,
            &aid,
        );
    }

    let backups_redacted = redact_patient_from_all_backups(app_data_dir, patient_id).await?;
    let log_files_redacted = sanitizer::redact_patient_id_in_logs(patient_id)?
        .redacted_files
        .len() as u32;

    log_system!(warn,
        event = "DSGVO_ERASURE",
        patient_id = %patient_id,
        deleted_records = deleted,
        backups_redacted = backups_redacted,
        log_files_redacted = log_files_redacted,
    );

    Ok(ErasureReport {
        patient_id: patient_id.to_string(),
        anonymised_at: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
        deleted_records: deleted,
        backups_redacted,
        log_files_redacted,
    })
}

/// DB-only erasure (used for live DB and SQLCipher backup snapshots).
pub async fn erase_patient_records(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    patient_id: &str,
) -> Result<(u64, Vec<(String,)>), AppError> {
    let chart_ids: Vec<(String,)> =
        sqlx::query_as("SELECT id FROM patient_chart WHERE patient_id = ?1")
            .bind(patient_id)
            .fetch_all(pool)
            .await?;

    let mut deleted: u64 = 0;
    let mut tx = pool.begin().await?;

    let exists: Option<(String,)> = sqlx::query_as("SELECT id FROM patient WHERE id = ?1")
        .bind(patient_id)
        .fetch_optional(&mut *tx)
        .await?;
    if exists.is_none() {
        tx.rollback().await?;
        return Err(AppError::NotFound("Patient".into()));
    }

    deleted += patient_repo::delete_dependents(&mut tx, patient_id, true).await?;

    let pseudo_name = format!("Anonymisiert ({patient_id})");
    let pseudo_vnr = format!("ANON-{patient_id}");

    let n = sqlx::query(
        "UPDATE patient SET
            name = ?1,
            date_of_birth = '1900-01-01',
            sex = 'DIVERSE',
            insurance_number = ?2,
            phone = NULL,
            email = NULL,
            address = NULL,
            status = 'READONLY',
            updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
         WHERE id = ?3",
    )
    .bind(&pseudo_name)
    .bind(&pseudo_vnr)
    .bind(patient_id)
    .execute(&mut *tx)
    .await?
    .rows_affected();

    if n == 0 {
        tx.rollback().await?;
        return Err(AppError::Internal(
            "Patient was not updated after check".into(),
        ));
    }
    // F119: the pseudonymised row must replace the original on every device.
    crate::infrastructure::database::recorded_write::record_in_tx(&mut tx, "patient", patient_id, "UPDATE")
        .await?;

    tx.commit().await?;
    Ok((deleted, chart_ids))
}

/// Apply patient erasure to every SQLCipher backup that still contains `patient_id`.
async fn redact_patient_from_all_backups(
    app_data_dir: &Path,
    patient_id: &str,
) -> Result<u32, AppError> {
    let key = db_key::ensure_sqlcipher_key(app_data_dir, false)?;
    let mut redacted = 0u32;
    for entry in backup::list()? {
        let path = entry.path;
        let Ok(pool) = sqlcipher::open_encrypted_pool(&path, key.clone(), false).await else {
            log_system!(warn,
                event = "BACKUP_REDACT_SKIP",
                path = %path.display(),
                reason = "not_sqlcipher_or_wrong_key",
            );
            continue;
        };
        let present = sqlx::query_scalar::<_, i32>("SELECT 1 FROM patient WHERE id = ?1")
            .bind(patient_id)
            .fetch_optional(&pool)
            .await?
            .is_some();
        if present {
            erase_patient_records(&pool, patient_id).await?;
            pool.close().await;
            backup::sign_file(&path)?;
            redacted += 1;
            log_system!(info,
                event = "BACKUP_REDACT_OK",
                path = %path.display(),
                patient_id = %patient_id,
            );
        } else {
            pool.close().await;
        }
    }
    Ok(redacted)
}

/// Statutory retention (§ 630f Abs. 3 BGB, § 147 AO): 10 years after the end
/// of the year of the last treatment / payment / issued document.
/// Returns the date (YYYY-12-31) until which erasure is blocked, if any.
pub async fn retention_until(pool: &SqlitePool, patient_id: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, AppError> {
    let last: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT MAX(d) FROM (
            SELECT MAX(CAST(t.created_at AS TEXT)) AS d FROM treatment t
              JOIN patient_chart c ON c.id = t.chart_id WHERE c.patient_id = ?1
            UNION ALL SELECT MAX(CAST(e.created_at AS TEXT)) FROM examination e
              JOIN patient_chart c ON c.id = e.chart_id WHERE c.patient_id = ?1
            UNION ALL SELECT MAX(CAST(created_at AS TEXT)) FROM payment WHERE patient_id = ?1
            UNION ALL SELECT MAX(CAST(created_at AS TEXT)) FROM prescription WHERE patient_id = ?1
            UNION ALL SELECT MAX(CAST(created_at AS TEXT)) FROM certificate WHERE patient_id = ?1
            UNION ALL SELECT MAX(issued_at) FROM issued_document WHERE patient_id = ?1
         )",
    )
    .bind(patient_id)
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await
    .unwrap_or(None);
    let Some(last) = last.filter(|s| s.len() >= 4) else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let year: i32 = last[..4].parse().unwrap_or(0);
    let until_year = year + 10;
    let now_year = chrono::Local::now().format("%Y").to_string().parse::<i32>().unwrap_or(0);
    if now_year <= until_year {
        Ok(Some(format!("{until_year}-12-31")))
    } else {
        Ok(None)
    }
}

/// Converts any SQLite row into a JSON object (column → value).
fn row_to_json(row: &SqliteRow) -> Value {
    use base64::Engine;
    let mut m = Map::new();
    for col in row.columns() {
        let i = col.ordinal();
        let raw = match row.try_get_raw(i) {
            Ok(r) => r,
            Err(_) => continue,
        };
        let v = if raw.is_null() {
            Value::Null
        } else {
            match raw.type_info().name() {
                "INTEGER" | "INT" | "INT8" | "BIGINT" | "BOOLEAN" => {
                    row.try_get::<i64, _>(i).map(Value::from).unwrap_or(Value::Null)
                }
                "REAL" | "FLOAT" | "DOUBLE" | "NUMERIC" => {
                    row.try_get::<f64, _>(i).map(Value::from).unwrap_or(Value::Null)
                }
                "BLOB" => row
                    .try_get::<Vec<u8>, _>(i)
                    .map(|b| Value::String(base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(b)))
                    .unwrap_or(Value::Null),
                _ => row.try_get::<String, _>(i).map(Value::String).unwrap_or(Value::Null),
            }
        };
        m.insert(col.name().to_string(), v);
    }
    Value::Object(m)
}

async fn rows(pool: &SqlitePool, sql: &str, patient_id: &str) -> Result<Value, AppError> {
    let rows = sqlx::query(sql).bind(patient_id).fetch_all(pool).await?;
    Ok(Value::Array(rows.iter().map(row_to_json).collect()))
}

async fn collect_related(pool: &SqlitePool, patient_id: &str) -> Result<Value, AppError> {
    const CHART: &str = "(SELECT id FROM patient_chart WHERE patient_id = ?1)";
    let queries: Vec<(&str, String)> = vec![
        ("patient_chart", "SELECT * FROM patient_chart WHERE patient_id = ?1".into()),
        ("anamnesis_form", "SELECT * FROM anamnesis_form WHERE patient_id = ?1".into()),
        ("dental_findings", format!("SELECT * FROM dental_finding WHERE chart_id IN {CHART}")),
        ("examinations", format!("SELECT * FROM examination WHERE chart_id IN {CHART}")),
        ("treatments", format!("SELECT * FROM treatment WHERE chart_id IN {CHART}")),
        ("prescriptions", "SELECT * FROM prescription WHERE patient_id = ?1".into()),
        ("certificates", "SELECT * FROM certificate WHERE patient_id = ?1".into()),
        ("appointments", "SELECT * FROM appointment WHERE patient_id = ?1".into()),
        ("payments", "SELECT * FROM payment WHERE patient_id = ?1".into()),
        (
            // Metadata only; the files themselves are added by the ZIP export.
            "chart_attachments",
            format!(
                "SELECT id, chart_id, display_name, mime_type, size_bytes, created_at \
                 FROM chart_attachment WHERE chart_id IN {CHART}"
            ),
        ),
    ];
    let mut out = Map::new();
    for (key, sql) in queries {
        out.insert(key.to_string(), rows(pool, &sql, patient_id).await?);
    }
    Ok(Value::Object(out))
}

// CSV-based patient import (FA-MIG-01).
//
// Format expected (header row mandatory, semicolon delimiter).
// English headers only:
//
//   name;date_of_birth;sex;insurance_number;phone;email;address
//
// `date_of_birth` is parsed as `YYYY-MM-DD` or `DD.MM.YYYY`.
// `sex` accepts M/F/W/D (case-insensitive) and is normalised to MALE/FEMALE/DIVERSE.

use chrono::NaiveDate;
use serde::Serialize;
use sqlx::SqlitePool;
use std::path::Path;

use crate::error::AppError;
use crate::log_migration;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Default)]
pub struct ImportReport {
    pub source: String,
    pub total_rows: u64,
    pub imported: u64,
    pub skipped: u64,
    pub failed: u64,
    pub errors: Vec<String>,
}

pub async fn import_patients(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    csv_path: &Path,
    dry_run: bool,
) -> Result<ImportReport, AppError> {
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(csv_path)
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Internal(format!("Cannot read CSV: {e}")))?;

    let mut report = ImportReport {
        source: csv_path.display().to_string(),
        ..Default::default()
    };

    log_migration!(info, event = "IMPORT_START", source = %report.source, dry_run);

    let mut lines = content.lines();
    let header = lines.next().unwrap_or("");
    let cols: Vec<&str> = header.split(';').map(|s| s.trim()).collect();
    let col = |english: &str| cols.iter().position(|c| *c == english);
    if col("name").is_none() || col("date_of_birth").is_none() {
        return Err(AppError::Validation(
            "CSV header must contain at least 'name' and 'date_of_birth'".into(),
        ));
    }

    for (lineno, raw) in lines.enumerate() {
        let lineno = lineno + 2; // +1 for header, +1 for 1-based
        if raw.trim().is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        report.total_rows += 1;
        // Quoted fields (RFC 4180) and the export's formula guard (`'+49…`)
        // must round-trip; a plain `split(';')` broke both.
        let fields: Vec<String> = split_semicolon_csv(raw);
        let get = |english: &str| -> Option<String> {
            col(english)
                .and_then(|i| fields.get(i))
                .map(|s| unguard_csv_cell(s.trim()).to_string())
                .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        };

        let name = match get("name") {
            Some(n) => n,
            None => {
                report.failed += 1;
                report.errors.push(format!("Row {lineno}: name missing"));
                continue;
            }
        };
        let dob_raw = match get("date_of_birth") {
            Some(g) => g,
            None => {
                report.failed += 1;
                report
                    .errors
                    .push(format!("Row {lineno}: date_of_birth missing"));
                continue;
            }
        };
        let dob = parse_date(&dob_raw);
        let dob = match dob {
            Some(d) => d,
            None => {
                report.failed += 1;
                report
                    .errors
                    .push(format!("Row {lineno}: invalid date '{dob_raw}'"));
                continue;
            }
        };
        let sex = normalise_sex(get("sex").as_deref().unwrap_or("D"));
        let vnr = get("insurance_number").unwrap_or_else(|| format!("UNKNOWN-{lineno}"));
        let phone = get("phone");
        let email = get("email");
        let address = get("address");

        if dry_run {
            report.imported += 1;
            continue;
        }

        let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let res = sqlx::query(
            "INSERT INTO patient (id, name, date_of_birth, sex,
                insurance_number, phone, email, address, status)
             VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8, 'ACTIVE')",
        )
        .bind(&id)
        .bind(&name)
        .bind(dob)
        .bind(sex)
        .bind(&vnr)
        .bind(&phone)
        .bind(&email)
        .bind(&address)
        .execute(pool)
        .await;

        match res {
            Ok(_) => report.imported += 1,
            Err(sqlx::Error::Database(db)) if db.is_unique_violation() => {
                report.skipped += 1;
                log_migration!(warn, event = "IMPORT_DUPLICATE", line = lineno, name = %name);
            }
            Err(e) => {
                report.failed += 1;
                report.errors.push(format!("Row {lineno}: DB error: {e}"));
            }
        }
    }

    log_migration!(info,
        event = "IMPORT_COMPLETE",
        source = %report.source,
        imported = report.imported,
        skipped = report.skipped,
        failed = report.failed,
    );

    Ok(report)
}

/// Split one `;`-separated line, honouring `"…"` quoting and `""` escapes.
fn split_semicolon_csv(line: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut cur = String::new();
    let mut in_q = false;
    let mut chars = line.chars().peekable();
    while let Some(c) = chars.next() {
        match (c, in_q) {
            ('"', true) if chars.peek() == Some(&'"') => {
                cur.push('"');
                chars.next();
            }
            ('"', true) => in_q = false,
            ('"', false) if cur.is_empty() => in_q = true,
            (';', false) => out.push(std::mem::take(&mut cur)),
            (other, _) => cur.push(other),
        }
    }
    out.push(cur);
    out
}

/// Undo the export's formula-injection guard (`'=…`, `'+49…`).
fn unguard_csv_cell(s: &str) -> &str {
    match s.strip_prefix('\'') {
        Some(rest) if rest.starts_with(['=', '+', '-', '@']) => rest,
        _ => s,
    }
}

fn parse_date(s: &str) -> Option<NaiveDate> {
    NaiveDate::parse_from_str(s, "%Y-%m-%d")
        .or_else(|_| NaiveDate::parse_from_str(s, "%d.%m.%Y"))
        .ok()
}

fn normalise_sex(s: &str) -> &'static str {
    match s.trim().to_uppercase().as_str() {
        "M" | "MALE" => "MALE",
        "W" | "F" | "FEMALE" => "FEMALE",
        _ => "DIVERSE",
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod csv_split_tests {
    use super::{split_semicolon_csv, unguard_csv_cell};

    #[test]
    fn quoted_fields_and_guard_round_trip() {
        let f = split_semicolon_csv("\"Muster; Max\";1990-01-01;'+49 30 123;\"a \"\"b\"\"\"");
        assert_eq!(f, vec!["Muster; Max", "1990-01-01", "'+49 30 123", "a \"b\""]);
        assert_eq!(unguard_csv_cell(&f[2]), "+49 30 123");
        assert_eq!(unguard_csv_cell("'Text"), "'Text");
    }
}

//! Clinical document PDFs — certificate, prescription, receipt.
//!
//! These renderers use the shared [`super::core`] / [`super::letterhead`]
//! layout system so all MeDoc PDFs (invoice, record, certificate, prescription,
//! receipt) have **identical margins, fonts, encoding, and page numbers**.
//!
//! Each document type has its own render function that interprets the shared
//! [`ClinicalPdfLayout`] input schema.
//!
//! Input = structured JSON (generated by the frontend).
//! Output = PDF bytes with DIN-5008 letterhead, signature block, and
//! privacy notice at the foot.

use crate::error::AppError;
use serde::Deserialize;

use super::core::{
    emit_multipage_pdf_with_images, emit_pdf_document, pdf_locale, table_row_height, wrap_soft,
    wrap_text, PageBuilder, PdfDocMeta, CONTENT_WIDTH, M_BOTTOM, M_LEFT, M_RIGHT,
};
use super::metrics::wrap_to_width;
use super::letterhead::{
    emit_continuation_header_locale, emit_letterhead, emit_signature_block, stamp_label,
    Letterhead, MetaRow,
};
use super::logo::PdfLogo;

// ===========================================================================
// Input schemas
// ===========================================================================

/// A "label: value" row (e.g. "Vers.-Nr.: A123…").
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct LabelValue {
    pub label: String,
    pub value: String,
    /// Medical content (diagnosis, ICD-10, findings). Removed from copies
    /// that go to third parties (AU employer copy).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub confidential: bool,
    /// Marks the grand-total row (bold, ruled) — replaces label sniffing.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub total: bool,
}

/// Column layout for tables.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum TableColumnLayout {
    /// Receipt: date (wide), description (wide), amount (narrow right).
    Receipt,
    /// Prescription (single): med · strength · dose · duration · PZN
    Prescription,
    /// Prescription (combo): pos · med · dose · duration · notes
    PrescriptionCombo,
    /// Even distribution (default).
    #[default]
    Even,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct PdfTableSpec {
    pub title: Option<String>,
    pub headers: Vec<String>,
    pub rows: Vec<Vec<String>>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub column_layout: TableColumnLayout,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct DetailRecord {
    pub kind: String,
    pub period: String,
    pub details: Vec<String>,
}

/// Two-column box (e.g. patient data left + insurance right).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct TwoColumnBlock {
    pub left_title: Option<String>,
    pub left_lines: Vec<String>,
    pub right_title: Option<String>,
    pub right_lines: Vec<String>,
}

/// Full input for a clinical document rendering call.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ClinicalPdfLayout {
    /// "certificate" | "prescription" | "receipt" | otherwise default
    pub kind: String,

    /// Practice letterhead (line 1 bold = name).
    pub practice_lines: Vec<String>,

    /// Right column at top — only when `meta_lines` is empty.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub header_right_lines: Vec<String>,

    /// Structured meta block (invoice no., date, …).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub meta_lines: Vec<LabelValue>,

    /// Address field (recipient).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub address_lines: Vec<String>,

    pub document_title: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub document_subtitle: Option<String>,

    /// Introductory paragraphs.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub intro_paragraphs: Vec<String>,

    /// Structured fields ("Label: Value" — compact single-line when possible).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub label_value_rows: Vec<LabelValue>,

    /// Patient panel (patient left, insurance right, etc.).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub two_column: Option<TwoColumnBlock>,

    #[serde(default)]
    pub tables: Vec<PdfTableSpec>,

    /// Detail blocks (e.g. sick-leave period per diagnosis).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub detail_records: Vec<DetailRecord>,

    /// Totals rows (for receipt / invoice).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub totals: Vec<LabelValue>,

    /// Closing paragraphs (e.g. notices, instructions).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub closing_paragraphs: Vec<String>,

    /// Signature block — line 1 = name, then professional title, ZANR, BSNR.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub signature_lines: Vec<String>,

    /// Footer right (issue date, place).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub footer_meta_lines: Vec<LabelValue>,

    /// Provider professional title for the default signature block.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub clinician_professional_title: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub clinician_zanr: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub clinician_bsnr: Option<String>,

    /// Practice logo from Settings (`practice.logo.v1`) — `{mime,data}` base64.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub logo_kv_json: Option<String>,

    /// UI locale (`en`|`de`|`fr`|`ar`) for chrome + page numbers.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub locale: Option<String>,

    /// When true (Arabic), logo is placed top-right.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub rtl: bool,

    /// Which copy is rendered: `patient` (default) | `employer` | `insurer`.
    /// `employer` strips every `confidential` row and all detail records.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub copy_variant: Option<String>,

    /// Registry number printed in the information block (set by the backend).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub document_number: Option<String>,

    /// Diagonal watermark ("ENTWURF" for previews, "KOPIE" for reprints).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub watermark: Option<String>,

    /// DIN footer lines (tax, bank, chamber) — set by the backend.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub footer_lines: Vec<String>,
}

impl ClinicalPdfLayout {
    /// Copy of the layout with confidential rows removed when the copy goes
    /// to a third party (AU-Richtlinie: employer copy without diagnosis).
    pub fn for_copy_variant(&self) -> ClinicalPdfLayout {
        let mut out = self.clone();
        let employer = matches!(out.copy_variant.as_deref(), Some("employer"));
        if employer {
            out.label_value_rows.retain(|r| !r.confidential);
            out.meta_lines.retain(|r| !r.confidential);
            out.footer_meta_lines.retain(|r| !r.confidential);
            out.detail_records.clear();
            out.intro_paragraphs.retain(|p| !p.contains("ICD"));
        }
        out
    }

    fn copy_variant_label(&self, locale: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
        let de = pdf_locale(locale) == "de";
        match self.copy_variant.as_deref() {
            Some("employer") => Some(if de {
                "Ausfertigung zur Vorlage beim Arbeitgeber"
            } else {
                "Copy for the employer"
            }),
            Some("insurer") => Some(if de {
                "Ausfertigung zur Vorlage bei der Krankenkasse"
            } else {
                "Copy for the health insurer"
            }),
            Some("patient") => Some(if de {
                "Ausfertigung für die versicherte Person"
            } else {
                "Copy for the patient"
            }),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}

// ===========================================================================
// Column layouts per document type
// ===========================================================================

/// Return X start positions per column for a given layout.
fn table_column_xs(layout: TableColumnLayout, ncol: usize) -> Vec<i32> {
    let ncol = ncol.max(1);
    match layout {
        // Date · Item (receipt no.) · Description — balanced for QU-… numbers
        TableColumnLayout::Receipt if ncol >= 3 => {
            vec![M_LEFT, M_LEFT + 88, M_LEFT + 250]
        }
        TableColumnLayout::Prescription if ncol >= 5 => vec![
            M_LEFT,
            M_LEFT + 130,
            M_LEFT + 220,
            M_LEFT + 295,
            M_LEFT + 365,
        ],
        TableColumnLayout::PrescriptionCombo if ncol >= 5 => vec![
            M_LEFT,
            M_LEFT + 38,
            M_LEFT + 170,
            M_LEFT + 290,
            M_LEFT + 365,
        ],
        _ => {
            let step = CONTENT_WIDTH / ncol as i32;
            (0..ncol).map(|i| M_LEFT + i as i32 * step).collect()
        }
    }
}

/// Usable width (pt) per column from the X positions (minus cell padding).
/// True when every non-empty cell of the column is a money/number value
/// ("120,00 EUR", "-12,94", "1.234,50 €"). Such columns are right-aligned
/// so decimal places line up, as on any accounting document.
fn is_amount_column(table: &PdfTableSpec, ci: usize) -> bool {
    let mut any = false;
    for row in &table.rows {
        let cell = row.get(ci).map(|s| s.trim()).unwrap_or("");
        if cell.is_empty() || cell == "—" || cell == "-" {
            continue;
        }
        let core = cell
            .trim_end_matches("EUR")
            .trim_end_matches('€')
            .trim();
        // Needs a currency or a decimal comma, so dates ("02.11.2026") and
        // fee numbers ("0010") stay left-aligned.
        let money_hint = core.len() != cell.len()
            || core.rsplit_once(',').is_some_and(|(_, d)| d.len() == 2);
        let ok = money_hint
            && core.chars().any(|c| c.is_ascii_digit())
            && core
                .chars()
                .all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit() || matches!(c, '.' | ',' | '-' | '+' | ' ' | '\u{a0}'));
        if !ok {
            return false;
        }
        any = true;
    }
    any
}

/// Draw one cell, right-aligned inside the column for amount columns.
fn draw_cell(pb: &mut PageBuilder, x: i32, width: i32, size: i32, bold: bool, s: &str, right: bool) {
    if right {
        pb.text_right(x + TABLE_CELL_PAD + width, size, bold, s);
    } else {
        pb.text(x + TABLE_CELL_PAD, size, bold, s);
    }
}

fn column_pt_widths(xs: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32> {
    let mut w = Vec::with_capacity(xs.len());
    for i in 0..xs.len() {
        let next = xs.get(i + 1).copied().unwrap_or(M_RIGHT);
        w.push((next - xs[i] - 2 * TABLE_CELL_PAD).max(20));
    }
    w
}

// ===========================================================================
// Render function
// ===========================================================================

/// `LabelValue` → `MetaRow` conversion for the letterhead.
fn to_meta_rows(items: &[LabelValue]) -> Vec<MetaRow> {
    items
        .iter()
        .map(|x| MetaRow::new(&x.label, &x.value))
        .collect()
}

/// Main entry: render a clinical PDF.
pub fn render_clinical_layout(doc: &ClinicalPdfLayout) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    render_clinical_layout_with_logo(doc, None)
}

/// Same as [`render_clinical_layout`], with an optional pre-loaded logo
/// (e.g. from `app_kv` when the layout JSON has no `logoKvJson`).
pub fn render_clinical_layout_with_logo(
    doc: &ClinicalPdfLayout,
    logo_override: Option<&PdfLogo>,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    let variant = doc.for_copy_variant();
    let doc = &variant;
    let owned_logo = doc.logo_kv_json.as_deref().and_then(PdfLogo::from_kv_json);
    let logo = logo_override.or(owned_logo.as_ref());
    let locale = pdf_locale(doc.locale.as_deref().unwrap_or("de"));

    let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
    pb.locale = locale;
    pb.watermark = doc.watermark.clone().filter(|w| !w.trim().is_empty());
    pb.footer_lines = doc.footer_lines.clone();
    pb.set_continuation(
        doc.practice_lines.first().map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("MeDoc"),
        &doc.document_title,
        locale,
    );

    match doc.kind.as_str() {
        "certificate" => render_certificate(&mut pb, doc, logo, locale),
        "prescription" => render_prescription(&mut pb, doc, logo, locale),
        "receipt" => render_receipt(&mut pb, doc, logo, locale),
        _ => render_generic(&mut pb, doc, logo, locale),
    }

    emit_clinical_privacy_footer(&mut pb, &doc.kind, locale);

    let pages = pb.finish();
    let images: Vec<PdfLogo> = logo.cloned().into_iter().collect();
    emit_pdf_document(
        &pages,
        &PdfDocMeta {
            title: match doc.document_number.as_deref() {
                Some(n) => format!("{} {n}", doc.document_title),
                None => doc.document_title.clone(),
            },
            subject: doc.document_number.clone(),
            author: doc.practice_lines.first().cloned(),
            locale: locale.to_string(),
        },
        &images,
    )
}

/// Information-block rows incl. the registry number (if issued).
fn meta_rows_with_number(doc: &ClinicalPdfLayout, locale: &str) -> Vec<MetaRow> {
    let mut rows = to_meta_rows(&doc.meta_lines);
    if let Some(n) = doc.document_number.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        let label = if pdf_locale(locale) == "de" { "Dokument-Nr." } else { "Document no." };
        if !rows.iter().any(|r| r.value == n) {
            rows.insert(0, MetaRow::new(label, n));
        }
    }
    rows
}

/// Prints the copy-variant line ("Ausfertigung zur Vorlage beim Arbeitgeber").
fn emit_copy_variant_line(pb: &mut PageBuilder, doc: &ClinicalPdfLayout, locale: &str) {
    if let Some(label) = doc.copy_variant_label(locale) {
        pb.text_center(9, true, label);
        pb.advance(14);
    }
}

fn clinical_letterhead<'a>(
    doc: &'a ClinicalPdfLayout,
    meta: &'a [MetaRow],
    logo: Option<&'a PdfLogo>,
    locale: &'a str,
) -> Letterhead<'a> {
    Letterhead {
        practice_lines: &doc.practice_lines,
        meta_rows: meta,
        address_lines: &doc.address_lines,
        header_right_lines: &doc.header_right_lines,
        show_sender_hint: !doc.address_lines.is_empty(),
        compact_address: doc.kind == "receipt",
        logo,
        rtl: doc.rtl,
        locale,
    }
}

/// Plain preview when the frontend sends `bodyLines` only (no `layoutJson`).
/// Uses the same letterhead + footer stack as structured clinical exports.
pub fn render_plain_preview(
    kind: &str,
    template_name: &str,
    footer: &str,
    body_pt: i32,
    body_lines: &[String],
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    let fs = body_pt.clamp(8, 18);
    let wrap_cols = 86usize.saturating_sub((18 - fs) as usize * 2);

    let cleaned: Vec<String> = body_lines
        .iter()
        .map(|l| crate::infrastructure::clinical_text_format::plain_text_for_pdf(l))
        .collect();

    let practice_lines: Vec<String> = cleaned
        .first()
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
        .map(|s| vec![s.clone()])
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let body_start = if practice_lines.is_empty() { 0 } else { 1 };

    let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
    let lh = Letterhead {
        practice_lines: &practice_lines,
        meta_rows: &[],
        address_lines: &[],
        header_right_lines: &[],
        show_sender_hint: false,
        compact_address: false,
        logo: None,
        rtl: false,
        locale: "de",
    };
    emit_letterhead(&mut pb, &lh);

    pb.text(M_LEFT, 14, true, template_name);
    pb.advance(18);
    pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, false, &format!("Dokumentart: {kind}"));
    pb.advance(14);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(16);

    for raw in &cleaned[body_start..] {
        if raw.trim().is_empty() {
            pb.advance(fs / 2);
            continue;
        }
        pb.paragraph(raw, fs, wrap_cols, 0);
    }

    if !footer.trim().is_empty() {
        pb.advance(8);
        pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
        pb.advance(10);
        for chunk in wrap_soft(footer.trim(), wrap_cols) {
            pb.text(M_LEFT, 8, false, &chunk);
            pb.advance(11);
        }
    }

    emit_clinical_privacy_footer(&mut pb, kind, "de");

    // This path renders free text without a registry entry → never official.
    pb.watermark = Some("ENTWURF".into());
    let pages = pb.finish();
    emit_multipage_pdf_with_images(&pages, &format!("Vorschau {template_name}"), &[], "de")
}

fn emit_clinical_privacy_footer(pb: &mut PageBuilder, _kind: &str, locale: &str) {
    // Receipts name the patient and the treatment, so they carry the notice too.
    let notice = match pdf_locale(locale) {
        "de" => "Vertrauliche Patientendaten gem. § 630f BGB / Art. 9 DSGVO. Weitergabe nur an berechtigte Personen.",
        "fr" => "Données patient confidentielles (art. 9 RGPD). Divulgation uniquement aux personnes autorisées.",
        _ => "Confidential patient data pursuant to § 630f BGB / Art. 9 GDPR. Disclosure only to authorized parties.",
    };
    pb.ensure_space(40);
    pb.advance(12);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(10);
    pb.text(M_LEFT, 7, false, notice);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CERTIFICATE  (Form-1 style)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn render_certificate(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    doc: &ClinicalPdfLayout,
    logo: Option<&PdfLogo>,
    locale: &str,
) {
    // Letterhead — certificates usually go to the patient directly, so
    // address_lines apply
    let meta_rows = meta_rows_with_number(doc, locale);
    let lh = clinical_letterhead(doc, &meta_rows, logo, locale);
    emit_letterhead(pb, &lh);

    // Centered title
    pb.text_center(17, true, &doc.document_title);
    pb.advance(22);
    if let Some(sub) = doc
        .document_subtitle
        .as_deref()
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
    {
        pb.text_center(10, false, sub);
        pb.advance(14);
    }

    emit_copy_variant_line(pb, doc, locale);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT + 100, M_RIGHT - 100);
    pb.advance(16);

    if let Some(ref tc) = doc.two_column {
        emit_two_column_panel(pb, tc);
    }
    render_intro(pb, &doc.intro_paragraphs);
    emit_label_value_rows(pb, &doc.label_value_rows);

    for table in &doc.tables {
        emit_table(
            pb,
            table,
            (
                doc.practice_lines
                    .first()
                    .map(|s| s.as_str())
                    .unwrap_or("MeDoc"),
                &doc.document_title,
            ),
        );
    }

    emit_detail_records(pb, &doc.detail_records);

    for p in &doc.closing_paragraphs {
        if !p.trim().is_empty() {
            pb.paragraph(p, 10, 84, 0);
        }
    }

    emit_default_or_custom_signature(pb, doc);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PRESCRIPTION  (Form-16 style — private prescription)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn render_prescription(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    doc: &ClinicalPdfLayout,
    logo: Option<&PdfLogo>,
    locale: &str,
) {
    let meta_rows = meta_rows_with_number(doc, locale);
    let lh = clinical_letterhead(doc, &meta_rows, logo, locale);
    emit_letterhead(pb, &lh);

    // Large "Prescription" title on the left, optional subtitle (private / statutory / BtM)
    pb.text(M_LEFT, 18, true, &doc.document_title);
    pb.advance(22);
    if let Some(sub) = doc
        .document_subtitle
        .as_deref()
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
    {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 10, false, sub);
        pb.advance(14);
    }
    pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(18);

    // Patient panel (two columns)
    if let Some(ref tc) = doc.two_column {
        emit_two_column_panel(pb, tc);
    }

    // "Rp." (the prescribed drugs) comes first, then duration / aut idem / notes.
    if !doc.tables.is_empty() {
        pb.advance(6);
        for table in &doc.tables {
            emit_table(
                pb,
                table,
                (
                    doc.practice_lines
                        .first()
                        .map(|s| s.as_str())
                        .unwrap_or("MeDoc"),
                    &doc.document_title,
                ),
            );
        }
        pb.advance(6);
    }

    emit_label_value_rows(pb, &doc.label_value_rows);

    render_intro(pb, &doc.intro_paragraphs);

    for p in &doc.closing_paragraphs {
        if !p.trim().is_empty() {
            pb.paragraph(p, 10, 84, 0);
        }
    }

    emit_default_or_custom_signature(pb, doc);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// RECEIPT  (GoBD-compliant)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn render_receipt(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    doc: &ClinicalPdfLayout,
    logo: Option<&PdfLogo>,
    locale: &str,
) {
    let meta_rows = meta_rows_with_number(doc, locale);
    let lh = clinical_letterhead(doc, &meta_rows, logo, locale);
    emit_letterhead(pb, &lh);

    pb.text_center(15, true, &doc.document_title);
    pb.advance(18);
    if let Some(sub) = doc
        .document_subtitle
        .as_deref()
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
    {
        pb.text_center(11, false, sub);
        pb.advance(14);
    }
    pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(14);

    render_intro(pb, &doc.intro_paragraphs);
    emit_label_value_rows(pb, &doc.label_value_rows);

    let cont = (
        doc.practice_lines
            .first()
            .map(|s| s.as_str())
            .unwrap_or("MeDoc"),
        doc.document_title.as_str(),
    );
    // Service lines first, then money totals (standard receipt order).
    for table in &doc.tables {
        emit_table(pb, table, cont);
    }
    emit_receipt_totals(pb, &doc.totals);

    pb.advance(6);
    for p in &doc.closing_paragraphs {
        if !p.trim().is_empty() {
            pb.paragraph(p, 9, 90, 0);
        }
    }

    emit_default_or_custom_signature(pb, doc);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GENERIC  (fallback for unknown kind)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn render_generic(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    doc: &ClinicalPdfLayout,
    logo: Option<&PdfLogo>,
    locale: &str,
) {
    let meta_rows = meta_rows_with_number(doc, locale);
    let lh = clinical_letterhead(doc, &meta_rows, logo, locale);
    emit_letterhead(pb, &lh);

    pb.text(M_LEFT, 14, true, &doc.document_title);
    pb.advance(18);
    if let Some(sub) = doc
        .document_subtitle
        .as_deref()
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
    {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 10, false, sub);
        pb.advance(14);
    }

    render_intro(pb, &doc.intro_paragraphs);
    emit_label_value_rows(pb, &doc.label_value_rows);

    if let Some(ref tc) = doc.two_column {
        emit_two_column_panel(pb, tc);
    }

    for table in &doc.tables {
        emit_table(
            pb,
            table,
            (
                doc.practice_lines
                    .first()
                    .map(|s| s.as_str())
                    .unwrap_or("MeDoc"),
                &doc.document_title,
            ),
        );
    }

    emit_detail_records(pb, &doc.detail_records);
    emit_totals_block(pb, &doc.totals);

    for p in &doc.closing_paragraphs {
        if !p.trim().is_empty() {
            pb.paragraph(p, 10, 84, 0);
        }
    }

    emit_default_or_custom_signature(pb, doc);
}

// ===========================================================================
// Bausteine
// ===========================================================================

fn render_intro(pb: &mut PageBuilder, paragraphs: &[String]) {
    for p in paragraphs {
        if p.trim().is_empty() {
            pb.advance(6);
            continue;
        }
        // Heuristic: if the element is a colon headline
        // ("Notee:", "Diagnosis:") AND short AND no further colons
        // inside, treat it as a section title.
        let trimmed = p.trim_end();
        let is_heading = trimmed.ends_with(':')
            && trimmed.len() <= 40
            && trimmed[..trimmed.len() - 1]
                .chars()
                .filter(|c| *c == ':')
                .count()
                == 0;

        if is_heading {
            pb.ensure_space(40);
            pb.advance(6);
            pb.text(M_LEFT, 11, true, &trimmed[..trimmed.len() - 1]);
            pb.advance(14);
        } else {
            pb.paragraph(p, 10, 84, 0);
            pb.advance(3);
        }
    }
}

fn emit_label_value_rows(pb: &mut PageBuilder, rows: &[LabelValue]) {
    // Value column starts after the widest label (measured), so long German
    // labels like "Voraussichtlich bis einschließlich" never overlap the value.
    let label_col = rows
        .iter()
        .map(|r| crate::infrastructure::pdf::text_width(&format!("{}:", r.label), 9, true))
        .max()
        .unwrap_or(0)
        .clamp(130, 230)
        + 12;
    let value_pt = f64::from(CONTENT_WIDTH - label_col);
    for row in rows {
        pb.ensure_space(36);
        let multiline = row.value.contains('\n');
        let compact = !multiline
            && crate::infrastructure::pdf::text_width(row.value.trim(), 10, false) as f64 <= value_pt;

        if compact {
            pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, true, &format!("{}:", row.label));
            pb.text(M_LEFT + label_col, 10, false, row.value.trim());
            pb.advance(14);
        } else {
            pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, true, &row.label);
            pb.advance(12);
            // Multi-line values: wrap each line separately so structure
            // is preserved
            for raw in row.value.split('\n') {
                if raw.trim().is_empty() {
                    pb.advance(6);
                    continue;
                }
                for chunk in wrap_text(raw, 84) {
                    pb.ensure_space(30);
                    pb.text(M_LEFT + 4, 10, false, &chunk);
                    pb.advance(12);
                }
            }
            pb.advance(6);
        }
    }
}

fn emit_two_column_panel(pb: &mut PageBuilder, block: &TwoColumnBlock) {
    let col_pt = f64::from(CONTENT_WIDTH / 2 - 16);
    let count = |lines: &[String]| -> i32 {
        lines
            .iter()
            .map(|l| wrap_to_width(l, 9, false, col_pt).len() as i32)
            .sum()
    };
    let rows = count(&block.left_lines).max(count(&block.right_lines)).max(1);
    // Title band + rows + padding — the box grows with its content.
    let panel_h = 30 + rows * 11;
    pb.ensure_space(panel_h + 30);
    let panel_bottom = pb.y - panel_h + 4;
    let title_band_y = pb.y - 12;

    // Rahmen
    pb.stroke_rect(M_LEFT, panel_bottom, CONTENT_WIDTH, panel_h);
    // Heller Titel-Streifen oben
    pb.fill_rect(M_LEFT + 1, title_band_y, CONTENT_WIDTH - 2, 13, 0.94);

    let mid_x = M_LEFT + CONTENT_WIDTH / 2;
    let title_y = pb.y - 8;

    // Titel
    let prev_y = pb.y;
    pb.y = title_y;
    pb.text(
        M_LEFT + 8,
        9,
        true,
        block.left_title.as_deref().unwrap_or("Patient"),
    );
    if let Some(t) = block.right_title.as_deref() {
        pb.text(mid_x + 4, 9, true, t);
    }
    pb.y = prev_y;

    // Linke Spalte
    let mut yl = title_y - 14;
    for line in &block.left_lines {
        for chunk in wrap_to_width(line, 9, false, col_pt) {
            pb.y = yl;
            pb.text(M_LEFT + 10, 9, false, &chunk);
            yl -= 11;
        }
    }

    // Rechte Spalte
    let mut yr = title_y - 14;
    for line in &block.right_lines {
        for chunk in wrap_to_width(line, 9, false, col_pt) {
            pb.y = yr;
            pb.text(mid_x + 6, 9, false, &chunk);
            yr -= 11;
        }
    }

    pb.y = panel_bottom - 18;
}

fn emit_table(pb: &mut PageBuilder, table: &PdfTableSpec, continuation: (&str, &str)) {
    let ncol = table
        .headers
        .len()
        .max(table.rows.iter().map(|r| r.len()).max().unwrap_or(0))
        .max(1);
    let col_xs = table_column_xs(table.column_layout, ncol);
    let col_widths = column_pt_widths(&col_xs);

    if let Some(t) = table.title.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) {
        pb.ensure_space(80);
        pb.advance(4);
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 11, true, t);
        pb.advance(14);
    }

    pb.ensure_space(70);

    // Table header — same inset as body cells
    pb.table_header_band(M_LEFT, pb.y + 2, CONTENT_WIDTH);
    for (ci, h) in table.headers.iter().enumerate() {
        let x = col_xs.get(ci).copied().unwrap_or(M_LEFT);
        let w = col_widths.get(ci).copied().unwrap_or(60);
        draw_cell(pb, x, w, 9, true, h, is_amount_column(table, ci));
    }
    pb.advance(14);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(10);

    emit_table_data_rows(pb, table, &col_xs, &col_widths, continuation);
}

fn emit_detail_records(pb: &mut PageBuilder, records: &[DetailRecord]) {
    for rec in records {
        let detail_lines: usize = rec
            .details
            .iter()
            .map(|d| wrap_soft(d, 80).len().max(1))
            .sum();
        let total_h = 14 + 24 + 14 + (detail_lines as i32 * 11) + 12;
        pb.ensure_space(total_h);

        let box_bottom = pb.y - total_h + 8;
        pb.fill_rect(M_LEFT, box_bottom, CONTENT_WIDTH, total_h - 8, 0.97);

        pb.advance(2);
        let de = pb.locale == "de";
        pb.text(M_LEFT + 6, 9, true, if de { "Art" } else { "Type" });
        pb.advance(12);
        for chunk in wrap_soft(&rec.kind, 80) {
            pb.text(M_LEFT + 6, 9, false, &chunk);
            pb.advance(11);
        }
        pb.advance(2);

        pb.text(M_LEFT + 6, 9, true, if de { "Zeitraum" } else { "Period" });
        pb.advance(12);
        for chunk in wrap_soft(&rec.period, 80) {
            pb.text(M_LEFT + 6, 9, false, &chunk);
            pb.advance(11);
        }
        pb.advance(2);

        pb.text(M_LEFT + 6, 9, true, if de { "Angaben" } else { "Details" });
        pb.advance(12);
        for detail in &rec.details {
            for chunk in wrap_soft(detail, 80) {
                pb.text(M_LEFT + 6, 9, false, &chunk);
                pb.advance(11);
            }
        }
        pb.advance(8);
    }
}

/// Uniform cell inset for table headers and body (must match).
const TABLE_CELL_PAD: i32 = 6;
/// Uniform padding in receipt totals.
const RECEIPT_PAD: i32 = 10;
const RECEIPT_ROW_H: i32 = 16;

/// Grand-total row: explicit `total` flag; label sniffing only as fallback
/// for layouts that do not set the flag yet.
fn is_total_row(row: &LabelValue, all: &[LabelValue]) -> bool {
    if all.iter().any(|r| r.total) {
        return row.total;
    }
    let l = row.label.to_lowercase();
    l == "total" || l == "gesamt" || l.starts_with("gesamtbetrag") || l.starts_with("endbetrag")
}

fn emit_receipt_totals(pb: &mut PageBuilder, totals: &[LabelValue]) {
    if totals.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    pb.ensure_space(24 + totals.len() as i32 * RECEIPT_ROW_H);
    pb.advance(10);
    // Separator above the money block (keeps the Total row free of overlapping rules).
    pb.hline(M_LEFT + 220, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(12);

    for row in totals {
        let bold = is_total_row(row, totals);
        if bold {
            pb.advance(2);
            pb.hline(M_LEFT + 220, M_RIGHT);
            pb.advance(12);
        }
        pb.text(M_LEFT + 220, 10, bold, &format!("{}:", row.label));
        let value = super::core::sanitize_pdf_money(&row.value);
        pb.text_right(M_RIGHT - RECEIPT_PAD, 10, bold, &value);
        pb.advance(RECEIPT_ROW_H);
    }
    pb.advance(4);
}

/// Table rows without re-emitting the header band (after page break).
fn emit_table_data_rows(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    table: &PdfTableSpec,
    col_xs: &[i32],
    col_widths: &[i32],
    continuation: (&str, &str),
) {
    let ncol = table
        .headers
        .len()
        .max(table.rows.iter().map(|r| r.len()).max().unwrap_or(0))
        .max(1);

    let amount_cols: Vec<bool> = (0..ncol).map(|ci| is_amount_column(table, ci)).collect();
    for (ri, row) in table.rows.iter().enumerate() {
        let mut wrapped: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::with_capacity(ncol);
        let mut row_lines = 1usize;
        for ci in 0..ncol {
            let cell = row.get(ci).map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
            let max_pt = col_widths.get(ci).copied().unwrap_or(60);
            // Wrap by measured width; never truncate clinical content.
            let w = wrap_to_width(cell, 9, false, f64::from(max_pt));
            row_lines = row_lines.max(w.len().max(1));
            wrapped.push(w);
        }

        let font_size = 9;
        let line_step = 12;
        let row_height = table_row_height(row_lines, line_step, font_size);
        if pb.y < M_BOTTOM + row_height + 20 {
            pb.break_page();
            let loc = pb.locale;
            emit_continuation_header_locale(pb, continuation.0, continuation.1, loc);
            pb.table_header_band(M_LEFT, pb.y + 2, CONTENT_WIDTH);
            for (ci, h) in table.headers.iter().enumerate() {
                let x = col_xs.get(ci).copied().unwrap_or(M_LEFT);
                let w = col_widths.get(ci).copied().unwrap_or(60);
                draw_cell(pb, x, w, 9, true, h, is_amount_column(table, ci));
            }
            pb.advance(14);
            pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
            pb.advance(10);
        }

        let first_baseline = pb.y;
        if ri % 2 == 1 {
            pb.fill_table_row_band(
                M_LEFT,
                CONTENT_WIDTH,
                first_baseline,
                row_height,
                font_size,
                0.97,
            );
        }

        for li in 0..row_lines {
            for ci in 0..ncol {
                let x = col_xs.get(ci).copied().unwrap_or(M_LEFT);
                let chunk = wrapped
                    .get(ci)
                    .and_then(|w| w.get(li))
                    .map(|s| s.as_str())
                    .unwrap_or("");
                if !chunk.is_empty() {
                    let prev = pb.y;
                    pb.y = first_baseline - li as i32 * line_step;
                    let w = col_widths.get(ci).copied().unwrap_or(60);
                    draw_cell(pb, x, w, font_size, false, chunk, amount_cols[ci]);
                    pb.y = prev;
                }
            }
        }
        pb.advance(row_height);
    }
    pb.advance(8);
}

fn emit_totals_block(pb: &mut PageBuilder, totals: &[LabelValue]) {
    if totals.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    pb.ensure_space(40 + totals.len() as i32 * 14);
    pb.advance(8);
    pb.hline(300, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(3);
    pb.hline(300, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(14);
    for row in totals {
        let bold = is_total_row(row, totals);
        pb.text_right(380, 10, bold, &format!("{}:", row.label));
        pb.text_right(
            M_RIGHT,
            10,
            bold,
            &super::core::sanitize_pdf_money(&row.value),
        );
        pb.advance(14);
    }
    pb.advance(8);
}

/// When `signature_lines` is populated, use those lines directly;
/// otherwise use the default signature block from `behandler_*` fields.
fn emit_default_or_custom_signature(pb: &mut PageBuilder, doc: &ClinicalPdfLayout) {
    if doc.signature_lines.is_empty() {
        // No custom block — default signature block. Provider name
        // is not available separately on this path; only professional
        // title, ZANR, and BSNR are emitted.
        emit_signature_block(
            pb,
            None,
            doc.clinician_professional_title.as_deref(),
            doc.clinician_zanr.as_deref(),
            doc.clinician_bsnr.as_deref(),
            true,
        );
        emit_footer_meta(pb, &doc.footer_meta_lines);
        return;
    }

    // Custom signature lines
    pb.ensure_space(80);
    pb.advance(20);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(20);
    pb.hline_at(M_LEFT, pb.y, M_LEFT + 180);
    pb.advance(14);
    for (i, line) in doc.signature_lines.iter().enumerate() {
        let bold = i == 0;
        let size = if i == 0 { 10 } else { 9 };
        pb.text(M_LEFT, size, bold, line);
        pb.advance(size + 2);
    }
    pb.advance(4);
    let stamp = stamp_label(pb.locale);
    pb.text(M_LEFT, 8, false, stamp);

    emit_footer_meta(pb, &doc.footer_meta_lines);
}

fn emit_footer_meta(pb: &mut PageBuilder, meta: &[LabelValue]) {
    if meta.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    // Ensure meta lines appear below the signature block
    pb.advance(10);
    for row in meta {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 8, false, &row.label);
        pb.text_right(M_RIGHT, 9, false, &row.value);
        pb.advance(12);
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn practice() -> Vec<String> {
        vec![
            "Dental practice Dr. Test".into(),
            "Teststraße 1".into(),
            "10115 Berlin".into(),
            "Tel: 030/12345".into(),
        ]
    }

    fn meta() -> Vec<LabelValue> {
        vec![
            LabelValue {
                label: "Date".into(),
                value: "19.04.2026".into(),

                label: "Document-Nr.".into(),
                value: "AT-001".into(),
                ..Default::default()
            },
        ]
    }

    #[test]
    fn renders_certificate() {
        let doc = ClinicalPdfLayout {
            kind: "certificate".into(),
            practice_lines: practice(),
            header_right_lines: vec![],
            meta_lines: meta(),
            address_lines: vec!["Max Sample".into(), "Sample Street 1".into()],
            document_title: "MEDICAL CERTIFICATE".into(),
            document_subtitle: Some("SICK_LEAVE".into()),
            intro_paragraphs: vec!["This certifies that the person named below …".into()],
            label_value_rows: vec![
                LabelValue {
                    label: "Patient".into(),
                    value: "Max Sample".into(),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                LabelValue {
                    label: "Date of birth".into(),
                    value: "01.01.1980".into(),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                LabelValue {
                    label: "ICD-10".into(),
                    value: "K02.1 — Karies des Dentins".into(),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
            ],
            two_column: None,
            tables: vec![],
            detail_records: vec![],
            totals: vec![],
            closing_paragraphs: vec!["Place, date: Berlin, 19.04.2026".into()],
            signature_lines: vec![],
            footer_meta_lines: vec![],
            clinician_professional_title: Some("Zahnärztin".into()),
            clinician_zanr: Some("987654321".into()),
            clinician_bsnr: Some("123456789".into()),
            logo_kv_json: None,
            locale: None,
            rtl: false,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let pdf = render_clinical_layout(&doc).unwrap();
        assert!(pdf.starts_with(b"%PDF-1.4"));
        assert!(pdf.ends_with(b"%%EOF\n"));
        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&pdf);
        assert!(text.contains("CERTIFICATE") || text.contains("MEDICAL"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn clinical_pdf_embeds_practice_logo_xobject() {
        let img = image::RgbImage::from_pixel(24, 24, image::Rgb([10, 120, 200]));
        let mut buf = Vec::new();
        image::DynamicImage::ImageRgb8(img)
            .write_to(&mut std::io::Cursor::new(&mut buf), image::ImageFormat::Png)
            .expect("encode");
        use base64::Engine;
        let b64 = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&buf);
        let logo_json = format!(r#"{{"mime":"image/png","data":"{b64}"}}"#);
        let logo = PdfLogo::from_kv_json(&logo_json).expect("logo");
        let doc = ClinicalPdfLayout {
            kind: "certificate".into(),
            practice_lines: practice(),
            header_right_lines: vec![],
            meta_lines: meta(),
            address_lines: vec!["Max Sample".into()],
            document_title: "MEDICAL CERTIFICATE".into(),
            document_subtitle: None,
            intro_paragraphs: vec!["Body".into()],
            label_value_rows: vec![],
            two_column: None,
            tables: vec![],
            detail_records: vec![],
            totals: vec![],
            closing_paragraphs: vec![],
            signature_lines: vec![],
            footer_meta_lines: vec![],
            clinician_professional_title: None,
            clinician_zanr: None,
            clinician_bsnr: None,
            logo_kv_json: None,
            locale: Some("en".into()),
            rtl: false,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let pdf = render_clinical_layout_with_logo(&doc, Some(&logo)).unwrap();
        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&pdf);
        assert!(text.contains("/Im0"), "page must reference logo XObject");
        assert!(
            text.contains("/Subtype /Image"),
            "PDF must embed image XObject"
        );
        assert!(text.contains("Do"), "content stream must draw image");
    }

    #[test]
    fn renders_prescription_with_two_column_panel() {
        let doc = ClinicalPdfLayout {

    fn renders_receipt() {

    }
}
