//! Shared PDF primitives for every MeDoc document type (invoice, record, certificate,
//! prescription, receipt, daily report, fact sheet).
//!
//! What lives here:
//! - **Constants** (DIN-5008-compliant margins, A4 media box, page positions).
//! - **Character encoding** WinAnsi with UTF-16BE fallback (without truncating
//!   the rest of the string).
//! - **PdfPage / PdfDoc** low-level builder model — writes a PDF-1.4 object stream.
//! - **Primitives** for text, lines, rectangles, table headers.
//!
//! All further renderers (invoice, record, clinical documents) build their
//! content on **one** shared [`PageBuilder`] instance so margins,
//! fonts, and encoding are defined exactly once.

use crate::error::AppError;
use std::fmt::Write;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// DIN-5008 / A4 constants
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// A4 width in PDF points (1 pt = 1/72 inch).
pub const PAGE_WIDTH: i32 = 595;
/// A4 height in PDF points.
pub const PAGE_HEIGHT: i32 = 842;

/// 1 mm in PDF points.
pub const MM: f64 = 72.0 / 25.4;

/// Converts "mm from the top edge" (how DIN 5008 is specified) to a PDF y.
pub const fn y_from_top_mm(mm_x10: i32) -> i32 {
    // mm_x10 = millimetres × 10 to keep this a const fn without floats.
    PAGE_HEIGHT - (mm_x10 * 2835 / 10_000)
}

/// Left content margin — DIN 5008: 25 mm.
pub const M_LEFT: i32 = 71;
/// Right content margin — DIN 5008: at least 20 mm → 595 − 57.
pub const M_RIGHT: i32 = 538;
/// Top content start (PDF Y-axis: 0 at bottom, 842 at top).
pub const M_TOP: i32 = 810;
/// Bottom of the content area. Below it: DIN footer (practice/bank/tax lines)
/// and the page number.
pub const M_BOTTOM: i32 = 80;

/// Content width = M_RIGHT − M_LEFT.
pub const CONTENT_WIDTH: i32 = M_RIGHT - M_LEFT;

// DIN 5008 **Form B** (letterhead 45 mm high, address field 45–90 mm from top).
/// Lowest baseline the letterhead may use (45 mm from top).
pub const LETTERHEAD_MIN_Y: i32 = y_from_top_mm(450);
/// Return-address line (Rücksendeangabe, zone 45–50 mm).
pub const SENDER_HINT_Y: i32 = y_from_top_mm(485);
/// First line of the recipient address (Anschriftzone starts at 62.7 mm).
pub const ADDRESS_WINDOW_Y: i32 = y_from_top_mm(662);
/// Bottom of the address field (90 mm).
pub const ADDRESS_WINDOW_BOTTOM_Y: i32 = y_from_top_mm(900);
/// Height of the address field (45 mm).
pub const ADDRESS_WINDOW_HEIGHT: i32 = 128;
/// Information block (Infoblock) starts 125 mm from the left edge, 50 mm from top.
pub const INFO_BLOCK_X: i32 = 354;
pub const INFO_BLOCK_TOP_Y: i32 = y_from_top_mm(500);
/// First content line after the address field (subject line, ~98.4 mm).
pub const CONTENT_START_Y: i32 = y_from_top_mm(984);
/// Fold marks (105 mm, 210 mm) and hole mark (148.5 mm), Form B.
pub const FOLD_MARK_1_Y: i32 = y_from_top_mm(1050);
pub const FOLD_MARK_2_Y: i32 = y_from_top_mm(2100);
pub const HOLE_MARK_Y: i32 = y_from_top_mm(1485);

/// Y where the page-number footer is rendered.
pub const PAGE_NUMBER_Y: i32 = 30;
/// Y of the first DIN footer line (grows upward, max 3 lines).
pub const FOOTER_FIRST_Y: i32 = 42;
/// Y where the signature footer area begins.
pub const SIGNATURE_FOOTER_Y: i32 = 90;

/// Document language for all official PDFs. The base-14 fonts cannot render
/// Arabic; until fonts are embedded, an Arabic UI still produces German
/// documents (the legal language of a German practice).
pub fn pdf_locale(requested: &str) -> &'static str {
    match requested {
        "en" => "en",
        "fr" => "fr",
        _ => "de",
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Encoding
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// Map a Unicode code point to WinAnsi (Helvetica Type-1).
///
/// Covers all characters relevant for German practice text — when not
/// mapped, `None` signals the caller to switch **the entire string**
/// to UTF-16BE hex (PDF hex literal `<…>`).
fn winansi_byte(ch: char) -> Option<u8> {
    if ch.is_ascii() {
        return Some(ch as u8);
    }
    Some(match ch {
        '\u{00A0}' => 0xA0,
        '\u{00A1}' => 0xA1,
        '\u{00A2}' => 0xA2,
        '\u{00A3}' => 0xA3,
        '\u{00A4}' => 0xA4,
        '\u{00A5}' => 0xA5,
        '\u{00A6}' => 0xA6,
        '\u{00A7}' => 0xA7,
        '\u{00A8}' => 0xA8,
        '\u{00A9}' => 0xA9,
        '\u{00AA}' => 0xAA,
        '\u{00AB}' => 0xAB,
        '\u{00AC}' => 0xAC,
        '\u{00AD}' => 0xAD,
        '\u{00AE}' => 0xAE,
        '\u{00AF}' => 0xAF,
        '\u{00B0}' => 0xB0,
        '\u{00B1}' => 0xB1,
        '\u{00B2}' => 0xB2,
        '\u{00B3}' => 0xB3,
        '\u{00B4}' => 0xB4,
        '\u{00B5}' => 0xB5,
        '\u{00B6}' => 0xB6,
        '\u{00B7}' => 0xB7,
        '\u{00B8}' => 0xB8,
        '\u{00B9}' => 0xB9,
        '\u{00BA}' => 0xBA,
        '\u{00BB}' => 0xBB,
        '\u{00BC}' => 0xBC,
        '\u{00BD}' => 0xBD,
        '\u{00BE}' => 0xBE,
        '\u{00BF}' => 0xBF,
        // German Umlauts
        'Ä' => 0xC4,
        'Å' => 0xC5,
        'Ö' => 0xD6,
        'Ø' => 0xD8,
        'Ü' => 0xDC,
        'ß' => 0xDF,
        'ä' => 0xE4,
        'å' => 0xE5,
        'ö' => 0xF6,
        'ø' => 0xF8,
        'ü' => 0xFC,
        'É' => 0xC9,
        'È' => 0xC8,
        'Ê' => 0xCA,
        'é' => 0xE9,
        'è' => 0xE8,
        'ê' => 0xEA,
        'ç' => 0xE7,
        'Ç' => 0xC7,
        'ñ' => 0xF1,
        'Ñ' => 0xD1,
        '\u{00D7}' => 0xD7, // × Multiplikationszeichen
        '\u{00F7}' => 0xF7, // ÷ Divisionszeichen
        // CP1252 (WinAnsi) extensions
        '€' => 0x80,
        '\u{201A}' => 0x82, // ‚ low single quote
        'ƒ' => 0x83,
        '\u{201E}' => 0x84, // „ low double quote
        '\u{2026}' => 0x85, // …
        '\u{2020}' => 0x86, // †
        '\u{2021}' => 0x87, // ‡
        '\u{02C6}' => 0x88, // ˆ
        '\u{2030}' => 0x89, // ‰
        'Š' => 0x8A,
        '\u{2039}' => 0x8B, // ‹
        'Œ' => 0x8C,
        'Ž' => 0x8E,
        '\u{2018}' => 0x91, // '
        '\u{2019}' => 0x92, // '
        '\u{201C}' => 0x93, // "
        '\u{201D}' => 0x94, // "
        '\u{2022}' => 0x95, // •
        '\u{2013}' => 0x96, // –
        '\u{2014}' => 0x97, // —
        '\u{02DC}' => 0x98, // ˜
        '\u{2122}' => 0x99, // ™
        'š' => 0x9A,
        '\u{203A}' => 0x9B, // ›
        'œ' => 0x9C,
        'ž' => 0x9E,
        'Ÿ' => 0x9F,
        // Mathematik / typographische Striche → ASCII-Fallback
        '\u{2015}' | '\u{2212}' => b'-',
        _ => return None,
    })
}

fn pdf_escape_winansi_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() + 4);
    for &b in bytes {
        match b {
            b'(' | b')' | b'\\' => {
                out.push('\\');
                out.push(b as char);
            }
            32..=126 => out.push(b as char),
            _ => {
                out.push('\\');
                let _ = write!(out, "{:03o}", b);
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

/// True when every character of `s` can be drawn with the WinAnsi fonts.
pub fn is_winansi_renderable(s: &str) -> bool {
    s.chars().all(|c| winansi_byte(c).is_some() || c.is_whitespace())
}

/// Encode a text literal for a **content stream** (Helvetica / WinAnsi).
///
/// A simple Type-1 font reads every byte as one WinAnsi glyph, so the old
/// UTF-16 hex fallback (`<FEFF…>`) printed `þÿ` followed by garbage.
/// Unmappable characters are now replaced by `?` and the caller is expected
/// to validate input with [`is_winansi_renderable`] for official documents.
/// Real non-Latin support needs embedded fonts (see `CHANGES.md`, phase 2).
pub fn text_operand(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(s.len());
    for ch in s.chars() {
        match winansi_byte(ch) {
            Some(b) => bytes.push(b),
            None if ch.is_whitespace() => bytes.push(b' '),
            None => bytes.push(b'?'),
        }
    }
    format!("({})", pdf_escape_winansi_bytes(&bytes))
}

/// Encode a string for the document **Info dictionary** / metadata, where
/// PDF allows UTF-16BE with BOM (unlike content streams).
pub fn info_string_operand(s: &str) -> String {
    if s.chars().all(|c| winansi_byte(c).is_some()) {
        return text_operand(s);
    }
    let mut hex = String::from("<FEFF");
    for unit in s.encode_utf16() {
        let _ = write!(hex, "{:04X}", unit);
    }
    hex.push('>');
    hex
}

/// Text width in PDF points from the Helvetica AFM metrics (regular weight).
pub fn approx_text_width(s: &str, font_size: i32) -> i32 {
    text_width(s, font_size, false)
}

/// Text width in PDF points from the Helvetica / Helvetica-Bold AFM metrics.
pub fn text_width(s: &str, font_size: i32, bold: bool) -> i32 {
    super::metrics::text_width_pt(s, font_size, bold).ceil() as i32
}

/// Continuation header drawn automatically after every page break.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ContinuationHeader {
    pub practice_name: String,
    pub doc_title: String,
    pub locale: &'static str,
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PageBuilder — unified write model for every document type
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// A PageBuilder accumulates PDF content streams page by page.
///
/// **Usage:**
/// ```ignore
/// let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
/// pb.text(M_LEFT, pb.y, 10, false, "Hello World");
/// pb.advance(12);
/// let pages = pb.finish();
/// emit_multipage_pdf(&pages, "My Document")?;
/// ```
///
/// `y` always points at the **baseline** of the next text output in
/// PDF coordinates (0 at bottom). `advance(n)` reduces `y` by `n` and
/// automatically page-breaks when `y < M_BOTTOM`.
pub struct PageBuilder {
    pub pages: Vec<String>,
    pub cur: String,
    pub y: i32,
    page_top: i32,
    /// DIN 5008 footer lines (practice / tax / bank), repeated on every page.
    pub footer_lines: Vec<String>,
    /// Drawn after each automatic or manual page break.
    pub continuation: Option<ContinuationHeader>,
    /// Diagonal watermark on every page (e.g. "ENTWURF", "KOPIE").
    pub watermark: Option<String>,
    /// Draw fold and hole marks (letters with an address window).
    pub letter_marks: bool,
    /// Document language for fixed labels (see [`pdf_locale`]).
    pub locale: &'static str,
}

impl Default for PageBuilder {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl PageBuilder {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            pages: Vec::new(),
            cur: String::new(),
            y: M_TOP,
            page_top: M_TOP,
            footer_lines: Vec::new(),
            continuation: None,
            watermark: None,
            letter_marks: false,
            locale: "de",
        }
    }

    /// Use a different top-of-page start (e.g. after letterhead).
    pub fn with_page_top(mut self, page_top: i32) -> Self {
        self.page_top = page_top;
        self.y = page_top;
        self
    }

    /// Register the header that every continuation page starts with.
    pub fn set_continuation(&mut self, practice_name: &str, doc_title: &str, locale: &str) {
        self.continuation = Some(ContinuationHeader {
            practice_name: practice_name.to_string(),
            doc_title: doc_title.to_string(),
            locale: pdf_locale(locale),
        });
    }

    /// Force a page break — the next write starts at `y = self.page_top`,
    /// below the continuation header when one is registered.
    pub fn break_page(&mut self) {
        if !self.cur.is_empty() {
            self.pages.push(std::mem::take(&mut self.cur));
        }
        self.y = self.page_top;
        if let Some(c) = self.continuation.clone() {
            let cont = match c.locale {
                "de" => "Fortsetzung",
                "fr" => "suite",
                _ => "continued",
            };
            self.text(M_LEFT, 9, true, &c.practice_name);
            self.text_right(M_RIGHT, 9, false, &format!("{} ({cont})", c.doc_title));
            self.y -= 4;
            let y = self.y;
            self.hline_at(M_LEFT, y, M_RIGHT);
            self.y -= 16;
        }
    }

    /// Ensure at least `min_y_remaining` points remain — otherwise
    /// page-break.
    pub fn ensure_space(&mut self, min_y_remaining: i32) {
        if self.y < M_BOTTOM + min_y_remaining {
            self.break_page();
        }
    }

    /// Reduce `y` by `dy` (line height).
    pub fn advance(&mut self, dy: i32) {
        self.y -= dy;
    }

    /// Write text. `bold = true` uses /F2 (Helvetica-Bold), otherwise /F1.
    /// **Cursor is NOT moved** — caller is responsible for `advance(line_height)`.
    pub fn text(&mut self, x: i32, size: i32, bold: bool, s: &str) {
        let font = if bold { "F2" } else { "F1" };
        let op = text_operand(s);
        let _ = writeln!(
            self.cur,
            "BT /{font} {size} Tf {x} {y} Td {op} Tj ET",
            font = font,
            size = size,
            x = x,
            y = self.y,
            op = op,
        );
    }

    /// Text right-aligned to right margin `x_right`.
    pub fn text_right(&mut self, x_right: i32, size: i32, bold: bool, s: &str) {
        let w = text_width(s, size, bold);
        let x = (x_right - w).max(M_LEFT);
        self.text(x, size, bold, s);
    }

    /// Writes `text` wrapped to `max_pt` starting at `x`; returns lines written.
    /// Breaks pages as needed (continuation header included).
    pub fn wrapped(&mut self, x: i32, size: i32, bold: bool, text: &str, max_pt: i32) -> usize {
        let lines = super::metrics::wrap_to_width(text, size, bold, f64::from(max_pt));
        for line in &lines {
            self.ensure_space(size + 6);
            if !line.is_empty() {
                self.text(x, size, bold, line);
            }
            self.advance(size + 3);
        }
        lines.len()
    }

    /// Draw shared Image XObject `/Im{index}` with bottom-left at `(x, y)`.
    pub fn draw_image(&mut self, index: usize, x: f64, y: f64, w: f64, h: f64) {
        let _ = writeln!(
            self.cur,
            "q {w:.2} 0 0 {h:.2} {x:.2} {y:.2} cm /Im{index} Do Q"
        );
    }

    /// Text centered between `M_LEFT` and `M_RIGHT`.
    pub fn text_center(&mut self, size: i32, bold: bool, s: &str) {
        let w = text_width(s, size, bold);
        let x = M_LEFT + (CONTENT_WIDTH - w) / 2;
        self.text(x.max(M_LEFT), size, bold, s);
    }

    /// Multi-line paragraph wrapped by measured width (the `max_chars`
    /// argument is kept for call-site compatibility and only caps the width).
    /// Handles page breaks itself.
    pub fn paragraph(&mut self, text: &str, size: i32, max_chars: usize, indent: i32) {
        let by_chars = (max_chars as f64 * f64::from(size) * 0.556) as i32;
        let max_pt = (CONTENT_WIDTH - indent).min(by_chars.max(40));
        for raw_line in text.split('\n') {
            if raw_line.trim().is_empty() {
                self.advance(size / 2);
                continue;
            }
            for chunk in super::metrics::wrap_to_width(raw_line, size, false, f64::from(max_pt)) {
                self.ensure_space(size + 6);
                self.text(M_LEFT + indent, size, false, &chunk);
                self.advance(size + 4);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Horizontal line at the current `y` position.
    pub fn hline(&mut self, x1: i32, x2: i32) {
        let _ = writeln!(self.cur, "{} {} m {} {} l S", x1, self.y, x2, self.y);
    }

    /// Horizontal line at an arbitrary `y` position (page element, e.g.
    /// letterhead divider).
    pub fn hline_at(&mut self, x1: i32, y: i32, x2: i32) {
        let _ = writeln!(self.cur, "{} {} m {} {} l S", x1, y, x2, y);
    }

    /// Filled rectangle (grayscale). `y_bottom` is the bottom edge.
    pub fn fill_rect(&mut self, x: i32, y_bottom: i32, w: i32, h: i32, gray: f64) {
        let _ = writeln!(
            self.cur,
            "q {g:.3} g {x} {y} {w} {h} re f Q",
            g = gray,
            x = x,
            y = y_bottom,
            w = w,
            h = h,
        );
    }

    /// Outlined rectangle.
    pub fn stroke_rect(&mut self, x: i32, y_bottom: i32, w: i32, h: i32) {
        let _ = writeln!(
            self.cur,
            "{x} {y} {w} {h} re S",
            x = x,
            y = y_bottom,
            w = w,
            h = h
        );
    }

    /// Table header band: light background behind the table header row.
    /// `y_text_baseline` is the header text baseline; the band covers ascenders.
    pub fn table_header_band(&mut self, x: i32, y_text_baseline: i32, w: i32) {
        let font_size = 9;
        let ascent = table_font_ascent(font_size);
        let descent = table_font_descent(font_size);
        let h = ascent + descent + 4;
        let y_bottom = y_text_baseline + ascent - h;
        self.fill_rect(x, y_bottom, w, h, 0.92);
    }

    /// Zebra stripe behind a table data row.
    ///
    /// PDF text sits on a **baseline** with glyphs extending above it. Filling
    /// `[baseline − h, baseline]` leaves the ink in white and the gray below
    /// the letters. This band is anchored so its **top** is at
    /// `first_baseline + ascent`, matching the vertical span consumed by
    /// `advance(row_height)` after drawing at `first_baseline`.
    pub fn fill_table_row_band(
        &mut self,
        x: i32,
        w: i32,
        first_baseline: i32,
        row_height: i32,
        font_size: i32,
        gray: f64,
    ) {
        let ascent = table_font_ascent(font_size);
        let y_bottom = first_baseline + ascent - row_height;
        self.fill_rect(x, y_bottom, w, row_height, gray);
    }

    /// Finish the current stream and return all pages.
    /// Guarantees at least one page (even if empty) so `emit_multipage_pdf`
    /// does not crash.
    pub fn finish(mut self) -> Vec<String> {
        if !self.cur.is_empty() {
            let last = std::mem::take(&mut self.cur);
            self.pages.push(last);
        }
        if self.pages.is_empty() {
            self.pages.push(String::new());
        }
        let footer = footer_stream(&self.footer_lines);
        let marks = if self.letter_marks { letter_marks_stream() } else { String::new() };
        let wm = self.watermark.as_deref().map(watermark_stream).unwrap_or_default();
        self.pages
            .into_iter()
            .map(|body| format!("{wm}{body}{footer}{marks}"))
            .collect()
    }
}

/// DIN 5008 footer: up to three centred 7 pt lines above the page number.
fn footer_stream(lines: &[String]) -> String {
    let mut s = String::new();
    let mut wrapped: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for l in lines.iter().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()) {
        wrapped.extend(super::metrics::wrap_to_width(l, 7, false, f64::from(CONTENT_WIDTH)));
    }
    if wrapped.is_empty() {
        return s;
    }
    let _ = writeln!(s, "q 0.6 G 0.5 w {M_LEFT} {} m {M_RIGHT} {} l S Q", M_BOTTOM - 8, M_BOTTOM - 8);
    // Draw bottom-up so the first line ends highest.
    for (i, line) in wrapped.iter().rev().take(3).enumerate() {
        let w = text_width(line, 7, false);
        let x = (M_LEFT + (CONTENT_WIDTH - w) / 2).max(M_LEFT);
        let y = FOOTER_FIRST_Y + i as i32 * 9;
        let _ = writeln!(s, "BT /F1 7 Tf {x} {y} Td {} Tj ET", text_operand(line));
    }
    s
}

/// Fold marks at 105 / 210 mm and the hole mark at 148.5 mm (DIN 5008 Form B).
fn letter_marks_stream() -> String {
    let mut s = String::from("q 0.4 w\n");
    for y in [FOLD_MARK_1_Y, FOLD_MARK_2_Y] {
        let _ = writeln!(s, "14 {y} m 28 {y} l S");
    }
    let _ = writeln!(s, "14 {y} m 34 {y} l S", y = HOLE_MARK_Y);
    s.push_str("Q\n");
    s
}

/// Light diagonal watermark drawn **under** the page content.
fn watermark_stream(text: &str) -> String {
    let size = 64;
    let w = f64::from(text_width(text, size, true));
    // Rotate 45° around the page centre.
    let (c, sn) = (std::f64::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2, std::f64::consts::FRAC_1_SQRT_2);
    let cx = f64::from(PAGE_WIDTH) / 2.0;
    let cy = f64::from(PAGE_HEIGHT) / 2.0;
    let x0 = cx - (w / 2.0) * c;
    let y0 = cy - (w / 2.0) * sn;
    format!(
        "q 0.88 g BT /F2 {size} Tf {c:.4} {sn:.4} {:.4} {c:.4} {x0:.2} {y0:.2} Tm {} Tj ET Q\n",
        -sn,
        text_operand(text)
    )
}

/// Helvetica-ish ascent above the baseline (points) for `font_size`.
pub fn table_font_ascent(font_size: i32) -> i32 {
    (font_size * 4 / 5).max(6)
}

/// Helvetica-ish descent below the baseline (points) for `font_size`.
pub fn table_font_descent(font_size: i32) -> i32 {
    (font_size / 4).max(2)
}

/// Total row advance for wrapped table cells: ascent + lines + descent + padding.
pub fn table_row_height(line_count: usize, line_step: i32, font_size: i32) -> i32 {
    let lines = line_count.max(1) as i32;
    let ascent = table_font_ascent(font_size);
    let descent = table_font_descent(font_size);
    let vpad = 4;
    ascent + vpad + (lines - 1) * line_step + descent + vpad
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PDF-Datei zusammenbauen
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// Write n pages as a PDF-1.4 file with embedded Helvetica + Helvetica-Bold
/// and an automatic "Page X of Y" footer.
///
/// Typically called after `let pages = page_builder.finish();`.
pub fn emit_multipage_pdf(page_streams: &[String], pdf_title: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    emit_multipage_pdf_with_images(page_streams, pdf_title, &[], "de")
}

/// Document-level metadata written to the Catalog and Info dictionary.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct PdfDocMeta {
    pub title: String,
    /// Stable document number or registry id (stored in `/Subject`).
    pub subject: Option<String>,
    /// Issuing practice / clinician (`/Author`).
    pub author: Option<String>,
    /// Document language (`de`, `en`, `fr`).
    pub locale: String,
}

/// Like [`emit_multipage_pdf`], with optional Image XObjects (`/Im0` …) and
/// localized page-number footer.
pub fn emit_multipage_pdf_with_images(
    page_streams: &[String],
    pdf_title: &str,
    images: &[super::logo::PdfLogo],
    locale: &str,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    emit_pdf_document(
        page_streams,
        &PdfDocMeta {
            title: pdf_title.to_string(),
            locale: locale.to_string(),
            ..Default::default()
        },
        images,
    )
}

/// PDF date string `D:YYYYMMDDHHmmSS+HH'mm'` in local time.
pub fn pdf_date_now() -> String {
    let now = chrono::Local::now();
    let off = now.offset().local_minus_utc();
    let sign = if off < 0 { '-' } else { '+' };
    let off = off.abs();
    format!(
        "D:{}{}{:02}'{:02}'",
        now.format("%Y%m%d%H%M%S"),
        sign,
        off / 3600,
        (off % 3600) / 60
    )
}

/// Write the PDF file (PDF 1.4, base-14 fonts). Adds `/Lang`,
/// `/DisplayDocTitle`, creation/modification dates and author/subject.
pub fn emit_pdf_document(
    page_streams: &[String],
    meta: &PdfDocMeta,
    images: &[super::logo::PdfLogo],
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    let locale = pdf_locale(&meta.locale);
    let pdf_title = meta.title.as_str();
    let n = page_streams.len().max(1);
    let image_count = images.len();
    // Object layout: 1=Catalog, 2=Pages, then page/content pairs, then fonts,
    // then images, then Info.
    let font_regular_id = 3 + n * 2;
    let font_bold_id = font_regular_id + 1;
    let first_image_id = font_bold_id + 1;
    let info_id = first_image_id + image_count;

    let mut out: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
    let mut offsets: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();

    out.extend_from_slice(b"%PDF-1.4\n");
    out.extend_from_slice(b"%\xE2\xE3\xCF\xD3\n"); // binary marker

    // 1 0 obj — Catalog
    offsets.push(out.len());
    out.extend_from_slice(
        format!(
            "1 0 obj\n<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R /Lang {} \
             /ViewerPreferences << /DisplayDocTitle true >> >>\nendobj\n",
            text_operand(match locale {
                "de" => "de-DE",
                "fr" => "fr-FR",
                _ => "en",
            })
        )
        .as_bytes(),
    );

    // 2 0 obj — Pages tree
    offsets.push(out.len());
    let kids: String = (0..n)
        .map(|i| format!("{} 0 R", 3 + i * 2))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" ");
    out.extend_from_slice(
        format!(
            "2 0 obj\n<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{}] /Count {} >>\nendobj\n",
            kids, n
        )
        .as_bytes(),
    );

    let xobject_dict = if image_count == 0 {
        String::new()
    } else {
        let entries: String = (0..image_count)
            .map(|i| format!("/Im{i} {} 0 R", first_image_id + i))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join(" ");
        format!(" /XObject << {entries} >>")
    };

    // 3 0 obj .. — Page + Content per page
    for i in 0..n {
        let page_id = 3 + i * 2;
        let content_id = 4 + i * 2;

        let mut stream = page_streams.get(i).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        append_page_number_footer(&mut stream, i, n, locale);
        let bytes = stream.as_bytes();

        offsets.push(out.len());
        out.extend_from_slice(
            format!(
                "{p} 0 obj\n<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R \
                 /MediaBox [0 0 {w} {h}] \
                 /Resources << /Font << /F1 {f} 0 R /F2 {fb} 0 R >>{xo} >> \
                 /Contents {c} 0 R >>\nendobj\n",
                p = page_id,
                w = PAGE_WIDTH,
                h = PAGE_HEIGHT,
                f = font_regular_id,
                fb = font_bold_id,
                xo = xobject_dict,
                c = content_id,
            )
            .as_bytes(),
        );

        offsets.push(out.len());
        out.extend_from_slice(
            format!(
                "{c} 0 obj\n<< /Length {len} >>\nstream\n",
                c = content_id,
                len = bytes.len()
            )
            .as_bytes(),
        );
        out.extend_from_slice(bytes);
        out.extend_from_slice(b"\nendstream\nendobj\n");
    }

    // Fonts
    offsets.push(out.len());
    out.extend_from_slice(
        format!(
            "{} 0 obj\n<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>\nendobj\n",
            font_regular_id
        )
        .as_bytes(),
    );
    offsets.push(out.len());
    out.extend_from_slice(
        format!(
            "{} 0 obj\n<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>\nendobj\n",
            font_bold_id
        )
        .as_bytes(),
    );

    // Images
    for (i, img) in images.iter().enumerate() {
        let id = first_image_id + i;
        offsets.push(out.len());
        out.extend_from_slice(
            format!(
                "{id} 0 obj\n<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image \
                 /Width {w} /Height {h} /ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 \
                 /Filter /FlateDecode /Length {len} >>\nstream\n",
                id = id,
                w = img.width_px,
                h = img.height_px,
                len = img.data.len(),
            )
            .as_bytes(),
        );
        out.extend_from_slice(&img.data);
        out.extend_from_slice(b"\nendstream\nendobj\n");
    }

    // Info-Dictionary
    offsets.push(out.len());
    let date = pdf_date_now();
    let mut info = format!(
        "<< /Title {} /Producer (MeDoc) /Creator (MeDoc) /CreationDate {} /ModDate {}",
        info_string_operand(pdf_title),
        text_operand(&date),
        text_operand(&date),
    );
    if let Some(s) = meta.subject.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        info.push_str(&format!(" /Subject {}", info_string_operand(s)));
    }
    if let Some(a) = meta.author.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        info.push_str(&format!(" /Author {}", info_string_operand(a)));
    }
    info.push_str(" >>");
    out.extend_from_slice(format!("{info_id} 0 obj\n{info}\nendobj\n").as_bytes());

    // xref
    let xref_pos = out.len();
    out.extend_from_slice(format!("xref\n0 {}\n", offsets.len() + 1).as_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(b"0000000000 65535 f \n");
    for off in &offsets {
        out.extend_from_slice(format!("{:010} 00000 n \n", off).as_bytes());
    }

    // trailer
    out.extend_from_slice(
        format!(
            "trailer\n<< /Size {} /Root 1 0 R /Info {} 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{}\n%%EOF\n",
            offsets.len() + 1,
            info_id,
            xref_pos,
        )
        .as_bytes(),
    );

    Ok(out)
}

fn page_of_label(locale: &str, page: usize, total: usize) -> String {
    match locale {
        "de" => format!("Seite {page} von {total}"),
        "fr" => format!("Page {page} sur {total}"),
        _ => format!("Page {page} of {total}"),
    }
}

fn append_page_number_footer(
    stream: &mut String,
    page_index: usize,
    page_total: usize,
    locale: &str,
) {
    let label = page_of_label(pdf_locale(locale), page_index + 1, page_total);
    let op = text_operand(&label);
    // Centered in the footer.
    let x = (PAGE_WIDTH - approx_text_width(&label, 9)) / 2;
    let _ = writeln!(
        stream,
        "BT /F1 9 Tf {x} {y} Td {op} Tj ET",
        x = x,
        y = PAGE_NUMBER_Y,
        op = op,
    );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Text helpers: wrap and hyphenation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn char_len(s: &str) -> usize {
    s.chars().count()
}

fn is_vowel(c: char) -> bool {
    matches!(
        c,
        'a' | 'e'
            | 'i'
            | 'o'
            | 'u'
            | 'ä'
            | 'ö'
            | 'ü'
            | 'y'
            | 'A'
            | 'E'
            | 'I'
            | 'O'
            | 'U'
            | 'Ä'
            | 'Ö'
            | 'Ü'
            | 'Y'
    )
}

/// Soft wrap — breaks ONLY on whitespace, never mid-word.
/// For table cells and short fields where hyphens would be distracting.
pub fn wrap_soft(text: &str, max_chars: usize) -> Vec<String> {
    let width = max_chars.clamp(4, 200);
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    for paragraph in text.split('\n') {
        let trimmed = paragraph.trim_end();
        if trimmed.is_empty() {
            lines.push(String::new());
            continue;
        }
        let mut current = String::new();
        for word in trimmed.split_whitespace() {
            if current.is_empty() {
                current.push_str(word);
            } else if char_len(&current) + 1 + char_len(word) <= width {
                current.push(' ');
                current.push_str(word);
            } else {
                lines.push(std::mem::take(&mut current));
                current.push_str(word);
            }
        }
        if !current.is_empty() {
            lines.push(current);
        }
    }
    if lines.is_empty() {
        lines.push(String::new());
    }
    lines
}

/// German flowing-text wrap — also breaks long compounds at syllable points
/// (prefix/suffix heuristic + vowel/consonant change) with a hyphen.
pub fn wrap_text(text: &str, max_chars: usize) -> Vec<String> {
    let width = max_chars.clamp(12, 200);
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    for paragraph in text.split('\n') {
        let trimmed = paragraph.trim_end();
        if trimmed.is_empty() {
            lines.push(String::new());
            continue;
        }
        let mut current = String::new();
        for word in trimmed.split_whitespace() {
            let pieces = hyphenate_german_word(word, width);
            for part in pieces {
                if current.is_empty() {
                    current = part;
                } else if char_len(&current) + 1 + char_len(&part) <= width {
                    current.push(' ');
                    current.push_str(&part);
                } else {
                    lines.push(std::mem::take(&mut current));
                    current = part;
                }
            }
        }
        if !current.is_empty() {
            lines.push(current);
        }
    }
    if lines.is_empty() {
        lines.push(String::new());
    }
    lines
}

fn hyphenate_german_word(word: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {
    if char_len(word) <= width {
        return vec![word.to_string()];
    }
    if word.contains('-') {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let mut acc = String::new();
        for (i, seg) in word.split('-').enumerate() {
            let piece = if i == 0 {
                seg.to_string()
            } else {
                format!("-{seg}")
            };
            if acc.is_empty() {
                acc = piece;
            } else if char_len(&acc) + char_len(&piece) <= width {
                acc.push_str(&piece);
            } else {
                out.extend(hyphenate_german_word(&acc, width));
                acc = piece;
            }
        }
        if !acc.is_empty() {
            out.extend(hyphenate_german_word(&acc, width));
        }
        return out;
    }
    pack_word_at_hyphen_points(word, width)
}

fn collect_german_hyphen_points(word: &str) -> Vec<usize> {
    let chars: Vec<char> = word.chars().collect();
    let n = chars.len();
    if n < 5 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let lower: String = chars.iter().collect::<String>().to_lowercase();
    let mut set = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();

    const PREFIXES: &[&str] = &[
        "be",
        "ge",
        "ver",
        "zer",
        "er",
        "emp",
        "ent",
        "auf",
        "aus",
        "ein",
        "über",
        "examination",
        "voll",
        "teil",
        "haus",
        "grund",
        "haupt",
        "neben",
        "zwischen",
    ];
    for p in PREFIXES {
        if lower.starts_with(p) && n > p.len() + 4 {
            set.insert(p.len());
        }
    }

    const SUFFIXES: &[&str] = &[
        "ierung", "schaft", "heit", "keit", "chen", "lein", "ieren", "isch", "lich", "los", "bar",
        "sam", "haft", "nis", "tum", "ung", "ion",
    ];
    for s in SUFFIXES {
        if let Some(pos) = lower.find(s) {
            if pos >= 3 && pos + s.len() < n {
                set.insert(pos);
            }
        }
    }

    for i in 2..n.saturating_sub(3) {
        let a = chars[i - 1];
        let b = chars[i];
        if is_vowel(a) != is_vowel(b) {
            set.insert(i);
        }
    }

    set.into_iter()
        .filter(|&i| i >= 2 && i <= n.saturating_sub(3))
        .collect()
}

fn pack_word_at_hyphen_points(word: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {
    let chars: Vec<char> = word.chars().collect();
    let mut breaks = collect_german_hyphen_points(word);
    breaks.sort_unstable();
    breaks.dedup();

    if breaks.is_empty() {
        return vec![word.to_string()];
    }

    let mut syllables: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut start = 0usize;
    for b in breaks {
        if b > start && b <= chars.len() {
            syllables.push(chars[start..b].iter().collect());
            start = b;
        }
    }
    if start < chars.len() {
        syllables.push(chars[start..].iter().collect());
    }
    if syllables.is_empty() {
        return vec![word.to_string()];
    }

    let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut current = String::new();
    for (idx, syl) in syllables.iter().enumerate() {
        let is_last = idx + 1 == syllables.len();
        let piece = if current.is_empty() {
            syl.clone()
        } else {
            format!("{current}{syl}")
        };
        let with_hyphen = if is_last {
            piece.clone()
        } else {
            format!("{piece}-")
        };
        if char_len(&with_hyphen) <= width {
            current = with_hyphen;
        } else if current.is_empty() {
            lines.push(with_hyphen);
            current.clear();
        } else {
            lines.push(current);
            current = if is_last {
                syl.clone()
            } else {
                format!("{syl}-")
            };
        }
    }
    if !current.is_empty() {
        lines.push(current);
    }
    if lines.is_empty() {
        lines.push(word.to_string());
    }
    lines
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Format-Helfer
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` → DIN `DD.MM.YYYY`. Other inputs returned unchanged.
pub fn format_date_dmy(iso: &str) -> String {
    let d = iso.trim();
    if d.len() >= 10 && d.as_bytes().get(4) == Some(&b'-') && d.as_bytes().get(7) == Some(&b'-') {
        return format!("{}.{}.{}", &d[8..10], &d[5..7], &d[0..4]);
    }
    d.to_string()
}

/// Cent value → "1.234,56 EUR" (DIN-style, ASCII — Helvetica has no reliable € glyph).
pub fn format_eur(cents: i64) -> String {
    let neg = cents < 0;
    let version = cents.abs();
    let euros = version / 100;
    let frac = version % 100;
    let mut grouped = String::new();
    let s = euros.to_string();
    for (i, ch) in s.chars().rev().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 && i % 3 == 0 {
            grouped.push('.');
        }
        grouped.push(ch);
    }
    let euros_de: String = grouped.chars().rev().collect();
    format!("{}{},{:02} EUR", if neg { "-" } else { "" }, euros_de, frac)
}

/// Make money / label text safe for Helvetica WinAnsi (no zero-width €, no NBSP).
pub fn sanitize_pdf_money(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len() + 4);
    let chars: Vec<char> = s.chars().collect();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < chars.len() {
        let c = chars[i];
        match c {
            '€' => {
                // Prefer "12.34 EUR" / "EUR 12.34" over a broken € glyph.
                let prev = out.chars().last();
                if prev.map(|p| p.is_ascii_digit()).unwrap_or(false) {
                    if prev != Some(' ') {
                        out.push(' ');
                    }
                    out.push_str("EUR");
                } else {
                    out.push_str("EUR");
                    let next = chars.get(i + 1).copied();
                    if next.map(|n| n.is_ascii_digit()).unwrap_or(false) {
                        out.push(' ');
                    }
                }
            }
            '\u{00A0}' | '\u{202F}' | '\u{2007}' | '\u{2009}' => out.push(' '),
            '\u{2212}' => out.push('-'),
            other => out.push(other),
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    out.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ")
}

/// Truncate a cell so it fits a table field (with `...` ellipsis).
pub fn truncate_cell(s: &str, max_chars: usize) -> String {
    let count = s.chars().count();
    if count <= max_chars {
        return s.to_string();
    }
    let mut t: String = s.chars().take(max_chars.saturating_sub(1)).collect();
    t.push('…');
    t
}

//! GOZ / GOÄ fee calculation and invoice validation (GOZ §§ 2, 5, 6, 9, 10;
//! UStG § 14 (4)).
//!
//! Every issued invoice goes through [`validate_invoice`] **on the server**.
//! Amounts sent by the frontend are recomputed from points × Punktwert ×
//! factor and rejected when they disagree, so a manipulated DTO cannot
//! produce an "official" invoice with wrong fees.

use super::core::is_winansi_renderable;
use super::invoice_goz::{FeeSchedule, Invoice, InvoiceKind, InvoiceLine};
use crate::error::AppError;

/// GOZ Punktwert in 1/100000 cent (5,62421 Cent, § 5 Abs. 1 GOZ).
pub const GOZ_PUNKTWERT_E5: i64 = 562_421;
/// GOÄ Punktwert in 1/100000 cent (5,82873 Cent, § 5 Abs. 1 GOÄ).
/// Update here when the GOÄ reform takes effect.
pub const GOAE_PUNKTWERT_E5: i64 = 582_873;

/// Threshold factor that requires a written justification (§ 5 Abs. 2 / § 10 Abs. 3 GOZ).
pub const FACTOR_JUSTIFICATION_THRESHOLD: f64 = 2.3;
/// Highest factor without a § 2 agreement.
pub const FACTOR_MAX_WITHOUT_AGREEMENT: f64 = 3.5;
/// Single expense above which a receipt must be attached (§ 10 Abs. 2 Nr. 5 GOZ).
pub const EXPENSE_RECEIPT_THRESHOLD_CENTS: i64 = 2_556;

/// Fee for one unit in cents: points × Punktwert × factor, rounded half-up.
pub fn unit_fee_cents(schedule: FeeSchedule, points: u32, factor: f64) -> i64 {
    let pw = match schedule {
        FeeSchedule::Goae => GOAE_PUNKTWERT_E5,
        _ => GOZ_PUNKTWERT_E5,
    };
    // Factor with up to 2 decimals → integer hundredths to avoid f64 drift.
    let factor_x100 = (factor * 100.0).round() as i64;
    let raw = i64::from(points) * pw * factor_x100; // cents × 1e5 × 100
    let denom = 100_000 * 100;
    (raw + denom / 2) / denom
}

/// Expected line amount (unit fee × quantity) for fee lines.
pub fn expected_line_cents(line: &InvoiceLine) -> Option<i64> {
    if !line.fee_schedule.is_fee() {
        return None;
    }
    let points = line.points?;
    let factor = line.factor?;
    let qty = i64::from(line.quantity.unwrap_or(1).max(1));
    Some(unit_fee_cents(line.fee_schedule, points, factor) * qty)
}

/// Totals per VAT rate (net, tax) plus grand total — all in cents.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct InvoiceTotals {
    pub fees_goz: i64,
    pub fees_goae: i64,
    pub material: i64,
    pub lab: i64,
    pub other: i64,
    /// (rate in percent × 100, net cents, tax cents) for every rate > 0.
    pub vat_groups: Vec<(i64, i64, i64)>,
    pub net: i64,
    pub tax: i64,
    pub gross: i64,
}

pub fn compute_totals(inv: &Invoice) -> InvoiceTotals {
    let mut t = InvoiceTotals::default();
    let mut groups: std::collections::BTreeMap<i64, i64> = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
    for l in &inv.lines {
        match l.fee_schedule {
            FeeSchedule::Goz => t.fees_goz += l.amount_cents,
            FeeSchedule::Goae => t.fees_goae += l.amount_cents,
            FeeSchedule::Material => t.material += l.amount_cents,
            FeeSchedule::Lab => t.lab += l.amount_cents,
            FeeSchedule::Other => t.other += l.amount_cents,
        }
        t.net += l.amount_cents;
        let rate = (l.vat_percent.unwrap_or(0.0) * 100.0).round() as i64;
        if rate > 0 {
            *groups.entry(rate).or_default() += l.amount_cents;
        }
    }
    for (rate, net) in groups {
        // Tax per rate, rounded half away from zero (works for cancellations too).
        let tax = (net * rate + net.signum() * 5_000) / 10_000;
        t.tax += tax;
        t.vat_groups.push((rate, net, tax));
    }
    t.gross = t.net + t.tax;
    t
}

fn is_iso_date(s: &str) -> bool {
    chrono::NaiveDate::parse_from_str(s.get(..10).unwrap_or(""), "%Y-%m-%d").is_ok()
}

fn blank(s: &Option<String>) -> bool {
    s.as_deref().map(|x| x.trim().is_empty()).unwrap_or(true)
}

/// Validate an invoice before it is numbered, stored and rendered.
/// Returns all problems at once (German, shown to the user).
pub fn validate_invoice(inv: &Invoice) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let mut errs: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let cancellation = inv.kind == InvoiceKind::Cancellation;

    if inv.number.trim().is_empty() {
        errs.push("Rechnungsnummer fehlt.".into());
    }
    if !is_iso_date(&inv.date) {
        errs.push("Rechnungsdatum fehlt oder ist ungültig (JJJJ-MM-TT).".into());
    }
    if inv.practice_name.trim().is_empty() || inv.practice_address.is_empty() {
        errs.push("Name und Anschrift der Praxis fehlen (§ 14 Abs. 4 Nr. 1 UStG).".into());
    }
    if inv.recipient_name.trim().is_empty() || inv.recipient_address.is_empty() {
        errs.push("Name und Anschrift des Rechnungsempfängers fehlen.".into());
    }
    if inv.lines.is_empty() {
        errs.push("Die Rechnung enthält keine Positionen.".into());
    }
    let has_fees = inv.lines.iter().any(|l| l.fee_schedule.is_fee());
    if has_fees && (inv.patient_name.trim().is_empty() || blank(&inv.patient_birth_date)) {
        errs.push("Name und Geburtsdatum der behandelten Person fehlen.".into());
    }
    if cancellation && blank(&inv.cancels_number) {
        errs.push("Stornorechnung ohne Bezug auf die ursprüngliche Rechnungsnummer.".into());
    }

    for (i, l) in inv.lines.iter().enumerate() {
        let pos = i + 1;
        if l.description.trim().is_empty() {
            errs.push(format!("Pos. {pos}: Leistungsbeschreibung fehlt."));
        }
        if blank(&l.treatment_date) || !is_iso_date(l.treatment_date.as_deref().unwrap_or("")) {
            errs.push(format!(
                "Pos. {pos}: Datum der Leistungserbringung fehlt (§ 10 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 GOZ)."
            ));
        }
        if !cancellation && l.amount_cents <= 0 {
            errs.push(format!("Pos. {pos}: Betrag muss größer als 0 sein."));
        }
        if cancellation && l.amount_cents >= 0 {
            errs.push(format!("Pos. {pos}: Stornopositionen müssen negativ sein."));
        }

        if l.fee_schedule.is_fee() {
            if blank(&l.goz_nr) {
                errs.push(format!("Pos. {pos}: Gebührennummer fehlt."));
            }
            match l.factor {
                None => errs.push(format!("Pos. {pos}: Steigerungsfaktor fehlt.")),
                Some(f) if f < 1.0 => errs.push(format!("Pos. {pos}: Faktor unter 1,0 ist unzulässig.")),
                Some(f) if f > FACTOR_MAX_WITHOUT_AGREEMENT && blank(&l.agreement_ref) => errs.push(format!(
                    "Pos. {pos}: Faktor {f:.1} über 3,5 nur mit Vereinbarung nach § 2 Abs. 1 und 2 GOZ."
                )),
                Some(f) if f > FACTOR_JUSTIFICATION_THRESHOLD && blank(&l.diagnosis_reason) => errs.push(format!(
                    "Pos. {pos}: Faktor {f:.1} über 2,3 erfordert eine schriftliche Begründung (§ 10 Abs. 3 GOZ)."
                )),
                _ => {}
            }
            match (l.points, expected_line_cents(l)) {
                (None, _) => errs.push(format!("Pos. {pos}: Punktzahl fehlt.")),
                (Some(_), Some(expected)) => {
                    if (l.amount_cents.abs() - expected).abs() > 1 {
                        errs.push(format!(
                            "Pos. {pos}: Betrag {} Cent passt nicht zu Punktzahl × Punktwert × Faktor ({} Cent).",
                            l.amount_cents, expected
                        ));
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
            if l.analog_of.is_some() && l.fee_schedule != FeeSchedule::Goz {
                errs.push(format!(
                    "Pos. {pos}: Analogberechnung nach § 6 Abs. 1 nur für GOZ-Positionen."
                ));
            }
        } else if matches!(l.fee_schedule, FeeSchedule::Material | FeeSchedule::Lab)
            && l.amount_cents.abs() > EXPENSE_RECEIPT_THRESHOLD_CENTS
            && !l.receipt_attached
        {
            errs.push(format!(
                "Pos. {pos}: Auslage über 25,56 EUR – Beleg muss beigefügt werden (§ 10 Abs. 2 Nr. 5 GOZ)."
            ));
        }
    }

    let taxable = inv.lines.iter().any(|l| l.vat_percent.unwrap_or(0.0) > 0.0);
    if taxable && blank(&inv.tax_number) && blank(&inv.vat_id) {
        errs.push("Umsatzsteuerpflichtige Positionen: Steuernummer oder USt-IdNr. fehlt (§ 14 Abs. 4 Nr. 2 UStG).".into());
    }
    if !taxable && blank(&inv.vat_notice) {
        errs.push("Hinweis auf die Steuerbefreiung fehlt (z. B. § 4 Nr. 14 UStG).".into());
    }

    // Everything printed must be representable in the PDF fonts.
    let mut texts: Vec<&str> = vec![&inv.recipient_name, &inv.practice_name, &inv.patient_name];
    texts.extend(inv.recipient_address.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()));
    texts.extend(inv.practice_address.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()));
    texts.extend(inv.lines.iter().map(|l| l.description.as_str()));
    texts.extend(
        inv.lines
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|l| l.diagnosis_reason.as_deref()),
    );
    if texts.iter().any(|t| !is_winansi_renderable(t)) {
        errs.push(
            "Text enthält Zeichen, die im PDF nicht darstellbar sind (nur lateinische Schrift)."
                .into(),
        );
    }

    if errs.is_empty() {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(AppError::Validation(errs.join("\n")))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn goz_0010_at_2_3_is_12_94() {
        // GOZ 0010 = 100 points; 100 × 5.62421 ct × 2.3 = 1293.57 ct → 12,94 EUR.
        assert_eq!(unit_fee_cents(FeeSchedule::Goz, 100, 2.3), 1294);
    }

    #[test]
    fn goz_factor_one_rounding() {
        // 100 × 5.62421 = 562.421 → 5,62 EUR.
        assert_eq!(unit_fee_cents(FeeSchedule::Goz, 100, 1.0), 562);
    }

    #[test]
    fn vat_groups_and_gross() {
        let inv = Invoice {
            lines: vec![
                InvoiceLine {
                    amount_cents: 10_000,
                    vat_percent: Some(19.0),
                    fee_schedule: FeeSchedule::Lab,
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                InvoiceLine {
                    amount_cents: 5_000,
                    ..Default::default()
                },
            ],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let t = compute_totals(&inv);
        assert_eq!(t.vat_groups, vec![(1900, 10_000, 1_900)]);
        assert_eq!(t.gross, 16_900);
    }
}

//! Dental invoice (Liquidation) in the structure of **Anlage 2 GOZ**.
//!
//! Columns: Datum | Region/Zahn | Nr. | Leistungsbeschreibung | Anz. | Faktor | Betrag EUR,
//! grouped into GOZ fees, GOÄ fees, § 9 expenses (material, external lab),
//! each with a subtotal; then net/VAT per rate (UStG § 14 Abs. 4 Nr. 7–8)
//! and the amount due. The document language is always German.
//!
//! The model is (de)serialisable so the issued invoice can be stored
//! verbatim in `issued_document.payload_json` and re-rendered later.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use super::core::{
    emit_pdf_document, format_date_dmy, format_eur, PageBuilder, PdfDocMeta, M_BOTTOM, M_LEFT,
    M_RIGHT,
};
use super::goz::{compute_totals, FACTOR_JUSTIFICATION_THRESHOLD};
use super::letterhead::{emit_letterhead, Letterhead, MetaRow};
use super::logo::PdfLogo;
use super::metrics::wrap_to_width;
use crate::error::AppError;

/// Which fee schedule / expense group a line belongs to.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum FeeSchedule {
    #[default]
    Goz,
    Goae,
    /// § 9 GOZ — practice material.
    Material,
    /// § 9 GOZ — external laboratory.
    Lab,
    /// Other non-fee items (e.g. Wegegeld § 8).
    Other,
}

impl FeeSchedule {
    pub fn is_fee(self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, FeeSchedule::Goz | FeeSchedule::Goae)
    }

    fn heading(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            FeeSchedule::Goz => "Honorar nach GOZ",
            FeeSchedule::Goae => "Honorar nach GOÄ",
            FeeSchedule::Material => "Auslagen nach § 9 GOZ – Material",
            FeeSchedule::Lab => "Auslagen nach § 9 GOZ – Fremdlabor",
            FeeSchedule::Other => "Sonstige Positionen",
        }
    }

    const ORDER: [FeeSchedule; 5] = [
        FeeSchedule::Goz,
        FeeSchedule::Goae,
        FeeSchedule::Material,
        FeeSchedule::Lab,
        FeeSchedule::Other,
    ];
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum InvoiceKind {
    #[default]
    Invoice,
    /// Stornorechnung — negative amounts, references the original number.
    Cancellation,
}

/// One invoice line.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct InvoiceLine {
    /// Service description (understandable wording, § 10 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 GOZ).
    pub description: String,
    /// Line amount in cents (unit fee × quantity, net).
    pub amount_cents: i64,
    /// Fee number ("0010", "2197", GOÄ "Ä1").
    pub goz_nr: Option<String>,
    /// Increase factor.
    pub factor: Option<f64>,
    /// Unit price in cents (informational).
    pub unit_price_cents: Option<i64>,
    pub quantity: Option<i32>,
    /// Tooth / region (FDI).
    pub tooth_nr: Option<String>,
    /// ISO date of the service.
    pub treatment_date: Option<String>,
    /// VAT rate in percent (0 = exempt).
    pub vat_percent: Option<f64>,
    /// Kind of material (shown as sub-line).
    pub material: Option<String>,
    /// Justification for factor > 2.3 (§ 10 Abs. 3 GOZ).
    pub diagnosis_reason: Option<String>,
    pub fee_schedule: FeeSchedule,
    /// Points of the fee number — used to recompute the amount.
    pub points: Option<u32>,
    /// Analog billing (§ 6 Abs. 1 GOZ): number of the service the fee is
    /// taken from. `goz_nr` then holds the analog number.
    pub analog_of: Option<String>,
    /// Reference to an agreement under § 2 Abs. 1 und 2 GOZ (factor > 3.5).
    pub agreement_ref: Option<String>,
    /// Receipt for expenses above 25,56 EUR is attached.
    pub receipt_attached: bool,
}

impl InvoiceLine {
    /// Construct a minimal line (all GOZ fields empty).
    pub fn simple(description: impl Into<String>, amount_cents: i64) -> Self {
        Self {
            description: description.into(),
            amount_cents,
            fee_schedule: FeeSchedule::Other,
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }
}

/// Complete invoice (UStG § 14 Abs. 4 + GOZ § 10).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct Invoice {
    pub kind: InvoiceKind,
    pub number: String,
    /// ISO issue date.
    pub date: String,
    pub recipient_name: String,
    pub recipient_address: Vec<String>,
    /// Treated person (may differ from the recipient, e.g. a child).
    pub patient_name: String,
    /// ISO date of birth of the treated person.
    pub patient_birth_date: Option<String>,
    pub practice_name: String,
    pub practice_address: Vec<String>,
    /// Full letterhead (name, address, contact, BSNR/ZANR), filled by the
    /// server. When empty, it is built from name + address + ids.
    pub practice_lines: Vec<String>,
    /// DIN footer (identity, chamber, tax no., bank), filled by the server.
    pub footer_lines: Vec<String>,
    pub lines: Vec<InvoiceLine>,
    pub note: Option<String>,
    pub clinician_name: Option<String>,
    pub clinician_zanr: Option<String>,
    pub practice_bsnr: Option<String>,
    /// Steuernummer.
    pub tax_number: Option<String>,
    /// USt-IdNr.
    pub vat_id: Option<String>,
    pub bank_details: Option<Vec<String>>,
    pub payment_terms_text: Option<String>,
    /// Exemption notice, e.g. "Umsatzsteuerfrei gem. § 4 Nr. 14 UStG".
    pub vat_notice: Option<String>,
    /// Original invoice number (cancellations).
    pub cancels_number: Option<String>,
    /// Original invoice date (cancellations).
    pub cancels_date: Option<String>,
    /// "ENTWURF" (preview) / "KOPIE" (reprint) — never stored.
    #[serde(skip)]
    pub watermark: Option<String>,
    #[serde(skip)]
    pub logo: Option<PdfLogo>,
    /// Kept for API compatibility; GOZ invoices are always German.
    pub locale: String,
    pub rtl: bool,
}

impl Invoice {
    /// Gross total (net + VAT) in cents.
    pub fn total_cents(&self) -> i64 {
        compute_totals(self).gross
    }

    fn service_period(&self) -> Option<String> {
        let mut dates: Vec<&str> = self
            .lines
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|l| l.treatment_date.as_deref())
            .filter(|d| d.len() >= 10)
            .map(|d| &d[..10])
            .collect();
        dates.sort_unstable();
        let first = *dates.first()?;
        let last = *dates.last()?;
        Some(if first == last {
            format_date_dmy(first)
        } else {
            format!("{} – {}", format_date_dmy(first), format_date_dmy(last))
        })
    }
}

/// "12,94" (German decimal comma, thousands dot, no currency).
pub fn fmt_amount(cents: i64) -> String {
    format_eur(cents).trim_end_matches(" EUR").to_string()
}

fn fmt_factor(f: f64) -> String {
    let s = if ((f * 100.0).round() as i64) % 10 == 0 {
        format!("{f:.1}")
    } else {
        format!("{f:.2}")
    };
    s.replace('.', ",")
}

// Column layout relative to M_LEFT (content width 467 pt).
const X_DATE: i32 = M_LEFT;
const X_REGION: i32 = M_LEFT + 54;
const X_NR: i32 = M_LEFT + 88;
const X_DESC: i32 = M_LEFT + 130;
const DESC_W: i32 = 186;
const X_QTY_R: i32 = M_LEFT + 346;
const X_FACTOR_R: i32 = M_LEFT + 390;
const X_AMOUNT_R: i32 = M_RIGHT;
const ROW_FS: i32 = 8;
const ROW_STEP: i32 = 10;

fn emit_table_header(pb: &mut PageBuilder) {
    pb.table_header_band(M_LEFT, pb.y + 2, M_RIGHT - M_LEFT);
    pb.text(X_DATE + 2, 8, true, "Datum");
    pb.text(X_REGION, 8, true, "Region");
    pb.text(X_NR, 8, true, "Nr.");
    pb.text(X_DESC, 8, true, "Leistungsbeschreibung");
    pb.text_right(X_QTY_R, 8, true, "Anz.");
    pb.text_right(X_FACTOR_R, 8, true, "Faktor");
    pb.text_right(X_AMOUNT_R - 2, 8, true, "Betrag EUR");
    pb.advance(10);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(11);
}

/// All text lines of the description column for one invoice line.
fn description_lines(line: &InvoiceLine) -> Vec<(String, bool)> {
    let w = f64::from(DESC_W);
    let mut out: Vec<(String, bool)> = wrap_to_width(&line.description, ROW_FS, false, w)
        .into_iter()
        .map(|s| (s, false))
        .collect();
    let mut sub = |text: String| {
        for s in wrap_to_width(&text, 7, false, w) {
            out.push((s, true));
        }
    };
    if let Some(orig) = line.analog_of.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        sub(format!("entsprechend Nr. {orig} gem. § 6 Abs. 1 GOZ"));
    }
    if let Some(m) = line.material.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        sub(format!("Art der Auslage: {m}"));
    }
    if line.receipt_attached {
        sub("Beleg liegt bei.".into());
    }
    if let Some(reason) = line
        .diagnosis_reason
        .as_deref()
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
    {
        let label = if line.factor.unwrap_or(0.0) > FACTOR_JUSTIFICATION_THRESHOLD {
            "Begründung (§ 10 Abs. 3 GOZ)"
        } else {
            "Hinweis"
        };
        sub(format!("{label}: {reason}"));
    }
    if let Some(a) = line
        .agreement_ref
        .as_deref()
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
    {
        sub(format!("Vereinbarung gem. § 2 Abs. 1 und 2 GOZ: {a}"));
    }
    out
}

fn emit_line(pb: &mut PageBuilder, line: &InvoiceLine) {
    let desc = description_lines(line);
    let height = desc.len() as i32 * ROW_STEP + 4;
    // Whole row must fit — otherwise new page with repeated header.
    if pb.y - height < M_BOTTOM + 6 {
        pb.break_page();
        emit_table_header(pb);
    }
    let top = pb.y;
    let date = line
        .treatment_date
        .as_deref()
        .map(format_date_dmy)
        .unwrap_or_default();
    pb.text(X_DATE + 2, ROW_FS, false, &date);
    pb.text(
        X_REGION,
        ROW_FS,
        false,
        line.tooth_nr.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
    );
    let nr = match (&line.goz_nr, line.analog_of.is_some()) {
        (Some(n), true) => format!("{n}a"),
        (Some(n), false) => n.clone(),
        (None, _) => String::new(),
    };
    pb.text(X_NR, ROW_FS, false, &nr);
    if line.fee_schedule.is_fee() {
        pb.text_right(
            X_QTY_R,
            ROW_FS,
            false,
            &line.quantity.unwrap_or(1).to_string(),
        );
        if let Some(f) = line.factor {
            pb.text_right(X_FACTOR_R, ROW_FS, false, &fmt_factor(f));
        }
    }
    pb.text_right(
        X_AMOUNT_R - 2,
        ROW_FS,
        false,
        &fmt_amount(line.amount_cents),
    );
    for (i, (text, small)) in desc.iter().enumerate() {
        pb.y = top - i as i32 * ROW_STEP;
        pb.text(X_DESC, if *small { 7 } else { ROW_FS }, false, text);
    }
    pb.y = top - height;
}

fn emit_sum_row(pb: &mut PageBuilder, label: &str, cents: i64, bold: bool, rule: bool) {
    pb.ensure_space(20);
    if rule {
        pb.hline(M_LEFT + 250, M_RIGHT);
        pb.advance(11);
    }
    pb.text_right(X_FACTOR_R, 9, bold, label);
    pb.text_right(X_AMOUNT_R - 2, 9, bold, &fmt_amount(cents));
    pb.advance(13);
}

/// Render an invoice (or cancellation invoice). Call [`super::goz::validate_invoice`]
/// first — the issuing service does this before allocating the number.
pub fn render_goz_invoice(inv: &Invoice) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    let cancellation = inv.kind == InvoiceKind::Cancellation;
    let totals = compute_totals(inv);
    let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
    pb.watermark = inv.watermark.clone();

    // ---- Letterhead -------------------------------------------------------
    let mut practice = if inv.practice_lines.is_empty() {
        vec![inv.practice_name.clone()]
    } else {
        inv.practice_lines.clone()
    };
    if inv.practice_lines.is_empty() {
        practice.extend(inv.practice_address.iter().cloned());
        let ids: Vec<String> = [
            inv.practice_bsnr.as_deref().map(|b| format!("BSNR {b}")),
            inv.clinician_zanr.as_deref().map(|z| format!("ZANR {z}")),
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .filter(|s| s.len() > 5)
        .collect();
        if !ids.is_empty() {
            practice.push(ids.join(" · "));
        }
    }

    let mut meta = vec![
        MetaRow::new(
            if cancellation {
                "Storno-Nr."
            } else {
                "Rechnungs-Nr."
            },
            &inv.number,
        ),
        MetaRow::new("Rechnungsdatum", format_date_dmy(&inv.date)),
    ];
    if let Some(p) = inv.service_period() {
        meta.push(MetaRow::new("Leistungszeitraum", p));
    }
    if !inv.patient_name.trim().is_empty() {
        let dob = inv
            .patient_birth_date
            .as_deref()
            .map(|d| format!(", geb. {}", format_date_dmy(d)))
            .unwrap_or_default();
        meta.push(MetaRow::new(
            "Behandelte Person",
            format!("{}{dob}", inv.patient_name),
        ));
    }
    if let Some(c) = inv
        .clinician_name
        .as_deref()
        .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
    {
        meta.push(MetaRow::new("Behandler/in", c));
    }

    let mut recipient = vec![inv.recipient_name.clone()];
    recipient.extend(inv.recipient_address.iter().cloned());

    let lh = Letterhead {
        practice_lines: &practice,
        meta_rows: &meta,
        address_lines: &recipient,
        show_sender_hint: true,
        logo: inv.logo.as_ref(),
        rtl: false,
        locale: "de",
        ..Default::default()
    };
    emit_letterhead(&mut pb, &lh);

    // DIN footer: identity, tax, bank on every page.
    let mut footer = if !inv.footer_lines.is_empty() {
        inv.footer_lines.clone()
    } else {
        Vec::new()
    };
    if footer.is_empty() {
        footer.push(format!(
            "{} · {}",
            inv.practice_name,
            inv.practice_address.join(", ")
        ));
        let tax: Vec<String> = [
            inv.tax_number.as_deref().map(|t| format!("Steuer-Nr. {t}")),
            inv.vat_id.as_deref().map(|v| format!("USt-IdNr. {v}")),
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .collect();
        if !tax.is_empty() {
            footer.push(tax.join(" · "));
        }
        if let Some(bank) = inv.bank_details.as_ref().filter(|b| !b.is_empty()) {
            footer.push(bank.join(" · "));
        }
    }
    pb.footer_lines.extend(footer);

    let title = if cancellation {
        "Stornorechnung"
    } else {
        "Rechnung"
    };
    pb.set_continuation(&inv.practice_name, &format!("{title} {}", inv.number), "de");

    // ---- Title --------------------------------------------------------------
    pb.text(M_LEFT, 16, true, title);
    pb.advance(18);
    let has_goz = inv.lines.iter().any(|l| l.fee_schedule == FeeSchedule::Goz);
    let has_goae = inv
        .lines
        .iter()
        .any(|l| l.fee_schedule == FeeSchedule::Goae);
    let basis = match (has_goz, has_goae) {
        (true, true) => "Liquidation nach GOZ und GOÄ",
        (true, false) => "Liquidation nach der Gebührenordnung für Zahnärzte (GOZ)",
        (false, true) => "Liquidation nach der Gebührenordnung für Ärzte (GOÄ)",
        _ => "",
    };
    if !basis.is_empty() {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, false, basis);
        pb.advance(14);
    }
    if cancellation {
        let orig = inv.cancels_number.as_deref().unwrap_or("-");
        let date = inv
            .cancels_date
            .as_deref()
            .map(|d| format!(" vom {}", format_date_dmy(d)))
            .unwrap_or_default();
        pb.wrapped(
            M_LEFT,
            9,
            false,
            &format!("Diese Stornorechnung hebt die Rechnung Nr. {orig}{date} vollständig auf."),
            M_RIGHT - M_LEFT,
        );
    }
    pb.advance(4);

    // ---- Table, grouped by schedule ---------------------------------------
    emit_table_header(&mut pb);
    for schedule in FeeSchedule::ORDER {
        let lines: Vec<&InvoiceLine> = inv
            .lines
            .iter()
            .filter(|l| l.fee_schedule == schedule)
            .collect();
        if lines.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        pb.ensure_space(30);
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 8, true, schedule.heading());
        pb.advance(11);
        let mut sum = 0;
        for l in lines {
            emit_line(&mut pb, l);
            sum += l.amount_cents;
        }
        emit_sum_row(
            &mut pb,
            &format!("Zwischensumme {}", short_label(schedule)),
            sum,
            false,
            true,
        );
        pb.advance(4);
    }

    // ---- Totals --------------------------------------------------------------
    pb.ensure_space(70);
    pb.advance(4);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT + 250, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(3);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT + 250, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(13);
    let total_label = if cancellation { "Stornobetrag" } else { "Rechnungsbetrag" };
    if totals.vat_groups.is_empty() {
        emit_sum_row(&mut pb, total_label, totals.gross, true, false);
    } else {
        emit_sum_row(&mut pb, "Nettobetrag", totals.net, false, false);
        for (rate, net, tax) in &totals.vat_groups {
            let rate_s = fmt_factor(*rate as f64 / 100.0)
                .trim_end_matches(",0")
                .to_string();
            emit_sum_row(
                &mut pb,
                &format!("zzgl. {rate_s} % USt auf {}", fmt_amount(*net)),
                *tax,
                false,
                false,
            );
        }
        emit_sum_row(&mut pb, total_label, totals.gross, true, true);
    }

    // ---- Notices -------------------------------------------------------------
    pb.advance(6);
    let width = M_RIGHT - M_LEFT;
    let exempt_part = inv
        .lines
        .iter()
        .any(|l| l.vat_percent.unwrap_or(0.0) <= 0.0);
    if exempt_part {
        if let Some(n) = inv.vat_notice.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
            let text = if totals.vat_groups.is_empty() {
                n.to_string()
            } else {
                format!("Positionen ohne USt-Ausweis: {n}")
            };
            pb.wrapped(M_LEFT, 9, false, &text, width);
        }
    }
    if !cancellation {
        if let Some(t) = inv
            .payment_terms_text
            .as_deref()
            .filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())
        {
            pb.wrapped(M_LEFT, 9, false, t, width);
        }
        // Payment details in the body, not only in the footer, so the
        // patient can transfer without searching the small print.
        if let Some(bank) = inv.bank_details.as_ref().filter(|b| !b.is_empty()) {
            pb.advance(4);
            pb.wrapped(
                M_LEFT,
                9,
                false,
                &format!(
                    "Bitte überweisen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag unter Angabe der Rechnungsnummer {} auf folgendes Konto:",
                    inv.number
                ),
                width,
            );
            // Holder + bank on one line, IBAN + BIC on the next.
            let (head, tail): (Vec<&String>, Vec<&String>) =
                bank.iter().partition(|l| !l.starts_with("IBAN") && !l.starts_with("BIC"));
            for part in [head, tail] {
                if !part.is_empty() {
                    let line: Vec<&str> = part.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();
                    pb.wrapped(M_LEFT, 9, true, &line.join(" · "), width);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(n) = inv.note.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        pb.advance(4);
        pb.wrapped(M_LEFT, 9, false, n, width);
    }

    let pages = pb.finish();
    let images: Vec<PdfLogo> = inv.logo.clone().into_iter().collect();
    emit_pdf_document(
        &pages,
        &PdfDocMeta {
            title: format!("{title} {}", inv.number),
            subject: Some(inv.number.clone()),
            author: Some(inv.practice_name.clone()),
            locale: "de".into(),
        },
        &images,
    )
}

fn short_label(s: FeeSchedule) -> &'static str {
    match s {
        FeeSchedule::Goz => "GOZ",
        FeeSchedule::Goae => "GOÄ",
        FeeSchedule::Material => "Material",
        FeeSchedule::Lab => "Fremdlabor",
        FeeSchedule::Other => "Sonstiges",
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::super::goz::{unit_fee_cents, validate_invoice};
    use super::*;

    pub fn sample() -> Invoice {
        Invoice {
            number: "RE-2026-000001".into(),
            date: "2026-06-02".into(),
            recipient_name: "Max Muster".into(),
            recipient_address: vec!["Musterweg 1".into(), "10115 Berlin".into()],
            patient_name: "Lena Muster".into(),
            patient_birth_date: Some("2014-03-01".into()),
            practice_name: "Zahnarztpraxis Dr. Beispiel".into(),
            practice_address: vec!["Hauptstraße 2".into(), "10115 Berlin".into()],
            clinician_name: Some("Dr. Maria Beispiel".into()),
            practice_bsnr: Some("123456789".into()),
            clinician_zanr: Some("987654321".into()),
            tax_number: Some("12/345/67890".into()),
            bank_details: Some(vec![
                "IBAN DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00".into(),
                "BIC COBADEFFXXX".into(),
            ]),
            vat_notice: Some("Umsatzsteuerfrei gem. § 4 Nr. 14 UStG.".into()),
            payment_terms_text: Some("Zahlbar innerhalb von 14 Tagen ohne Abzug.".into()),
            lines: vec![
                InvoiceLine {
                    description: "Eingehende Untersuchung".into(),
                    goz_nr: Some("0010".into()),
                    points: Some(100),
                    factor: Some(2.3),
                    amount_cents: unit_fee_cents(FeeSchedule::Goz, 100, 2.3),
                    treatment_date: Some("2026-05-20".into()),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                InvoiceLine {
                    description: "Testposition Füllung, dreiflächig".into(),
                    goz_nr: Some("9999".into()),
                    points: Some(1_000),
                    factor: Some(3.0),
                    amount_cents: unit_fee_cents(FeeSchedule::Goz, 1_000, 3.0),
                    tooth_nr: Some("36".into()),
                    treatment_date: Some("2026-05-27".into()),
                    diagnosis_reason: Some(
                        "Erschwerte Trockenlegung bei subgingivaler Ausdehnung".into(),
                    ),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                InvoiceLine {
                    description: "Komposit-Material".into(),
                    fee_schedule: FeeSchedule::Material,
                    amount_cents: 3_200,
                    material: Some("Komposit, Charge 4711".into()),
                    receipt_attached: true,
                    treatment_date: Some("2026-05-27".into()),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
            ],
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn valid_sample_passes_and_renders_german_form() {
        let inv = sample();
        validate_invoice(&inv).expect("valid");
        let pdf = render_goz_invoice(&inv).unwrap();
        let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&pdf);
        for needle in [
            "Rechnung",
            "Leistungsbeschreibung",
            "Zwischensumme GOZ",
            "Rechnungsbetrag",
            "Behandelte Person",
            "Steuer-Nr. 12/345/67890",
            "Begr\\374ndung",
            "Leistungszeitraum",
        ] {
            assert!(s.contains(needle), "missing {needle}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_factor_above_2_3_without_reason_and_wrong_amount() {
        let mut inv = sample();
        inv.lines[1].diagnosis_reason = None;
        inv.lines[0].amount_cents += 50;
        let err = validate_invoice(&inv).unwrap_err().to_string();
        assert!(err.contains("Begründung"));
        assert!(err.contains("passt nicht"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_missing_patient_dob_and_service_date() {
        let mut inv = sample();
        inv.patient_birth_date = None;
        inv.lines[0].treatment_date = None;
        let err = validate_invoice(&inv).unwrap_err().to_string();
        assert!(err.contains("Geburtsdatum"));
        assert!(err.contains("Leistungserbringung"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn taxable_line_needs_tax_id_and_shows_vat() {
        let mut inv = sample();
        inv.tax_number = None;
        inv.lines[2].vat_percent = Some(19.0);
        assert!(validate_invoice(&inv)
            .unwrap_err()
            .to_string()
            .contains("Steuernummer"));
        inv.tax_number = Some("12/345/67890".into());
        validate_invoice(&inv).unwrap();
        let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&render_goz_invoice(&inv).unwrap()).into_owned();
        assert!(s.contains("zzgl. 19 % USt"));
        assert_eq!(inv.total_cents(), compute_totals(&inv).net + 608);
    }

    #[test]
    fn cancellation_references_original() {
        let mut inv = sample();
        inv.kind = InvoiceKind::Cancellation;
        inv.number = "ST-2026-000001".into();
        inv.cancels_number = Some("RE-2026-000001".into());
        for l in &mut inv.lines {
            l.amount_cents = -l.amount_cents;
        }
        validate_invoice(&inv).unwrap();
        let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&render_goz_invoice(&inv).unwrap()).into_owned();
        assert!(s.contains("Stornorechnung"));
        assert!(s.contains("RE-2026-000001"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn long_invoice_repeats_header_on_every_page() {
        let mut inv = sample();
        let base = inv.lines[0].clone();
        inv.lines = (0..80).map(|_| base.clone()).collect();
        let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&render_goz_invoice(&inv).unwrap()).into_owned();
        let pages = s.matches("/Type /Page ").count();
        assert!(pages >= 3);
        assert_eq!(s.matches("(Leistungsbeschreibung)").count(), pages);
    }
}
