//! DIN-5008-compliant letterhead for all MeDoc documents.
//!
//! Layout (Form A, window-envelope compatible):
//!
//! ```text
//! ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
//! │ Practice name (bold, 12 pt)               ┌───────────────────┐ │
//! │ Street                                    │ Meta block:       │ │
//! │ ZIP City                                  │ Invoice no.       │ │
//! │ Tel · Fax · E-Mail · Web                  │ Date              │ │
//! │ BSNR · ZANR · VAT ID                      │ Provider          │ │
//! │                                           │ Patient no.       │ │
//! │                                           └───────────────────┘ │
//! │ ┌─── Practice · Street · ZIP City (7 pt, small)───────────────┐ │
//! │ │                                                              │ │
//! │ │  Recipient address                                           │ │
//! │ │  (window envelope area, DIN 5008 A, Y 700–572)               │ │
//! │ │                                                              │ │
//! │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
//! │ ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  │
//! │ [Content from Y ≈ 560]                                           │
//! └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
//! ```
//!
//! The letterhead is rendered **once** on the first page; on
//! continuation pages a short **header stub** (practice name + document no.)
//! is used (see [`emit_continuation_header`]).

use super::core::{
    pdf_locale, PageBuilder, ADDRESS_WINDOW_BOTTOM_Y, ADDRESS_WINDOW_Y,
    CONTENT_START_Y, INFO_BLOCK_TOP_Y, INFO_BLOCK_X, LETTERHEAD_MIN_Y, M_LEFT, M_RIGHT, M_TOP,
    SENDER_HINT_Y,
};
use super::logo::PdfLogo;

/// One row of the meta / information block: "label" + "value".
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct MetaRow {
    pub label: String,
    pub value: String,
}

impl MetaRow {
    pub fn new(label: impl Into<String>, value: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            label: label.into(),
            value: value.into(),
        }
    }
}

/// Complete practice letterhead.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Letterhead<'a> {
    /// First line = practice name (bold); further lines = address, contact.
    /// Lines that do not fit into the 45 mm letterhead zone move to the page
    /// footer instead of being dropped.
    pub practice_lines: &'a [String],
    /// Contact extras ("Tel: …"). Only used when `meta_rows` is empty.
    pub header_right_lines: &'a [String],
    /// Information block (invoice no., date, clinician, …).
    pub meta_rows: &'a [MetaRow],
    /// Recipient address in the window-envelope area.
    pub address_lines: &'a [String],
    /// Return-address line in the 45–50 mm zone.
    pub show_sender_hint: bool,
    /// Place the address directly below the header (hand-out documents such
    /// as receipts). No fold marks in this mode.
    pub compact_address: bool,
    /// Practice logo from Settings (`practice.logo.v1`).
    pub logo: Option<&'a PdfLogo>,
    /// Mirrors logo/meta placement. The text itself is still rendered LTR.
    pub rtl: bool,
    /// Document language (`de` | `en` | `fr`; anything else → `de`).
    pub locale: &'a str,
}

/// Render the letterhead (DIN 5008 Form B) on the current page and place
/// `pb.y` below it. Returns the new `pb.y`.
///
/// Layout: practice block top-left (above 45 mm), return-address line at
/// 45–50 mm, address field 62.7–90 mm, information block at x = 125 mm.
/// Without an address field the information block sits top-right.
pub fn emit_letterhead(pb: &mut PageBuilder, lh: &Letterhead) -> i32 {
    pb.locale = pdf_locale(lh.locale);

    let mut text_left = M_LEFT;
    let mut text_right_cap = if lh.address_lines.is_empty() && !lh.meta_rows.is_empty() {
        INFO_BLOCK_X - 10
    } else {
        M_RIGHT
    };
    if let Some(logo) = lh.logo {
        let x = logo.x_for_side(lh.rtl);
        let y = logo.y_bottom(M_TOP);
        pb.draw_image(0, x, y, logo.display_w, logo.display_h);
        text_left = logo.practice_text_left(lh.rtl);
        text_right_cap = text_right_cap.min(logo.practice_text_right_cap(lh.rtl));
    }
    let avail_pt = f64::from((text_right_cap - text_left).max(80));

    // --- 1. Practice block (must stay above 45 mm) --------------------------
    let mut left_y = M_TOP;
    let mut overflow: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for (i, line) in lh.practice_lines.iter().enumerate() {
        let size = if i == 0 { 12 } else { 9 };
        let step = if i == 0 { 14 } else { 11 };
        let chunks = super::metrics::wrap_to_width(line, size, i == 0, avail_pt);
        let needed = step * chunks.len() as i32;
        if left_y - needed < LETTERHEAD_MIN_Y && i > 0 {
            overflow.push(line.clone());
            continue;
        }
        for chunk in chunks {
            pb.y = left_y;
            pb.text(text_left, size, i == 0, &chunk);
            left_y -= step;
        }
    }
    if let Some(logo) = lh.logo {
        left_y = left_y.min(logo.y_bottom(M_TOP) as i32 - 4);
    }
    // Nothing is silently lost: overflow goes into the DIN footer.
    pb.footer_lines.extend(overflow);

    let window_layout = !lh.address_lines.is_empty() && !lh.compact_address;

    // --- 2. Information block / contact -------------------------------------
    let mut right_y = M_TOP;
    if !lh.meta_rows.is_empty() {
        if window_layout {
            // DIN 5008: information block right of the address field.
            emit_info_block(pb, lh.meta_rows, INFO_BLOCK_X, INFO_BLOCK_TOP_Y);
        } else if lh.rtl {
            right_y = emit_info_block(pb, lh.meta_rows, M_LEFT, M_TOP);
        } else {
            right_y = emit_info_block(pb, lh.meta_rows, INFO_BLOCK_X, M_TOP);
        }
    } else {
        for line in lh.header_right_lines.iter().take(5) {
            pb.y = right_y;
            pb.text_right(M_RIGHT, 9, false, line);
            right_y -= 11;
        }
    }
    let header_bottom = left_y.min(right_y);

    // --- 3. Address -----------------------------------------------------------
    let rule_y;
    if lh.address_lines.is_empty() {
        rule_y = header_bottom - 8;
    } else if lh.compact_address {
        let mut addr_y = header_bottom - 16;
        if lh.show_sender_hint {
            let sender = sender_hint_line(lh.practice_lines);
            if !sender.trim().is_empty() {
                pb.y = addr_y;
                pb.text(M_LEFT, 7, false, &sender);
                addr_y -= 12;
            }
        }
        addr_y = emit_address_lines(pb, lh.address_lines, addr_y, i32::MIN);
        rule_y = addr_y - 8;
    } else {
        pb.letter_marks = true;
        if lh.show_sender_hint {
            let sender = sender_hint_line(lh.practice_lines);
            if !sender.trim().is_empty() {
                pb.y = SENDER_HINT_Y;
                // Must fit the 85 mm window width.
                let max = super::core::MM * 80.0;
                let fitted = super::metrics::wrap_to_width(&sender, 7, false, max)
                    .into_iter()
                    .next()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                pb.text(M_LEFT, 7, false, &fitted);
            }
        }
        emit_address_lines(pb, lh.address_lines, ADDRESS_WINDOW_Y, ADDRESS_WINDOW_BOTTOM_Y);
        rule_y = CONTENT_START_Y + 12;
    }

    pb.hline_at(M_LEFT, rule_y, M_RIGHT);
    pb.y = rule_y - 18;
    pb.y
}

fn emit_address_lines(pb: &mut PageBuilder, lines: &[String], start_y: i32, min_y: i32) -> i32 {
    let max_pt = super::core::MM * 80.0;
    let mut y = start_y;
    for (i, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
        let size = if i == 0 { 11 } else { 10 };
        for chunk in super::metrics::wrap_to_width(line, size, false, max_pt) {
            if y < min_y {
                // Address field is full (max ~6 lines per DIN 5008); keep the
                // remaining text on the last line instead of overprinting.
                break;
            }
            pb.y = y;
            pb.text(M_LEFT, size, false, &chunk);
            y -= if size == 11 { 13 } else { 12 };
        }
    }
    y
}

/// Short header for continuation pages.
///
/// [`PageBuilder::break_page`] now draws it automatically once registered,
/// so this only registers + draws on the first call and is a no-op afterwards.
pub fn emit_continuation_header(pb: &mut PageBuilder, practice_name: &str, doc_title: &str) {
    let locale = pb.locale;
    emit_continuation_header_locale(pb, practice_name, doc_title, locale);
}

pub fn emit_continuation_header_locale(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    practice_name: &str,
    doc_title: &str,
    _locale: &str,
) {
    if pb.continuation.is_some() {
        return;
    }
    let locale = pb.locale;
    pb.set_continuation(practice_name, doc_title, locale);
    let cont = match locale {
        "de" => "Fortsetzung",
        "fr" => "suite",
        _ => "continued",
    };
    pb.y = M_TOP;
    pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, true, practice_name);
    pb.text_right(M_RIGHT, 9, false, &format!("{doc_title} ({cont})"));
    pb.y -= 4;
    let y = pb.y;
    pb.hline_at(M_LEFT, y, M_RIGHT);
    pb.y -= 16;
}

/// Information block: label (8 pt) and value (9 pt bold) left-aligned at `x`.
/// Returns the lowest `y` written.
fn emit_info_block(pb: &mut PageBuilder, rows: &[MetaRow], x: i32, start_y: i32) -> i32 {
    let max_pt = f64::from(M_RIGHT - x);
    let mut y = start_y;
    for row in rows {
        pb.y = y;
        pb.text(x, 8, false, &row.label);
        y -= 10;
        for chunk in super::metrics::wrap_to_width(&row.value, 9, true, max_pt) {
            pb.y = y;
            pb.text(x, 9, true, &chunk);
            y -= 11;
        }
        y -= 3;
    }
    y
}

fn sender_hint_line(practice_lines: &[String]) -> String {
    practice_lines
        .iter()
        .take(3)
        .map(|s| s.trim())
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" · ")
}

/// Localised "(Praxisstempel)" label.
pub fn stamp_label(locale: &str) -> &'static str {
    match pdf_locale(locale) {
        "de" => "(Praxisstempel)",
        "fr" => "(Cachet du cabinet)",
        _ => "(Practice stamp)",
    }
}

/// Signature block: line, clinician name, title · ZANR · BSNR, stamp label.
pub fn emit_signature_block(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    clinician_name: Option<&str>,
    professional_title: Option<&str>,
    zanr: Option<&str>,
    bsnr: Option<&str>,
    show_stempel_label: bool,
) {
    pb.ensure_space(90);
    pb.advance(20);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(28);

    let y = pb.y;
    pb.hline_at(M_LEFT, y, M_LEFT + 180);
    pb.advance(14);

    if let Some(n) = clinician_name.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 10, true, n);
        pb.advance(12);
    }

    let mut subline = Vec::new();
    if let Some(b) = professional_title.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        subline.push(b.to_string());
    }
    if let Some(z) = zanr.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        subline.push(format!("ZANR: {z}"));
    }
    if let Some(b) = bsnr.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        subline.push(format!("BSNR: {b}"));
    }
    if !subline.is_empty() {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, false, &subline.join(" · "));
        pb.advance(11);
    }

    if show_stempel_label {
        pb.advance(6);
        let label = stamp_label(pb.locale);
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 8, false, label);
    }
}

/// Bank-details block (prefer [`footer_lines_for_practice`] → page footer).
pub fn emit_bank_details(pb: &mut PageBuilder, lines: &[String]) {
    let locale = pb.locale;
    emit_bank_details_locale(pb, lines, locale);
}

pub fn emit_bank_details_locale(pb: &mut PageBuilder, lines: &[String], locale: &str) {
    if lines.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let title = match pdf_locale(locale) {
        "de" => "Bankverbindung:",
        "fr" => "Coordonnées bancaires :",
        _ => "Bank details:",
    };
    pb.ensure_space(40 + lines.len() as i32 * 11);
    pb.advance(6);
    pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, true, title);
    pb.advance(11);
    for line in lines {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, false, line);
        pb.advance(11);
    }
}

/// DIN 5008 footer content: legal identity, tax and bank details.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct PracticeFooter {
    pub practice_name: String,
    pub tax_number: Option<String>,
    pub vat_id: Option<String>,
    pub iban: Option<String>,
    pub bic: Option<String>,
    pub bank_name: Option<String>,
    pub chamber: Option<String>,
}

/// Build the (max. 3) footer lines for [`PageBuilder::footer_lines`].
pub fn footer_lines_for_practice(f: &PracticeFooter, locale: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let de = pdf_locale(locale) == "de";
    let mut l1 = vec![f.practice_name.trim().to_string()];
    if let Some(c) = f.chamber.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        l1.push(format!("{}: {c}", if de { "Kammer" } else { "Chamber" }));
    }
    let mut l2 = Vec::new();
    if let Some(t) = f.tax_number.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        l2.push(format!("{} {t}", if de { "Steuer-Nr." } else { "Tax no." }));
    }
    if let Some(v) = f.vat_id.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        l2.push(format!("{} {v}", if de { "USt-IdNr." } else { "VAT ID" }));
    }
    let mut l3 = Vec::new();
    if let Some(b) = f.bank_name.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        l3.push(b.to_string());
    }
    if let Some(i) = f.iban.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        l3.push(format!("IBAN {i}"));
    }
    if let Some(b) = f.bic.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        l3.push(format!("BIC {b}"));
    }
    [l1, l2, l3]
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|v| v.iter().any(|s| !s.is_empty()))
        .map(|v| v.join(" · "))
        .collect()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn dummy_practice() -> Vec<String> {
        vec![
            "Dental practice Dr. Sample".into(),
            "Hauptstraße 1".into(),
            "10115 Berlin".into(),
            "Tel: 030/123456".into(),
        ]
    }

    fn dummy_address() -> Vec<String> {
        vec![
            "Max Sample".into(),
            "Sample Street 2".into(),
            "10117 Berlin".into(),
        ]
    }

    #[test]
    fn letterhead_renders_without_panic() {
        let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
        let practice = dummy_practice();
        let addr = dummy_address();
        let meta = vec![
            MetaRow::new("Invoice-Nr.", "RE-2026-001"),
            MetaRow::new("Date", "19.04.2026"),
        ];
        let lh = Letterhead {
            practice_lines: &practice,
            meta_rows: &meta,
            address_lines: &addr,
            header_right_lines: &[],
            show_sender_hint: true,
            compact_address: false,
            logo: None,
            rtl: false,
            locale: "en",
        };
        let y_after = emit_letterhead(&mut pb, &lh);
        assert!(y_after < M_TOP);
        let pages = pb.finish();
        assert_eq!(pages.len(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn letterhead_without_address_compresses() {
        let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
        let practice = dummy_practice();
        let lh = Letterhead {
            practice_lines: &practice,
            meta_rows: &[],
            address_lines: &[],
            header_right_lines: &[],
            show_sender_hint: false,
            compact_address: false,
            logo: None,
            rtl: false,
            locale: "en",
        };
        let y_after = emit_letterhead(&mut pb, &lh);
        // Without an address field the divider must be earlier than DIN-5008 Y560.
        assert!(y_after > 560);
    }

    #[test]
    fn overlong_practice_header_moves_to_footer_not_dropped() {
        let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
        let practice: Vec<String> = (0..12).map(|i| format!("Kopfzeile {i}")).collect();
        let addr = dummy_address();
        let lh = Letterhead {
            practice_lines: &practice,
            address_lines: &addr,
            locale: "de",
            ..Default::default()
        };
        emit_letterhead(&mut pb, &lh);
        assert!(!pb.footer_lines.is_empty());
        assert!(pb.footer_lines.iter().any(|l| l == "Kopfzeile 11"));
        assert!(pb.letter_marks);
    }

    #[test]
    fn footer_lines_contain_tax_and_bank() {
        let lines = footer_lines_for_practice(
            &PracticeFooter {
                practice_name: "Zahnarztpraxis Dr. Test".into(),
                tax_number: Some("12/345/67890".into()),
                iban: Some("DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00".into()),
                ..Default::default()
            },
            "de",
        );
        assert_eq!(lines.len(), 3);
        assert!(lines[1].contains("Steuer-Nr. 12/345/67890"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn continuation_header_writes_practice_and_title() {
        let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
        emit_continuation_header(&mut pb, "Practice A", "Invoice");
        let pages = pb.finish();
        assert!(pages[0].contains("Practice A") || pages[0].contains("Rech"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn signature_block_handles_missing_fields() {
        let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
        pb.y = 200;
        emit_signature_block(&mut pb, None, None, None, None, false);
        let pages = pb.finish();
        // Lines only, no text — should still be valid
        assert_eq!(pages.len(), 1);
    }
}

//! Glyph widths for the two base-14 fonts MeDoc uses (Helvetica, Helvetica-Bold).
//!
//! Values are the advance widths from Adobe's Core14 AFM files (units of
//! 1/1000 em). Replaces the old `chars × 0.52 × size` guess, which made
//! right-aligned amounts and column wrapping drift.
//!
//! When the renderer moves to embedded fonts (PDF/A, Arabic), this module is
//! replaced by the font's own `hmtx` table.

/// Advance width of `ch` in 1/1000 em.
pub fn glyph_width(ch: char, bold: bool) -> u32 {
    let c = ch as u32;
    if (32..=126).contains(&c) {
        let idx = (c - 32) as usize;
        return if bold {
            BOLD_ASCII[idx]
        } else {
            REGULAR_ASCII[idx]
        } as u32;
    }
    // Accented letters share the width of their base letter in Helvetica.
    let base = match ch {
        'ä' | 'à' | 'á' | 'â' | 'å' => Some('a'),
        'Ä' | 'À' | 'Á' | 'Â' | 'Å' => Some('A'),
        'ö' | 'ò' | 'ó' | 'ô' | 'ø' => Some('o'),
        'Ö' | 'Ò' | 'Ó' | 'Ô' | 'Ø' => Some('O'),
        'ü' | 'ù' | 'ú' | 'û' => Some('u'),
        'Ü' | 'Ù' | 'Ú' | 'Û' => Some('U'),
        'é' | 'è' | 'ê' | 'ë' => Some('e'),
        'É' | 'È' | 'Ê' | 'Ë' => Some('E'),
        'í' | 'ì' | 'î' | 'ï' => Some('i'),
        'ç' => Some('c'),
        'Ç' => Some('C'),
        'ñ' => Some('n'),
        'Ñ' => Some('N'),
        'š' => Some('s'),
        'Š' => Some('S'),
        'ž' => Some('z'),
        'Ž' => Some('Z'),
        _ => None,
    };
    if let Some(b) = base {
        return glyph_width(b, bold);
    }
    match ch {
        'ß' => 611,
        '€' => 556,
        '§' => 556,
        '°' => 400,
        '×' | '÷' | '±' => 584,
        '–' => 556,
        '—' | '…' | '‰' => 1000,
        '•' => 350,
        '\u{00A0}' => 278,
        '„' | '“' | '”' => {
            if bold {
                500
            } else {
                333
            }
        }
        '‚' | '‘' | '’' => {
            if bold {
                278
            } else {
                222
            }
        }
        '²' | '³' | '¹' => 333,
        '½' | '¼' | '¾' => 834,
        _ => 556,
    }
}

/// Width of `s` in PDF points at `font_size`.
pub fn text_width_pt(s: &str, font_size: i32, bold: bool) -> f64 {
    let units: u32 = s.chars().map(|c| glyph_width(c, bold)).sum();
    f64::from(units) * f64::from(font_size) / 1000.0
}

/// Largest prefix (in chars) of `s` that fits into `max_pt`.
pub fn fit_chars(s: &str, font_size: i32, bold: bool, max_pt: f64) -> usize {
    let mut acc = 0.0;
    for (i, c) in s.chars().enumerate() {
        acc += f64::from(glyph_width(c, bold)) * f64::from(font_size) / 1000.0;
        if acc > max_pt {
            return i;
        }
    }
    s.chars().count()
}

/// Wrap on whitespace so that every line fits into `max_pt`. Words longer
/// than the line are hard-broken (never silently clipped).
pub fn wrap_to_width(text: &str, font_size: i32, bold: bool, max_pt: f64) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for paragraph in text.split('\n') {
        let trimmed = paragraph.trim_end();
        if trimmed.is_empty() {
            out.push(String::new());
            continue;
        }
        let mut cur = String::new();
        for word in trimmed.split_whitespace() {
            let candidate = if cur.is_empty() {
                word.to_string()
            } else {
                format!("{cur} {word}")
            };
            if text_width_pt(&candidate, font_size, bold) <= max_pt {
                cur = candidate;
                continue;
            }
            if !cur.is_empty() {
                out.push(std::mem::take(&mut cur));
            }
            // Word alone too long → hard break.
            let mut rest: String = word.to_string();
            while text_width_pt(&rest, font_size, bold) > max_pt {
                let n = fit_chars(&rest, font_size, bold, max_pt).max(1);
                let head: String = rest.chars().take(n).collect();
                out.push(head);
                rest = rest.chars().skip(n).collect();
            }
            cur = rest;
        }
        if !cur.is_empty() {
            out.push(cur);
        }
    }
    if out.is_empty() {
        out.push(String::new());
    }
    out
}

#[rustfmt::skip]
const REGULAR_ASCII: [u16; 95] = [
    278, 278, 355, 556, 556, 889, 667, 191, 333, 333, 389, 584, 278, 333, 278, 278, // ' '..'/'
    556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556,                               // 0..9
    278, 278, 584, 584, 584, 556, 1015,                                             // :..@
    667, 667, 722, 722, 667, 611, 778, 722, 278, 500, 667, 556, 833,                // A..M
    722, 778, 667, 778, 722, 667, 611, 722, 667, 944, 667, 667, 611,                // N..Z
    278, 278, 278, 469, 556, 333,                                                   // [..`
    556, 556, 500, 556, 556, 278, 556, 556, 222, 222, 500, 222, 833,                // a..m
    556, 556, 556, 556, 333, 500, 278, 556, 500, 722, 500, 500, 500,                // n..z
    334, 260, 334, 584,                                                             // {..~
];

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn digits_are_tabular() {
        assert_eq!(
            text_width_pt("1111", 10, false),
            text_width_pt("8888", 10, false)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn bold_is_wider_for_lowercase() {
        assert!(text_width_pt("abc", 10, true) > text_width_pt("abc", 10, false));
    }

    #[test]
    fn umlaut_matches_base() {
        assert_eq!(glyph_width('ä', false), glyph_width('a', false));
    }

    #[test]
    fn wrap_never_exceeds_width() {
        let lines = wrap_to_width(
            "Zahnfleischbluten Parodontalbehandlungsplanung extrem langes Wort",
            9,
            false,
            60.0,
        );
        assert!(lines.iter().all(|l| text_width_pt(l, 9, false) <= 60.0));
        assert!(lines.len() > 2);
    }
}

//! Invoice and patient record as PDF.
//!
//! Both document types use the shared [`PageBuilder`] from
//! [`super::core`] and the DIN-5008 letterhead from [`super::letterhead`].
//! Margins, fonts, encoding, and page numbers are therefore consistent.
//!
//! - **Invoice** ([`render`]) — GOZ/GOÄ-compliant table with position, date,
//!   tooth, GOZ no., description, quantity, factor, and total. Totals block
//!   on the right with VAT note. Bank details + payment terms in the footer.
//! - **Patient record** ([`render_chart_blocks`]) — modular block lists with
//!   master data, diagnosis, findings, treatments, attachment metadata, etc.

use crate::error::AppError;

use super::core::{
    emit_pdf_document, pdf_locale, sanitize_pdf_money, table_row_height, text_width,
    truncate_cell, wrap_text, PageBuilder, PdfDocMeta, CONTENT_WIDTH, M_BOTTOM, M_LEFT, M_RIGHT,
};
use super::letterhead::{emit_continuation_header_locale, emit_letterhead, Letterhead, MetaRow};
use super::logo::PdfLogo;

// ===========================================================================
// INVOICE — moved to `invoice_goz.rs` (Anlage 2 GOZ structure, German).
// ===========================================================================

pub use super::invoice_goz::{
    fmt_amount, render_goz_invoice, FeeSchedule, Invoice, InvoiceKind, InvoiceLine,
};

/// Render an invoice. Kept as `render` for existing call sites.
pub fn render(invoice: &Invoice) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    render_goz_invoice(invoice)
}

// ===========================================================================
// PATIENT RECORD  (modular block list)
// ===========================================================================

/// Table inside a record block.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct ChartPdfTable {
    pub headers: Vec<String>,
    pub rows: Vec<Vec<String>>,
    /// Optional column weights (e.g. `[2, 1, 10]` → narrow · narrow · wide).
    /// If omitted: even distribution across [`CONTENT_WIDTH`].
    pub column_weights: Option<Vec<i32>>,
}

impl ChartPdfTable {
    pub fn new(headers: Vec<String>, rows: Vec<Vec<String>>) -> Self {
        Self {
            headers,
            rows,
            column_weights: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn with_column_weights(mut self, weights: Vec<i32>) -> Self {
        self.column_weights = Some(weights);
        self
    }
}

/// One section in the record (master data, diagnosis, treatments, …).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct ChartPdfBlock {
    pub title: String,
    pub body_lines: Vec<String>,
    pub kv_pairs: Vec<(String, String)>,
    pub table: Option<ChartPdfTable>,
}

impl ChartPdfBlock {
    pub fn body(title: impl Into<String>, lines: Vec<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            title: title.into(),
            body_lines: lines,
            kv_pairs: Vec::new(),
            table: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn kv(title: impl Into<String>, kv: Vec<(String, String)>) -> Self {
        Self {
            title: title.into(),
            body_lines: Vec::new(),
            kv_pairs: kv,
            table: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn table(title: impl Into<String>, table: ChartPdfTable) -> Self {
        Self {
            title: title.into(),
            body_lines: Vec::new(),
            kv_pairs: Vec::new(),
            table: Some(table),
        }
    }
}

/// Legacy single-document mode (for backward compatibility).
pub struct ChartDocument {
    pub patient_name: String,
    pub patient_date_of_birth: String,
    pub patient_insurance_number: String,
    pub chart_status: String,
    pub diagnosis: Option<String>,
    pub findings: Option<String>,
    pub treatments: Vec<(String, String)>,
    pub generated_at: String,
}

/// Practice header data for record / fact sheet (optional — when `None` a
/// slim header without DIN-5008 letterhead is rendered).
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ChartHeaderContext {
    pub practice_lines: Vec<String>,
    pub clinician_name: Option<String>,
    pub professional_title: Option<String>,
    pub bsnr: Option<String>,
    pub zanr: Option<String>,
    pub created_by: Option<String>,
    pub document_id: Option<String>,
    pub logo: Option<PdfLogo>,
    pub locale: String,
    pub rtl: bool,
    /// "ENTWURF" for previews (not registered, not audited as export).
    pub watermark: Option<String>,
    /// DIN footer lines (practice identity).
    pub footer_lines: Vec<String>,
}

impl Default for ChartHeaderContext {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            practice_lines: Vec::new(),
            clinician_name: None,
            professional_title: None,
            bsnr: None,
            zanr: None,
            created_by: None,
            document_id: None,
            logo: None,
            locale: "de".into(),
            rtl: false,
            watermark: None,
            footer_lines: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
}

/// Main renderer for the patient record as PDF (modular).
///
/// `header` supplies the practice context (letterhead, provider) for the first
/// page. When empty, only title + date are rendered at the top.
pub fn render_chart_blocks(
    doc_title: &str,
    generated_at: &str,
    pdf_title_meta: &str,
    blocks: &[ChartPdfBlock],
    header: Option<&ChartHeaderContext>,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    let mut pb = PageBuilder::new();
    let locale = pdf_locale(header.map(|h| h.locale.as_str()).unwrap_or("de"));
    pb.locale = locale;
    let de = locale == "de";
    if let Some(h) = header {
        pb.watermark = h.watermark.clone();
        pb.footer_lines = h.footer_lines.clone();
    }

    // ---------- Header -----------------------------------------------------
    if let Some(h) = header.filter(|h| !h.practice_lines.is_empty()) {
        let mut meta = Vec::new();
        if let Some(id) = h.document_id.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
            meta.push(MetaRow::new(if de { "Dokument-Nr." } else { "Document no." }, id));
        }
        meta.push(MetaRow::new(if de { "Erstellt am" } else { "Created" }, generated_at));
        if let Some(by) = h.created_by.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
            meta.push(MetaRow::new(if de { "Erstellt von" } else { "Created by" }, by));
        }
        if let Some(b) = h.clinician_name.as_deref().filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
            meta.push(MetaRow::new(if de { "Behandler/in" } else { "Clinician" }, b));
        }

        let lh = Letterhead {
            practice_lines: &h.practice_lines,
            meta_rows: &meta,
            address_lines: &[],
            header_right_lines: &[],
            show_sender_hint: false,
            compact_address: false,
            logo: h.logo.as_ref(),
            rtl: h.rtl,
            locale,
        };
        emit_letterhead(&mut pb, &lh);
    } else {
        // Slim header: title + date only
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 18, true, doc_title);
        pb.advance(22);
        let created = if de { "Erstellt am" } else { "Created" };
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, false, &format!("{created}: {generated_at}"));
        pb.advance(14);
        pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
        pb.advance(20);
    }

    // Place document title centrally even when letterhead is present
    if header.is_some() {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 16, true, doc_title);
        pb.advance(20);
        pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
        pb.advance(18);
    }

    // ---------- Blocks -----------------------------------------------------
    let practice_name = header
        .and_then(|h| h.practice_lines.first().cloned())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "MeDoc".into());
    pb.set_continuation(&practice_name, doc_title, locale);

    if blocks.is_empty() {
        let empty = if de { "(Keine Inhalte für diesen Export.)" } else { "(No content for this export.)" };
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 10, false, empty);
        pb.advance(14);
    }

    for block in blocks {
        emit_chart_block(&mut pb, block, &practice_name, doc_title);
    }

    // ---------- GDPR notice at the end ------------------------------------
    if header.is_some() {
        pb.ensure_space(60);
        pb.advance(10);
        pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
        pb.advance(14);
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 8, true, if de { "Datenschutzhinweis" } else { "Privacy notice" });
        pb.advance(11);
        let notice = if de {
            "Dieses Dokument enthält vertrauliche Patientendaten (§ 630f BGB, Art. 9 DSGVO). \
             Weitergabe nur mit ausdrücklicher Einwilligung der Patientin bzw. des Patienten."
        } else {
            "This document contains confidential patient data (§ 630f BGB, Art. 9 GDPR). \
             Disclosure only with the patient's explicit consent."
        };
        pb.paragraph(notice, 8, 120, 0);
    }

    let pages = pb.finish();
    {
        let images: Vec<PdfLogo> = header.and_then(|h| h.logo.clone()).into_iter().collect();
        emit_pdf_document(
            &pages,
            &PdfDocMeta {
                title: pdf_title_meta.to_string(),
                subject: header.and_then(|h| h.document_id.clone()),
                author: header.and_then(|h| h.practice_lines.first().cloned()),
                locale: locale.to_string(),
            },
            &images,
        )
    }
}

fn emit_chart_block(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    block: &ChartPdfBlock,
    practice_name: &str,
    doc_title: &str,
) {
    // Ensure at least title + 2 lines fit
    pb.ensure_space(48);
    if pb.y < M_BOTTOM + 100 {
        pb.break_page();
        emit_continuation_header_locale(pb, practice_name, doc_title, "en");
    }

    // Block-Titel in Hellgrau-Band
    pb.table_header_band(M_LEFT, pb.y + 2, CONTENT_WIDTH);
    pb.text(M_LEFT + 4, 11, true, &block.title);
    pb.advance(18);

    let mut wrote_any = false;

    if let Some(ref tbl) = block.table {
        if !tbl.headers.is_empty() || !tbl.rows.is_empty() {
            emit_chart_table(pb, tbl, practice_name, doc_title);
            wrote_any = true;
        }
    }

    if !block.kv_pairs.is_empty() {
        for (k, version) in &block.kv_pairs {
            emit_chart_kv_pair(pb, k, version, practice_name, doc_title);
        }
        wrote_any = true;
    }

    if !block.body_lines.is_empty() {
        for line in &block.body_lines {
            let display = crate::infrastructure::clinical_text_format::plain_text_for_pdf(line);
            for chunk in wrap_text(&display, 90) {
                if pb.y < M_BOTTOM + 24 {
                    pb.break_page();
                    emit_continuation_header_locale(pb, practice_name, doc_title, "en");
                }
                pb.text(M_LEFT, 10, false, &chunk);
                pb.advance(12);
            }
        }
        wrote_any = true;
    }

    if !wrote_any {
        let none = if pb.locale == "de" { "(keine Einträge)" } else { "(no entries)" };
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 10, false, none);
        pb.advance(12);
    }

    pb.advance(8);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(14);
}

fn emit_chart_kv_pair(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    key: &str,
    value: &str,
    practice_name: &str,
    doc_title: &str,
) {
    let display =
        sanitize_pdf_money(&crate::infrastructure::clinical_text_format::plain_text_for_pdf(value));
    let label = format!("{key}:");
    let label_w = text_width(&label, 9, true);
    // Long labels (e.g. "Income (current calendar month)") must not collide with values.
    let value_x = M_LEFT + label_w + 14;
    let fits_one_line = !display.contains('\n')
        && value_x + text_width(&display, 10, false) <= M_RIGHT
        && label_w <= 240;

    if pb.y < M_BOTTOM + 30 {
        pb.break_page();
        emit_continuation_header_locale(pb, practice_name, doc_title, "en");
    }

    if fits_one_line {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, true, &label);
        pb.text(value_x, 10, false, &display);
        pb.advance(14);
    } else {
        pb.text(M_LEFT, 9, true, &label);
        pb.advance(12);
        for chunk in wrap_text(&display, 90) {
            if pb.y < M_BOTTOM + 24 {
                pb.break_page();
                emit_continuation_header_locale(pb, practice_name, doc_title, "en");
            }
            pb.text(M_LEFT + 8, 10, false, &chunk);
            pb.advance(12);
        }
        pb.advance(4);
    }
}

fn chart_table_column_xs(ncol: usize, weights: Option<&[i32]>) -> Vec<i32> {
    let n = ncol.max(1);
    let Some(w) = weights.filter(|w| !w.is_empty()) else {
        let step = CONTENT_WIDTH / n as i32;
        return (0..n).map(|i| M_LEFT + i as i32 * step).collect();
    };
    let sum: i32 = w.iter().copied().sum::<i32>().max(1);
    let mut xs = vec![M_LEFT];
    let mut acc = 0i32;
    for i in 0..n.saturating_sub(1) {
        let wt = w.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(1).max(1);
        acc += CONTENT_WIDTH * wt / sum;
        xs.push(M_LEFT + acc);
    }
    xs
}

/// Usable width (pt) per column (cell padding subtracted).
fn chart_table_column_pt_widths(col_xs: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32> {
    let mut w = Vec::with_capacity(col_xs.len());
    for i in 0..col_xs.len() {
        let next = col_xs.get(i + 1).copied().unwrap_or(M_RIGHT);
        w.push((next - col_xs[i] - 2 * CHART_CELL_PAD).max(20));
    }
    w
}

fn is_amount_header(h: &str) -> bool {
    let l = h.to_ascii_lowercase();
    l.contains("amount") || l.contains("betrag") || l.contains("total") || l.contains("eur")
}

const CHART_CELL_PAD: i32 = 6;

fn emit_chart_table_header_row(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    tbl: &ChartPdfTable,
    col_xs: &[i32],
    col_widths: &[i32],
) {
    pb.table_header_band(M_LEFT, pb.y + 2, CONTENT_WIDTH);
    for ci in 0..tbl.headers.len().max(1) {
        let h = tbl.headers.get(ci).map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
        let max_pt = col_widths.get(ci).copied().unwrap_or(60);
        let x = col_xs.get(ci).copied().unwrap_or(M_LEFT);
        let next = col_xs.get(ci + 1).copied().unwrap_or(M_RIGHT);
        let n = super::metrics::fit_chars(h, 9, true, f64::from(max_pt));
        let text = truncate_cell(h, n.max(3));
        if is_amount_header(h) {
            pb.text_right(next - CHART_CELL_PAD, 9, true, &text);
        } else {
            pb.text(x + CHART_CELL_PAD, 9, true, &text);
        }
    }
    pb.advance(14);
    pb.hline(M_LEFT, M_RIGHT);
    pb.advance(10);
}

fn emit_chart_table(
    pb: &mut PageBuilder,
    tbl: &ChartPdfTable,
    practice_name: &str,
    doc_title: &str,
) {
    let ncol = tbl
        .headers
        .len()
        .max(tbl.rows.iter().map(|r| r.len()).max().unwrap_or(0))
        .max(1);
    let col_xs = chart_table_column_xs(ncol, tbl.column_weights.as_deref());
    let col_widths = chart_table_column_pt_widths(&col_xs);

    if pb.y < M_BOTTOM + 60 {
        pb.break_page();
        emit_continuation_header_locale(pb, practice_name, doc_title, "en");
    }

    emit_chart_table_header_row(pb, tbl, &col_xs, &col_widths);

    if tbl.rows.is_empty() {
        let none = if pb.locale == "de" { "(keine Tabelleneinträge)" } else { "(no table rows)" };
        pb.text(M_LEFT + CHART_CELL_PAD, 9, false, none);
        pb.advance(12);
        return;
    }

    for (ri, row) in tbl.rows.iter().enumerate() {
        let mut wrapped: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::with_capacity(ncol);
        let mut row_lines = 1usize;
        for ci in 0..ncol {
            let cell = row.get(ci).map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
            let safe = sanitize_pdf_money(cell);
            let max_pt = col_widths.get(ci).copied().unwrap_or(60);
            let w = super::metrics::wrap_to_width(&safe, 9, false, f64::from(max_pt));
            row_lines = row_lines.max(w.len().max(1));
            wrapped.push(w);
        }

        let font_size = 9;
        let line_step = 12;
        let row_height = table_row_height(row_lines, line_step, font_size);
        if pb.y < M_BOTTOM + row_height + 20 {
            pb.break_page();
            emit_continuation_header_locale(pb, practice_name, doc_title, "en");
            emit_chart_table_header_row(pb, tbl, &col_xs, &col_widths);
        }

        let first_baseline = pb.y;
        if ri % 2 == 1 {
            pb.fill_table_row_band(
                M_LEFT,
                CONTENT_WIDTH,
                first_baseline,
                row_height,
                font_size,
                0.97,
            );
        }

        for li in 0..row_lines {
            for ci in 0..ncol {
                let x = col_xs.get(ci).copied().unwrap_or(M_LEFT);
                let next = col_xs.get(ci + 1).copied().unwrap_or(M_RIGHT);
                let chunk = wrapped
                    .get(ci)
                    .and_then(|w| w.get(li))
                    .map(|s| s.as_str())
                    .unwrap_or("");
                if chunk.is_empty() {
                    continue;
                }
                let prev = pb.y;
                pb.y = first_baseline - li as i32 * line_step;
                let header = tbl.headers.get(ci).map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                if is_amount_header(header) {
                    pb.text_right(next - CHART_CELL_PAD, font_size, false, chunk);
                } else {
                    pb.text(x + CHART_CELL_PAD, font_size, false, chunk);
                }
                pb.y = prev;
            }
        }
        pb.advance(row_height);
    }
    pb.advance(4);
}

/// Legacy wrapper.
pub fn render_chart(doc: &ChartDocument) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    let diag = doc
        .diagnosis
        .clone()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "(none recorded)".into());
    let bef = doc
        .findings
        .clone()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "(none recorded)".into());
    let beh_lines: Vec<String> = if doc.treatments.is_empty() {
        vec!["(no treatments recorded)".to_string()]
    } else {
        doc.treatments
            .iter()
            .map(|(d, b)| format!("{d} — {b}"))
            .collect()
    };

    let blocks = vec![
        ChartPdfBlock::kv(
            "Master data / chart header",
            vec![
                ("Patient".into(), doc.patient_name.clone()),
                ("Date of birth".into(), doc.patient_date_of_birth.clone()),
                ("Insurance no.".into(), doc.patient_insurance_number.clone()),
                ("Chart status".into(), doc.chart_status.clone()),
            ],
        ),
        ChartPdfBlock::body("Diagnosis", vec![diag]),
        ChartPdfBlock::body("Findings (free text)", vec![bef]),
        ChartPdfBlock::body("Treatments", beh_lines),
    ];

    render_chart_blocks(
        "PatientChart",
        &doc.generated_at,
        &format!("PatientChart {}", doc.patient_name),
        &blocks,
        None,
    )
}

/// Key-value row in the report summary block.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ReportPdfSummaryRow {
    pub label: String,
    pub value: String,
}

/// Tabular section (same table primitive as PatientChart).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ReportPdfSection {
    pub title: String,
    pub headers: Vec<String>,
    pub rows: Vec<Vec<String>>,
}

/// Structured input for practice reports (Income, Statistics, BalanceSheet).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ReportPdfInput {
    pub doc_title: String,
    pub generated_at: String,
    pub practice_name: String,
    pub practice_address: Vec<String>,
    pub summary: Vec<ReportPdfSummaryRow>,
    pub sections: Vec<ReportPdfSection>,
    /// Which report this is — decides the permission the command requires:
    /// `finance` (default) | `statistics` | `audit` | `compliance` | `daily_report`.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub report_kind: Option<String>,
    /// Document language (`de` default).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub locale: Option<String>,
    /// Registry number (set by the backend when the report is issued).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub document_number: Option<String>,
    /// "ENTWURF" for previews.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub watermark: Option<String>,
}

/// Renders a practice report PDF using the same [`render_chart_blocks`] pipeline as
/// Chart / Leaflet — identical letterhead, margins, tables, and page numbers.
pub fn render_report_pdf(input: &ReportPdfInput) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    let mut practice_lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    if !input.practice_name.trim().is_empty() {
        practice_lines.push(input.practice_name.trim().to_string());
    }
    for line in &input.practice_address {
        let t = line.trim();
        if !t.is_empty() {
            practice_lines.push(t.to_string());
        }
    }

    let header = if practice_lines.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(ChartHeaderContext {
            practice_lines,
            locale: pdf_locale(input.locale.as_deref().unwrap_or("de")).into(),
            document_id: input.document_number.clone(),
            watermark: input.watermark.clone(),
            ..Default::default()
        })
    };
    let de = pdf_locale(input.locale.as_deref().unwrap_or("de")) == "de";

    let mut blocks: Vec<ChartPdfBlock> = Vec::new();
    if !input.summary.is_empty() {
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::kv(
            if de { "Zusammenfassung" } else { "Summary" },
            input
                .summary
                .iter()
                .map(|r| (r.label.clone(), r.value.clone()))
                .collect(),
        ));
    }
    for sec in &input.sections {
        if sec.headers.is_empty() && sec.rows.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let mut table = ChartPdfTable::new(sec.headers.clone(), sec.rows.clone());
        // Two-column metric/amount tables: give the value column room + right align.
        if sec.headers.len() == 2 {
            table = table.with_column_weights(vec![3, 2]);
        }
        blocks.push(ChartPdfBlock::table(&sec.title, table));
    }

    render_chart_blocks(
        &input.doc_title,
        &input.generated_at,
        &input.doc_title,
        &blocks,
        header.as_ref(),
    )
}

// ===========================================================================
// Template preview (for template editor)
// ===========================================================================

/// Preview renderer: uses either a structured layout
/// (`layout_json`, see `clinical_pdf_layout`) or the same letterhead/footer
/// library via [`clinical_pdf_layout::render_plain_preview`].
pub fn render_template_preview_pdf(
    kind: &str,
    template_name: &str,
    footer: &str,
    body_pt: i32,
    body_lines: &[String],
    layout_json: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AppError> {
    if let Some(json) = layout_json.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()) {
        let layout: super::clinical_layout::ClinicalPdfLayout = serde_json::from_str(json)
            .map_err(|e| AppError::Validation(format!("PDF-Layout: {e}")))?;
        return super::clinical_layout::render_clinical_layout(&layout);
    }

    super::clinical_layout::render_plain_preview(kind, template_name, footer, body_pt, body_lines)
}

fn receipt_layout() -> String {
    r#"{"kind":"receipt","practiceLines":["Gefälschte Praxis"],"documentTitle":"QUITTUNG",
        "addressLines":["Lena Muster"],"totals":[{"label":"Betrag","value":"45,00 EUR","total":true}]}"#
        .into()
}

fn year() -> String {
    chrono::Local::now().format("%Y").to_string()
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn receipt_is_numbered_once_and_reprinted_as_copy() {
    let pool = setup().await;
    let s = session("PHYSICIAN");
    let args = |preview| IssueClinicalArgs {
        kind: "receipt".into(),
        source_id: "pay-paid".into(),
        layout_json: receipt_layout(),
        preview,
        copy_variant: None,
    };

    let preview = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, args(true))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(
        preview.document_number.is_none(),
        "preview must not consume a number"
    );

    let first = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, args(false))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        first.document_number.as_deref(),
        Some(format!("QU-{}-000001", year()).as_str())
    );
    assert!(!first.reprint);

    let again = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, args(false))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(again.reprint);
    assert_eq!(again.document_number, first.document_number);
    assert_ne!(
        again.sha256, first.sha256,
        "copy carries the KOPIE watermark"
    );

    // Server overwrote the practice header sent by the client.
    let doc = issued_document_repo::find_by_id(&pool, first.document_id.as_deref().unwrap())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(doc.payload_json.contains("Zahnarztpraxis Dr. Test"));
    assert!(!doc.payload_json.contains("Gefälschte Praxis"));

    // Both prints are verifiable by hash.
    assert!(issued_document_repo::find_by_sha256(&pool, &again.sha256)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .is_some());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn invoice_cancellation_creates_storno_and_locks_original() {
    let pool = setup().await;
    let s = session("PHYSICIAN");
    let issued = issue_invoice(
        &pool,
        &s,
        IssueInvoiceArgs {
            patient_id: "p1".into(),
            invoice: invoice(),
            preview: false,
        },
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        issued.document_number.as_deref(),
        Some(format!("RE-{}-000001", year()).as_str())
    );

    let storno = cancel_invoice(
        &pool,
        &s,
        issued.document_id.as_deref().unwrap(),
        "Doppelt erfasst",
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        storno.document_number.as_deref(),
        Some(format!("ST-{}-000001", year()).as_str())
    );

    let original = issued_document_repo::find_by_id(&pool, issued.document_id.as_deref().unwrap())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(original.status, "CANCELLED");
    // A second cancellation is refused.
    assert!(cancel_invoice(&pool, &s, &original.id, "nochmal")
        .await
        .is_err());

    // GoBD: content of an issued document cannot be changed or deleted.
    let upd = sqlx::query("UPDATE issued_document SET payload_json = '{}' WHERE id = ?1")
        .bind(&original.id)
        .execute(&pool)
        .await;
    assert!(upd.is_err());
    let del = sqlx::query("DELETE FROM issued_document WHERE id = ?1")
        .bind(&original.id)
        .execute(&pool)
        .await;
    assert!(del.is_err());
}

fn bytes(p: &IssuedPdf) -> Vec<u8> {
    base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD
        .decode(&p.pdf_base64)
        .expect("base64")
}

/// WinAnsi bytes as Latin-1 text, with PDF string escapes resolved
/// (`\\ddd` octal, `\\(`, `\\)`, `\\\\`). Content streams are uncompressed.
fn text(pdf: &[u8]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(pdf.len());
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < pdf.len() {
        let b = pdf[i];
        if b == b'\\' && i + 1 < pdf.len() {
            let n = pdf[i + 1];
            if n.is_ascii_digit() && i + 3 < pdf.len() && pdf[i + 2].is_ascii_digit() && pdf[i + 3].is_ascii_digit() {
                let v = (n - b'0') as u32 * 64 + (pdf[i + 2] - b'0') as u32 * 8 + (pdf[i + 3] - b'0') as u32;
                out.push(char::from_u32(v).unwrap_or('?'));
                i += 4;
                continue;
            }
            if matches!(n, b'(' | b')' | b'\\') {
                out.push(n as char);
                i += 2;
                continue;
            }
        }
        out.push(b as char);
        i += 1;
    }
    out
}

/// Text as it appears in the content stream (WinAnsi = Latin-1 for these chars).
fn latin1(s: &str) -> String {
    s.to_string()
}

/// Checks every official PDF must pass.
fn assert_official(name: &str, pdf: &[u8], number: Option<&str>) -> String {
    let path = out_dir().join(format!("{name}.pdf"));
    std::fs::write(&path, pdf).unwrap();
    let t = text(pdf);
    assert!(t.starts_with("%PDF-1."), "{name}: header");
    assert!(t.trim_end().ends_with("%%EOF"), "{name}: trailer");
    assert!(t.contains("/MediaBox [0 0 595"), "{name}: A4 page size");
    assert!(
        t.contains("/Lang (de-DE)") || t.contains("/Lang (de)"),
        "{name}: /Lang"
    );
    assert!(t.contains("/CreationDate (D:"), "{name}: CreationDate");
    assert!(t.contains("/Title ("), "{name}: Title");
    for needle in ["Zahnarztpraxis Dr. Anna Berger", "Seite 1 von"] {
        assert!(t.contains(&latin1(needle)), "{name}: missing {needle:?}");
    }
    // Legal identity on every official document (footer).
    for needle in ["66/123/45678", "DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00"] {
        assert!(t.contains(needle), "{name}: footer missing {needle:?}");
    }
    if let Some(n) = number {
        assert!(t.contains(n), "{name}: document number {n} not printed");
    }
    assert!(
        !t.contains("ENTWURF"),
        "{name}: final document must not carry ENTWURF"
    );
    t
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn render_official_document_samples() {
    let pool = setup().await;
    let s = session();
    let year = chrono::Local::now().format("%Y").to_string();

    // ---- Invoice (GOZ Anlage 2) --------------------------------------------
    let line = |nr: &str, desc: &str, points: u32, factor: f64, tooth: Option<&str>| InvoiceLine {
        description: desc.into(),
        goz_nr: Some(nr.into()),
        points: Some(points),
        factor: Some(factor),
        quantity: Some(1),
        amount_cents: unit_fee_cents(FeeSchedule::Goz, points, factor),
        tooth_nr: tooth.map(String::from),
        treatment_date: Some("2026-11-02".into()),
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let mut endo = line(
        "2410",
        "Aufbereitung eines Wurzelkanals",
        392,
        3.0,
        Some("36"),
    );
    endo.diagnosis_reason =
        Some("Stark gekrümmte, obliterierte Kanäle, erhöhter Zeitaufwand".into());
    let invoice = Invoice {
        recipient_name: "Lena Müller".into(),
        recipient_address: vec!["Musterweg 3".into(), "49076 Osnabrück".into()],
        lines: vec![
            line("0010", "Eingehende Untersuchung", 100, 2.3, None),
            line(
                "0090",
                "Intraorale Infiltrationsanästhesie",
                60,
                2.3,
                Some("36"),
            ),
            endo,
            InvoiceLine {
                description: "Wurzelfüllmaterial (Guttapercha, Sealer)".into(),
                fee_schedule: FeeSchedule::Material,
                amount_cents: 1850,
                quantity: Some(1),
                treatment_date: Some("2026-11-02".into()),
                ..Default::default()
            },
        ],
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let inv = issue_invoice(
        &pool,
        &s,
        IssueInvoiceArgs {
            patient_id: "p1".into(),
            invoice,
            preview: false,
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("issue invoice");
    let inv_no = format!("RE-{year}-000001");
    assert_eq!(inv.document_number.as_deref(), Some(inv_no.as_str()));
    let t = assert_official("01-rechnung", &bytes(&inv), Some(&inv_no));
    for needle in [
        "GOZ",
        "Faktor",
        "2410",
        "Zwischensumme",
        "Rechnungsbetrag",
        "geb. 15.01.1990",
        "Leistungszeitraum",
        "Steuer-Nr. 66/123/45678",
        "Kammer: Zahnärztekammer Niedersachsen",
        "Tel. 0541 123456",
        "unter Angabe der Rechnungsnummer",
        "4 Nr. 14",
        "Zahlbar innerhalb von 30 Tagen",
    ] {
        assert!(t.contains(&latin1(needle)), "invoice: missing {needle:?}");
    }
    // § 10 Abs. 3 GOZ justification is printed next to the 3.0 factor.
    assert!(t.contains("Kan"), "invoice: factor justification missing");

    // ---- Cancellation (Stornorechnung) ------------------------------------
    let storno = cancel_invoice(
        &pool,
        &s,
        inv.document_id.as_deref().unwrap(),
        "Rechnungsadresse falsch",
    )
    .await
    .expect("cancel");
    let st_no = format!("ST-{year}-000001");
    let t = assert_official("02-stornorechnung", &bytes(&storno), Some(&st_no));
    assert!(
        t.contains(&inv_no),
        "storno must reference the original invoice"
    );

    // ---- Certificate (AU): patient copy and employer copy -------------------
    let cert_layout = r#"{
      "kind": "certificate",
      "documentTitle": "ARBEITSUNFÄHIGKEITSBESCHEINIGUNG",
      "metaLines": [{"label": "Ausgestellt am", "value": "09.11.2026"}],
      "introParagraphs": ["Hiermit wird bescheinigt, dass die unten genannte Person arbeitsunfähig ist."],
      "twoColumn": {"leftTitle": "Patient/in", "leftLines": ["Lena Müller", "Geb.-Datum: 15.01.1990"],
                    "rightTitle": "Anschrift", "rightLines": ["Musterweg 3, 49076 Osnabrück"]},
      "labelValueRows": [
        {"label": "Festgestellt am", "value": "09.11.2026"},
        {"label": "Arbeitsunfähig von", "value": "09.11.2026"},
        {"label": "Voraussichtlich bis einschließlich", "value": "11.11.2026"},
        {"label": "Diagnose (ICD-10)", "value": "K04.0 Pulpitis", "confidential": true},
        {"label": "Befund", "value": "Akute Pulpitis 36", "confidential": true}
      ]
    }"#;
    let cert = |variant: &str| IssueClinicalArgs {
        kind: "certificate".into(),
        source_id: "c1".into(),
        layout_json: cert_layout.into(),
        preview: false,
        copy_variant: Some(variant.into()),
    };
    let patient_copy = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, cert("patient"))
        .await
        .expect("AU patient");
    let at_no = patient_copy.document_number.clone().unwrap();
    let t = assert_official("03-au-patient", &bytes(&patient_copy), Some(&at_no));
    assert!(t.contains("K04.0"), "patient copy keeps the diagnosis");
    // Patient identity comes from the database, not from the client layout.
    for needle in ["Lena Müller", "Geb.-Datum: 15.01.1990", "Vers.-Nr.: A123456789"] {
        assert!(t.contains(needle), "AU: missing {needle:?}");
    }

    let employer_copy = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, cert("employer"))
        .await
        .expect("AU employer");
    let t = assert_official(
        "04-au-arbeitgeber",
        &bytes(&employer_copy),
        employer_copy.document_number.as_deref(),
    );
    assert!(
        !t.contains("K04.0") && !t.contains("Pulpitis"),
        "employer copy must not show the diagnosis"
    );
    assert!(t.contains("Arbeitgeber"), "employer copy is labelled");
    assert!(t.contains("Lena Müller"), "employer copy names the patient");
    assert!(!t.contains("A123456789"), "employer copy omits the insurance number");

    // ---- Private prescription (AMVV § 2) ----------------------------------
    let rx_layout = r#"{
      "kind": "prescription",
      "documentTitle": "PRIVATREZEPT",
      "metaLines": [{"label": "Ausstellungsdatum", "value": "09.11.2026"}],
      "twoColumn": {"leftTitle": "Patient/in", "leftLines": ["Lena Müller", "Geb.-Datum: 15.01.1990"],
                    "rightTitle": "Anschrift", "rightLines": ["Musterweg 3, 49076 Osnabrück"]},
      "tables": [{"title": "Rp.", "columnLayout": "prescription",
        "headers": ["Arzneimittel / Stärke", "Darreichungsform", "Packung", "Dosierung", "PZN"],
        "rows": [["Ibuprofen 600 mg", "Filmtabletten", "1 × N1 (20 St.)", "1-0-1 nach dem Essen", "—"]]}],
      "labelValueRows": [{"label": "Dauer", "value": "5 Tage"},
                         {"label": "Aut idem", "value": "Austausch zulässig"}],
      "closingParagraphs": ["Privatrezept: gültig 3 Monate ab Ausstellungsdatum."]
    }"#;
    let rx = issue_clinical_document(
        &pool,
        &s,
        IssueClinicalArgs {
            kind: "prescription".into(),
            source_id: "rx1".into(),
            layout_json: rx_layout.into(),
            preview: false,
            copy_variant: None,
        },
    )
    .await
    .expect("prescription");
    let t = assert_official(
        "05-privatrezept",
        &bytes(&rx),
        rx.document_number.as_deref(),
    );
    for needle in [
        "Ibuprofen 600 mg",
        "Filmtabletten",
        "1-0-1",
        "Dr. med. dent. Anna Berger",
        "ZANR 987654321",
    ] {
        assert!(t.contains(needle), "prescription: missing {needle:?}");
    }

    // ---- Receipt, reprint, preview ---------------------------------------
    let receipt_layout = r#"{
      "kind": "receipt",
      "documentTitle": "QUITTUNG",
      "metaLines": [{"label": "Zahlungsdatum", "value": "09.11.2026"}, {"label": "Zahlart", "value": "Karte"}],
      "addressLines": ["Lena Müller", "Musterweg 3", "49076 Osnabrück"],
      "tables": [{"columnLayout": "receipt", "headers": ["Datum", "Leistung", "Betrag"],
                  "rows": [["02.11.2026", "Wurzelkanalbehandlung 36", "112,24 EUR"], ["02.11.2026", "Anästhesie", "7,76 EUR"]]}],
      "totals": [{"label": "Rechnungsbetrag", "value": "120,00 EUR"},
                 {"label": "Erhaltener Betrag", "value": "120,00 EUR", "total": true},
                 {"label": "Noch offen", "value": "0,00 EUR"}],
      "closingParagraphs": ["Umsatzsteuerfrei gem. § 4 Nr. 14 Buchst. a UStG.", "Betrag dankend erhalten."]
    }"#;
    let receipt = |preview| IssueClinicalArgs {
        kind: "receipt".into(),
        source_id: "pay1".into(),
        layout_json: receipt_layout.into(),
        preview,
        copy_variant: None,
    };
    let preview = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, receipt(true))
        .await
        .expect("preview");
    assert!(preview.document_number.is_none());
    let preview_pdf = bytes(&preview);
    std::fs::write(out_dir().join("06-quittung-vorschau.pdf"), &preview_pdf).unwrap();
    assert!(
        text(&preview_pdf).contains("ENTWURF"),
        "preview carries ENTWURF"
    );

    let q = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, receipt(false))
        .await
        .expect("receipt");
    let qu_no = format!("QU-{year}-000001");
    let t = assert_official("07-quittung", &bytes(&q), Some(&qu_no));
    assert!(
        t.contains("Erhaltener Betrag") && t.contains("120,00"),
        "receipt totals"
    );

    let copy = issue_clinical_document(&pool, &s, receipt(false))
        .await
        .expect("reprint");
    assert!(copy.reprint);
    let t = assert_official("08-quittung-kopie", &bytes(&copy), Some(&qu_no));
    assert!(t.contains("KOPIE"), "reprint carries KOPIE");

    // ---- Daily report (Tagesabschluss) -----------------------------------
    let report = ReportPdfInput {
        doc_title: "Tagesabschluss 09.11.2026".into(),
        generated_at: "09.11.2026 18:05".into(),
        report_kind: Some("daily_report".into()),
        summary: vec![
            ReportPdfSummaryRow {
                label: "Einnahmen des Tages".into(),
                value: "120,00 EUR".into(),
            },
            ReportPdfSummaryRow {
                label: "Anzahl Zahlungen".into(),
                value: "1".into(),
            },
        ],
        sections: vec![ReportPdfSection {
            title: "Zahlungen des Tages".into(),
            headers: vec![
                "Uhrzeit".into(),
                "Patient/in".into(),
                "Zahlart".into(),
                "Betrag".into(),
            ],
            rows: vec![vec![
                "10:42".into(),
                "Lena Müller".into(),
                "CARD".into(),
                "120,00 EUR".into(),
            ]],
        }],
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let tb = issue_report(&pool, &s, report, Some("2026-11-09".into()), false)
        .await
        .expect("report");
    let tb_no = format!("TB-{year}-000001");
    assert_eq!(tb.document_number.as_deref(), Some(tb_no.as_str()));
    std::fs::write(out_dir().join("09-tagesabschluss.pdf"), bytes(&tb)).unwrap();

    eprintln!("PDF samples written to {}", out_dir().display());
}

use medoc_core::error::AppError;
use medoc_core::infrastructure::database::patient_repo;
use sqlx::SqlitePool;

use crate::repo::{mark_applied, was_applied, OutboxEntry};

/// Conflict resolution when two devices edited the same row offline.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ConflictPolicy {
    /// Newer `updated_at` wins. Equal timestamps break by lexicographic
    /// `device_id` (higher wins). No master tie-break.
    ///
    /// When **either** side lacks a parsable `updated_at`:
    /// - Master ingesting a member push, or replica ingesting an admin pull
    ///   (`admin_pull` phase): accept inbound.
    /// - Replica ingesting a mesh peer push: keep local when row exists.
    LastWriteWins,
}

pub async fn apply_remote_entry(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    local_device_id: &str,
    local_is_master: bool,
    policy: ConflictPolicy,
    entry: &OutboxEntry,
) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
    apply_remote_entry_phased(pool, local_device_id, local_is_master, false, policy, entry).await
}

/// `admin_pull`: replica applying master rows after push-then-pull — admin
/// authoritative when timestamps are missing (product: merge member, then admin).
pub async fn apply_remote_entry_phased(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    local_device_id: &str,
    local_is_master: bool,
    admin_pull: bool,
    policy: ConflictPolicy,
    entry: &OutboxEntry,
) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
    if was_applied(pool, &entry.device_id, entry.seq).await? {
        return Ok(false);
    }

    let applied = match entry.op.as_str() {
        "INSERT" | "UPDATE" => {
            apply_upsert(
                pool,
                local_device_id,
                local_is_master,
                admin_pull,
                policy,
                entry,
            )
            .await?
        }
        "DELETE" => apply_delete(pool, entry).await?,
        _ => {
            return Err(AppError::Validation(format!(
                "unknown sync op: {}",
                entry.op
            )))
        }
    };

    if applied {
        mark_applied(pool, &entry.device_id, entry.seq).await?;
    }
    Ok(applied)
}

async fn apply_upsert(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    local_device_id: &str,
    local_is_master: bool,
    admin_pull: bool,
    policy: ConflictPolicy,
    entry: &OutboxEntry,
) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
    let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&entry.payload_json)
        .map_err(|e| AppError::Validation(format!("sync payload json: {e}")))?;
    let Some(obj) = payload.as_object() else {
        return Err(AppError::Validation(
            "sync payload must be a JSON object".into(),
        ));
    };

    let exists: i64 = if entry.entity_table == "app_kv" {
        sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_kv WHERE key = ?1")
            .bind(&entry.entity_id)
            .fetch_one(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?
    } else {
        let table = sanitize_table(&entry.entity_table)?;
        sqlx::query_scalar(&format!("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table} WHERE id = ?1"))
            .bind(&entry.entity_id)
            .fetch_one(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?
    };

    if exists > 0 && policy == ConflictPolicy::LastWriteWins {
        let remote_ts = obj.get("updated_at").and_then(parse_ts);
        let local_ts = load_local_updated_at(pool, &entry.entity_table, &entry.entity_id).await?;
        match (local_ts, remote_ts) {
            (Some(local), Some(remote)) => {
                if remote > local {
                    // Remote is fresher → apply.
                } else if remote < local {
                    tracing::debug!(
                        target: "medoc::sync",
                        event = "SKIP_STALE_REMOTE",
                        table = %entry.entity_table,
                        id = %entry.entity_id,
                        local = %local,
                        remote = %remote,
                    );
                    return Ok(true);
                } else if entry.device_id.as_str() <= local_device_id {
                    // Timestamp tie → higher device_id wins (no master tie-break).
                    tracing::debug!(
                        target: "medoc::sync",
                        event = "SKIP_TIE_LOSER",
                        table = %entry.entity_table,
                        id = %entry.entity_id,
                        remote_device = %entry.device_id,
                        local_device = %local_device_id,
                    );
                    return Ok(true);
                }
            }
            _ => {
                let accept_inbound = local_is_master || admin_pull;
                if !accept_inbound {
                    tracing::debug!(
                        target: "medoc::sync",
                        event = "SKIP_REPLICA_COLLISION",
                        table = %entry.entity_table,
                        id = %entry.entity_id,
                    );
                    return Ok(true);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if entry.entity_table == "app_kv" {
        apply_app_kv(pool, &entry.entity_id, obj).await?;
    } else if exists == 0 {
        insert_from_json(pool, &entry.entity_table, &entry.entity_id, obj).await?;
    } else {
        update_from_json(pool, &entry.entity_table, &entry.entity_id, obj).await?;
    }
    Ok(true)
}

/// Reads `updated_at` from the existing local row, if any. Returns `None`
/// for app_kv (no timestamp tracked per row at field level), missing rows,
/// or any parse error: the caller falls back to legacy master-wins.
async fn load_local_updated_at(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    table: &str,
    id: &str,
) -> Result<Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::FixedOffset>>, AppError> {
    if table == "app_kv" {
        let raw: Option<String> =
            sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT updated_at FROM app_kv WHERE key = ?1")
                .bind(id)
                .fetch_optional(pool)
                .await
                .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        return Ok(raw.and_then(|s| parse_ts_str(&s)));
    }
    if table == "in_app_notification" {
        let raw: Option<String> = sqlx::query_scalar(
            "SELECT CAST(created_at AS TEXT) FROM in_app_notification WHERE id = ?1",
        )
        .bind(id)
        .fetch_optional(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        return Ok(raw.and_then(|s| parse_ts_str(&s)));
    }
    let safe = sanitize_table(table)?;
    let raw: Result<Option<String>, sqlx::Error> = sqlx::query_scalar(&format!(
        "SELECT CAST(updated_at AS TEXT) FROM {safe} WHERE id = ?1"
    ))
    .bind(id)
    .fetch_optional(pool)
    .await;
    let raw = match raw {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(e) if e.to_string().contains("no such column: updated_at") => {
            sqlx::query_scalar(&format!(
                "SELECT CAST(created_at AS TEXT) FROM {safe} WHERE id = ?1"
            ))
            .bind(id)
            .fetch_optional(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?
        }
        Err(e) => return Err(AppError::Database(e)),
    };
    Ok(raw.and_then(|s| parse_ts_str(&s)))
}

fn parse_ts(version: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::FixedOffset>> {
    version.as_str().and_then(parse_ts_str)
}

/// Accepts RFC 3339 (preferred) and SQLite's `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS[.fff]`
/// default form, treating naive timestamps as UTC.
fn parse_ts_str(s: &str) -> Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::FixedOffset>> {
    let trimmed = s.trim();
    if trimmed.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    if let Ok(ts) = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(trimmed) {
        return Some(ts);
    }
    let normalised = trimmed.replacen(' ', "T", 1);
    if let Ok(ts) = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&format!("{normalised}Z")) {
        return Some(ts);
    }
    if let Ok(naive) = chrono::NaiveDateTime::parse_from_str(trimmed, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") {
        let utc: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc> =
            chrono::TimeZone::from_utc_datetime(&chrono::Utc, &naive);
        return Some(utc.fixed_offset());
    }
    if let Ok(naive) = chrono::NaiveDateTime::parse_from_str(trimmed, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%.f") {
        let utc: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc> =
            chrono::TimeZone::from_utc_datetime(&chrono::Utc, &naive);
        return Some(utc.fixed_offset());
    }
    None
}

async fn apply_app_kv(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    key: &str,
    obj: &serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let value = obj
        .get("value")
        .map(json_to_sql_literal)
        .transpose()?
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let row_key = obj
        .get("key")
        .and_then(|version| version.as_str())
        .unwrap_or(key);
    sqlx::query("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO app_kv (key, value) VALUES (?1, ?2)")
        .bind(row_key)
        .bind(value)
        .execute(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

async fn apply_delete(pool: &SqlitePool, entry: &OutboxEntry) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
    let table = sanitize_table(&entry.entity_table)?;
    if table == "app_kv" {
        sqlx::query("DELETE FROM app_kv WHERE key = ?1")
            .bind(&entry.entity_id)
            .execute(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        return Ok(true);
    }
    if table == "patient" {
        patient_repo::delete_row(pool, &entry.entity_id).await?;
        return Ok(true);
    }
    if table == "patient_chart" {
        for sql in [
            "DELETE FROM treatment WHERE chart_id = ?1",
            "DELETE FROM examination WHERE chart_id = ?1",
            "DELETE FROM dental_finding WHERE chart_id = ?1",
            "DELETE FROM chart_attachment WHERE chart_id = ?1",
        ] {
            sqlx::query(sql)
                .bind(&entry.entity_id)
                .execute(pool)
                .await
                .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        }
        sqlx::query("DELETE FROM patient_chart WHERE id = ?1")
            .bind(&entry.entity_id)
            .execute(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        return Ok(true);
    }
    if table == "service_item" {
        sqlx::query("UPDATE payment SET service_item_id = NULL WHERE service_item_id = ?1")
            .bind(&entry.entity_id)
            .execute(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        sqlx::query("DELETE FROM service_item WHERE id = ?1")
            .bind(&entry.entity_id)
            .execute(pool)
            .await
            .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
        return Ok(true);
    }
    sqlx::query(&format!("DELETE FROM {table} WHERE id = ?1"))
        .bind(&entry.entity_id)
        .execute(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(true)
}

async fn table_column_names(pool: &SqlitePool, table: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, AppError> {
    sqlx::query_scalar(&format!("SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('{table}')"))
        .fetch_all(pool)
        .await
        .map_err(AppError::Database)
}

fn keep_known_column(known: &[String], name: &str) -> bool {
    known.iter().any(|c| c == name)
}

async fn insert_from_json(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    table: &str,
    id: &str,
    obj: &serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let table = sanitize_table(table)?;
    let known = table_column_names(pool, table).await?;
    let mut cols = vec!["id".to_string()];
    let mut binds: Vec<String> = vec![id.to_string()];
    for (k, version) in obj {
        if k == "id" || !keep_known_column(&known, k) {
            continue;
        }
        cols.push(k.clone());
        binds.push(json_to_sql_literal(version)?);
    }
    let placeholders: Vec<String> = (1..=binds.len()).map(|i| format!("?{i}")).collect();
    let sql = format!(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO {table} ({}) VALUES ({})",
        cols.join(", "),
        placeholders.join(", ")
    );
    let mut q = sqlx::query(&sql);
    for b in binds {
        q = q.bind(b);
    }
    q.execute(pool).await.map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

async fn update_from_json(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    table: &str,
    id: &str,
    obj: &serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let table = sanitize_table(table)?;
    let known = table_column_names(pool, table).await?;
    let mut sets = Vec::new();
    let mut binds = Vec::new();
    let mut idx = 1;
    for (k, version) in obj {
        if k == "id" || !keep_known_column(&known, k) {
            continue;
        }
        sets.push(format!("{k} = ?{idx}"));
        binds.push(json_to_sql_literal(version)?);
        idx += 1;
    }
    if sets.is_empty() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let sql = format!("UPDATE {table} SET {} WHERE id = ?{idx}", sets.join(", "));
    let mut q = sqlx::query(&sql);
    for b in binds {
        q = q.bind(b);
    }
    q = q.bind(id);
    q.execute(pool).await.map_err(AppError::Database)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn sanitize_table(table: &str) -> Result<&str, AppError> {
    const ALLOWED: &[&str] = &[
        "staff",
        "patient",
        "patient_chart",
        "appointment",
        "treatment",
        "examination",
        "payment",
        "app_kv",
        "practice_task",
        "anamnesis_form",
        "dental_finding",
        "prescription",
        "certificate",
        "service_item",
        "in_app_notification",
        "practice_ticket",
        "issued_document",
    ];
    if ALLOWED.contains(&table) {
        Ok(table)
    } else {
        Err(AppError::Validation(format!(
            "sync entity_table not allow-listed: {table}"
        )))
    }
}

fn json_to_sql_literal(version: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<String, AppError> {
    match version {
        serde_json::Value::Null => Ok(String::new()),
        serde_json::Value::Bool(b) => Ok(if *b { "1".into() } else { "0".into() }),
        serde_json::Value::Number(n) => Ok(n.to_string()),
        serde_json::Value::String(s) => Ok(s.clone()),
        other => Ok(other.to_string()),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::sanitize_table;

    #[test]
    fn allow_list_rejects_unknown_tables() {
        assert!(sanitize_table("staff").is_ok());
        assert!(sanitize_table("license").is_err());
        assert!(sanitize_table("patient").is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn tier1_tables_are_allow_listed() {
        for table in [
            "anamnesis_form",
            "dental_finding",
            "prescription",
            "certificate",
            "service_item",
            "in_app_notification",
            "practice_ticket",
        ] {
            assert!(sanitize_table(table).is_ok(), "{table}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_ts_str_handles_rfc3339_and_sqlite_naive() {
        use super::parse_ts_str;
        assert!(parse_ts_str("2099-01-01T00:00:00Z").is_some());
        assert!(parse_ts_str("2099-01-01 00:00:00").is_some());
        assert!(parse_ts_str("2099-01-01 00:00:00.123").is_some());
        assert!(parse_ts_str("").is_none());
        assert!(parse_ts_str("   ").is_none());
        assert!(parse_ts_str("not-a-date").is_none());
    }
}
